test_cases.title: Start of Mission in Level 2 triggers session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Level 2. No communication session is established. Safe radio connection is not set up.

steps.action: Perform Start of Mission procedure in Level 2.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the establishment of a communication session (requests safe radio connection set-up).

test_cases.title: Trackside order triggers session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Level 2. No communication session is established. Safe radio connection is not set up.

steps.action: Receive an order from trackside to establish a communication session.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the establishment of a communication session (requests safe radio connection set-up).

test_cases.title: Mode change to be reported to RBC triggers session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Level 2. No communication session is established. Safe radio connection is not set up. A mode change occurs that requires reporting to the RBC (not End of Mission).

steps.action: Execute a mode change that must be reported to the RBC in Level 2.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the establishment of a communication session (requests safe radio connection set-up).

test_cases.title: Manual level change to Level 2 triggers session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Level 1. No communication session is established. Safe radio connection is not set up.

steps.action: Driver manually changes the level to Level 2.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the establishment of a communication session (requests safe radio connection set-up).

test_cases.title: Engine rear end reaching end of announced radio hole triggers session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Level 2. A radio hole has been announced. The engine rear end is approaching the end of the radio hole. No communication session is established.

steps.action: The engine rear end reaches the end of the announced radio hole.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the establishment of a communication session (requests safe radio connection set-up).

test_cases.title: Previous session terminated due to loss of safe radio connection triggers new session
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Level 2. A communication session was previously established but is considered terminated due to loss of safe radio connection.

steps.action: The condition 'previous session considered terminated due to loss of safe radio connection' is met.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the establishment of a new communication session (requests safe radio connection set-up).

test_cases.title: Driver manually selecting RBC contact information outside Start of Mission triggers session
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Level 2. Outside Start of Mission procedure. No communication session is established.

steps.action: Driver manually selects RBC contact information.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the establishment of a communication session (requests safe radio connection set-up).

test_cases.title: Successful session establishment sequence
test_cases.preconditions: Trigger for session establishment is active. Safe radio connection can be set up. System version is compatible.

steps.action: OBU requests set-up of safe radio connection.
steps.expected: Safe radio connection is established.

steps.action: OBU sends Initiation of communication session.
steps.expected: Message is sent to trackside.

steps.action: OBU receives system version from trackside.
steps.expected: OBU considers the session established and sends a session established report.

test_cases.title: Session establishment with incompatible system version
test_cases.preconditions: Trigger for session establishment is active. Safe radio connection can be set up. System version is not compatible.

steps.action: OBU requests set-up of safe radio connection and sends Initiation of communication session.
steps.expected: Safe radio connection is established and initiation message is sent.

steps.action: OBU receives a system version that is not compatible.
steps.expected: OBU sends 'No compatible version supported', informs the driver, and terminates the session.

test_cases.title: Retry on safe radio connection failure during Start of Mission
test_cases.preconditions: Start of Mission procedure is in progress in Level 2. First request for safe radio connection fails.

steps.action: OBU requests set-up of safe radio connection and it fails.
steps.expected: OBU immediately repeats the request for safe radio connection set-up.

test_cases.title: Radio system selection based on trackside order (FRMCS-only RBC)
test_cases.preconditions: Both FRMCS and GSM-R radio systems are fitted. Trackside order to establish session with an RBC interfaced with FRMCS only.

steps.action: OBU receives order to establish session with FRMCS-only RBC.
steps.expected: OBU requests set-up of safe radio connection using the FRMCS radio system.

test_cases.title: Radio system selection based on driver's single-radio choice
test_cases.preconditions: Both FRMCS and GSM-R radio systems are fitted. Stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. Driver elected during Start of Mission to use only GSM-R. No trackside order specifying radio system.

steps.action: Trigger for session establishment occurs (e.g., mode change).
steps.expected: OBU requests set-up of safe radio connection using the GSM-R radio system.

test_cases.title: Radio system selection based on stored Radio Network information
test_cases.preconditions: Both FRMCS and GSM-R radio systems are fitted. Stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. No trackside order specifying radio system. No driver single-radio choice. Preferred radio system from previous session is FRMCS.

steps.action: Trigger for session establishment occurs.
steps.expected: OBU requests set-up of safe radio connection using the FRMCS radio system (preferred from previous session).

test_cases.title: Memorisation of radio system used for successful connection
test_cases.preconditions: Both FRMCS and GSM-R radio systems are fitted. Session establishment is triggered. GSM-R is selected and successfully sets up the safe radio connection.

steps.action: OBU successfully sets up safe radio connection using GSM-R.
steps.expected: OBU stores GSM-R as the radio system used for the successful safe radio connection set-up.

test_cases.title: Abort session establishment on desk closure during Start of Mission
test_cases.preconditions: Start of Mission in Level 2. Session establishment is in progress (safe radio connection requested or set up, system version not yet received).

steps.action: Driver closes the desk during Start of Mission while session establishment is in progress.
steps.expected: OBU aborts the session establishment process and releases the safe radio connection (if any).

test_cases.title: Abort session establishment on End of Mission
test_cases.preconditions: Session establishment is in progress (safe radio connection requested or set up, system version not yet received).

steps.action: End of Mission is performed while session establishment is in progress.
steps.expected: OBU aborts the session establishment process and releases the safe radio connection (if any).

test_cases.title: Abort session establishment on trackside termination order
test_cases.preconditions: Session establishment is in progress (safe radio connection requested or set up, system version not yet received).

steps.action: OBU receives an order from trackside to terminate the communication session while establishment is in progress.
steps.expected: OBU aborts the session establishment process and releases the safe radio connection (if any).

test_cases.title: Abort session establishment on passing Level 2 exit border
test_cases.preconditions: Session establishment is in progress (safe radio connection requested or set up, system version not yet received). Train is approaching a level transition border from Level 2 to an area where Level 2 is not supported.

steps.action: Train passes with its min safe rear end the level transition border from Level 2 to a non-Level 2 area while session establishment is in progress.
steps.expected: OBU aborts the session establishment process and releases the safe radio connection (if any).

test_cases.title: Abort session establishment on passing RBC/RBC border
test_cases.preconditions: Session establishment is in progress (safe radio connection requested or set up, system version not yet received). Train is approaching an RBC/RBC border.

steps.action: Train passes an RBC/RBC border with its min safe rear end while session establishment is in progress.
steps.expected: OBU aborts the session establishment process and releases the safe radio connection (if any).

test_cases.title: Use stored RBC contact info when order contains 'last known RBC' identity
test_cases.preconditions: RBC contact information is stored on board. Trackside order to establish session contains the special RBC identity value meaning 'last known RBC' and a telephone number.

steps.action: OBU receives the order with 'last known RBC' identity.
steps.expected: OBU disregards the telephone number in the order and contacts the RBC using its stored RBC contact information.

test_cases.title: Ignore order for 'last known RBC' when no contact info is stored
test_cases.preconditions: No RBC contact information is stored on board. Trackside order to establish session contains the special RBC identity value meaning 'last known RBC'.

steps.action: OBU receives the order with 'last known RBC' identity.
steps.expected: OBU ignores the order and does not attempt to establish a communication session.

test_cases.title: Prevention of duplicate session establishment with the same RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2, Start of Mission is completed, and a communication session with RBC-A is currently being established (safe radio connection requested but not yet confirmed).

steps.action: Trigger a new session establishment request for the same RBC-A (e.g., via a mode change that requires reporting to the RBC).
steps.expected: The OBU does not initiate a new session establishment process with RBC-A. The existing establishment process continues or completes without interruption.

test_cases.title: Prevention of duplicate session establishment with an established RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2, and a communication session with RBC-A is established and active. No Termination of Communication Session message has been sent to RBC-A.

steps.action: Trigger a new session establishment request for the same RBC-A (e.g., via manual selection of RBC contact information for RBC-A outside Start of Mission).
steps.expected: The OBU does not initiate a new session establishment process with RBC-A. The existing session remains active.

test_cases.title: Termination of existing session when establishing a new one with a different RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2, and a communication session with RBC-A is established and active.

steps.action: Receive an order from trackside to establish a communication session with RBC-B (a different RBC).
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the existing session with RBC-A (sends Termination of Communication Session) and initiates the establishment of a new session with RBC-B.

test_cases.title: Exception: Accepting RBC order does not terminate current session if multi-session capable
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2, capable of handling multiple communication sessions via GSM-R, and a communication session with RBC-A is established and active.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is configured to support multiple simultaneous GSM-R sessions.

steps.action: Receive an RBC transition order containing an embedded order to establish a session with an Accepting RBC (RBC-B).
steps.expected: The OBU does not terminate the existing session with RBC-A. It initiates the establishment of a new session with RBC-B while maintaining the session with RBC-A.

test_cases.title: Evaluation of balise information validity in Shunting mode (reverse direction)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Shunting (SH) mode. Train orientation is forward. A balise group is ahead in the reverse direction (behind the train's current forward orientation).

steps.action: The train moves in reverse and crosses the balise group. The balise transmits information valid only for the reverse direction (the direction of crossing).
steps.expected: The OBU takes the information into account, as it is valid for the crossing direction.

steps.action: The train moves in reverse and crosses another balise group. The balise transmits information valid only for the forward direction (opposite to the crossing direction).
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the information, as it is valid only for the opposite direction.

test_cases.title: Immediate MA request upon receipt of new parameters if repetition period elapsed
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2, session established. Last MA request was sent 10 seconds ago. Current MA request parameters specify a repetition period of 5 seconds.

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from the RBC specifying a repetition period of 5 seconds.
steps.expected: The OBU immediately sends an MA request to the RBC, because the time since the last MA request (10s) is greater than or equal to the newly received repetition period (5s).

test_cases.title: No immediate MA request upon receipt of new parameters if repetition period not elapsed
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2, session established. Last MA request was sent 2 seconds ago. Current MA request parameters specify a repetition period of 5 seconds.

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from the RBC specifying a repetition period of 5 seconds.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send an MA request immediately. It waits until the new repetition period (5 seconds) has elapsed since the last MA request.

test_cases.title: No Supervised Location defined while LOA is supervised
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2, supervising a Limit of Authority (LOA) with a target speed above zero. The MA includes an End Section and a Danger Point.

steps.action: The train approaches the End Section of the LOA.
steps.expected: The OBU does not define the End Section as a Supervised Location (SvL). The train is supervised based on the LOA target speed, not by a SvL-based stop.

test_cases.title: Level 1 signalling speed restriction remains valid after switching to Level 2
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1, supervising a signalling related speed restriction of 50 km/h. The train is approaching a Level 2 area.

steps.action: The OBU switches from Level 1 to Level 2. No Level 2 MA has been accepted yet.
steps.expected: The signalling related speed restriction of 50 km/h remains valid and is applied by the OBU.

steps.action: A Level 2 MA is accepted by the OBU.
steps.expected: The signalling related speed restriction is no longer applied, as the Level 2 MA takes precedence.

test_cases.title: Maximum Train Speed applied as Static Speed Restriction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2, train data configured with a Maximum Train Speed of 200 km/h. No other speed restrictions are active.

steps.action: The train accelerates towards 200 km/h.
steps.expected: The OBU limits the train speed to 200 km/h, treating the Maximum Train Speed as a Static Speed Restriction.

test_cases.title: Initial state of no speed restriction for permitted braking distance
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2, no permitted braking distance data has been received from trackside.

steps.action: The train operates under normal supervision.
steps.expected: No speed restriction based on permitted braking distance is applied. The train speed is not constrained by a PBD limit.

test_cases.title: Immediate re-establishment attempt after safe radio connection loss
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established with the trackside. The safe radio connection is active and was previously set up via a specific radio system (e.g., GSM-R).
test_cases.assumptions: The radio system used for the initial connection is available and functional for re-establishment.

steps.action: Simulate a loss of the safe radio connection (EURORADIO indicates loss).
steps.expected: The OBU immediately initiates an attempt to set up a new safe radio connection using the same radio system that was used for the previous successful connection.

test_cases.title: Repeated attempts until safe radio connection is re-established
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established. The safe radio connection is lost.
test_cases.assumptions: The defined time for considering the session terminated has not yet elapsed.

steps.action: Simulate a loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts attempting to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Allow the first re-establishment attempt to fail.
steps.expected: The OBU repeats the attempt to set up the safe radio connection.

steps.action: Allow the second re-establishment attempt to fail.
steps.expected: The OBU repeats the attempt to set up the safe radio connection.

steps.action: Allow the third re-establishment attempt to succeed.
steps.expected: The OBU stops repeating the attempts as the safe radio connection is now set up.

test_cases.title: Attempts stop when session is considered terminated due to timeout
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established. The safe radio connection is lost. The defined time for maintaining the session (as per A.3.1) is known and can be monitored.
test_cases.assumptions: The re-establishment attempts continue to fail throughout the defined time period.

steps.action: Simulate a loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts attempting to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Wait until the defined time for maintaining the session elapses without a successful re-establishment.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the session as terminated and stops repeating the attempts to set up the safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Attempts stop when train passes RIU termination location
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established with an RIU. The safe radio connection is lost. The OBU has received an RIU order to terminate the communication session at a specific location.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is moving towards the specified termination location.

steps.action: Simulate a loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts attempting to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Move the train past the location indicated in the RIU order to terminate the communication session.
steps.expected: The OBU stops repeating the attempts to set up the safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Termination initiated by trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established with the RBC. The train is in a supervised mode (e.g., FS). No termination condition defined in other sections is currently active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order to terminate the communication session (e.g., via RBC message).

steps.action: The OBU receives an explicit order from the trackside (RBC) to terminate the communication session.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination of the communication session by sending the 'Termination of communication session' message.

test_cases.title: Termination initiated by internal condition without trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established with the RBC. The train is in a supervised mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger for an internal termination condition (e.g., loss of safe radio connection or specific mode change requiring session end as per SUBSET-026).
test_cases.assumptions: The specific internal condition is one defined in SUBSET-026 that requires termination without an explicit trackside order.

steps.action: A condition requiring the termination of the communication session is fulfilled (e.g., safe radio connection is lost) without receiving an explicit trackside order.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination of the communication session by sending the 'Termination of communication session' message.

test_cases.title: No termination initiated without valid trigger
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established with the RBC. The train is in a stable supervised mode. No trackside order to terminate is received. No internal termination condition is fulfilled.
test_cases.test_inputs: None.

steps.action: The system operates normally for a duration longer than the fixed waiting time, with no trackside termination order and no internal termination condition triggered.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send a 'Termination of communication session' message. The session remains established.

test_cases.title: Repetition of Termination message upon missing acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established. The OBU has initiated termination and sent the first 'Termination of communication session' message. The RBC does not send an acknowledgement.
test_cases.test_inputs: None (simulated lack of acknowledgement from RBC).
test_cases.assumptions: The fixed waiting time is defined in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: The OBU sends the 'Termination of communication session' message.
steps.expected: The message is transmitted.

steps.action: The fixed waiting time elapses without receiving an acknowledgement from the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU repeats the 'Termination of communication session' message.

test_cases.title: No repetition if acknowledgement is received within waiting time
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established. The OBU has initiated termination and sent the 'Termination of communication session' message.
test_cases.test_inputs: Acknowledgement of termination from RBC.

steps.action: The OBU sends the 'Termination of communication session' message.
steps.expected: The message is transmitted.

steps.action: The RBC sends an acknowledgement of the termination within the fixed waiting time.
steps.expected: The OBU does not repeat the 'Termination of communication session' message.

test_cases.title: Session considered terminated after max repetitions without acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established. The OBU has initiated termination. The RBC does not send any acknowledgement.
test_cases.test_inputs: None (simulated lack of acknowledgement from RBC).
test_cases.assumptions: The defined number of repetitions is N (from SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1). The fixed waiting time is T.

steps.action: The OBU sends the 'Termination of communication session' message (1st attempt).
steps.expected: Message sent.

steps.action: The fixed waiting time T elapses without acknowledgement. The OBU repeats the message (2nd attempt).
steps.expected: Message repeated.

steps.action: The process continues until the defined number of repetitions N is reached. The fixed waiting time T elapses after the last sending without acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the communication session terminated. No further 'Termination of communication session' messages are sent.

test_cases.title: Session not considered terminated if acknowledgement received before max repetitions
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established. The OBU has initiated termination. The RBC does not send acknowledgement for the first few attempts but sends it before the max repetitions are exhausted.
test_cases.test_inputs: Acknowledgement of termination from RBC.
test_cases.assumptions: The defined number of repetitions is N. The acknowledgement is received after the (N-1)th repetition.

steps.action: The OBU sends the 'Termination of communication session' message and repeats it (N-1) times, with no acknowledgement received for the first (N-1) attempts.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to repeat the message as per the repetition logic.

steps.action: The RBC sends an acknowledgement of the termination within the fixed waiting time after the (N-1)th repetition.
steps.expected: The OBU stops repeating the message. The session termination process is completed via acknowledgement, not by timeout after max repetitions.

test_cases.title: GSM-R Mobile Terminal registration at power-up
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered off. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected and available. The OBU has a valid GSM-R Radio Network identity stored (either memorized or default).

steps.action: Power up the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU orders the registration of the connected GSM-R Mobile Terminal to the GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: GSM-R Mobile Terminal registration after driver enters new identity
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in a stable state. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected. The current GSM-R Radio Network identity is different from the one to be entered.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new valid GSM-R Radio Network identity.

steps.action: The driver enters a new GSM-R Radio Network identity into the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU orders the registration of the connected GSM-R Mobile Terminal to the new GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: GSM-R Mobile Terminal registration when ordered by trackside
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected but is not currently registered to the target GSM-R Radio Network. The Mobile Terminal is not used for an established communication session and no safe radio connection is being set up.
test_cases.test_inputs: A Radio Network transition order from trackside specifying a GSM-R Radio Network type (GSM-R or FRMCS+GSM-R).

steps.action: The OBU receives a Radio Network transition order from trackside specifying a GSM-R Radio Network.
steps.expected: The OBU stores the Radio Network type and orders the registration of the GSM-R Mobile Terminal to the specified GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: Use of default Radio Network type after System Failure
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in System Failure state. No Radio Network type has been memorized from trackside or driver. A default Radio Network type is configured on-board.

steps.action: The OBU recovers from System Failure and initializes its radio communication management.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the default Radio Network type configured on-board for its radio network management.

test_cases.title: Use of default Radio Network type at very first power-up
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered off. No Radio Network type has ever been memorized (very first power-up scenario). A default Radio Network type is configured on-board.

steps.action: Power up the OBU for the first time.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the default Radio Network type configured on-board.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when FRMCS not registered (FRMCS only installed)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is fitted with FRMCS on-board equipment only. The stored Radio Network type is FRMCS. The FRMCS on-board equipment is not registered to the FRMCS Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: The OBU receives a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when FRMCS not registered (FRMCS+GSM-R, both installed, no single-radio choice)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is fitted with both FRMCS on-board equipment and a GSM-R Mobile Terminal. The stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. The driver has not elected to perform the mission with only one radio system. The FRMCS on-board equipment is not registered to the FRMCS Radio Network. The GSM-R Mobile Terminal is duly registered to a GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: The OBU receives a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when GSM-R not registered (FRMCS+GSM-R, both installed, no single-radio choice)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is fitted with both FRMCS on-board equipment and a GSM-R Mobile Terminal. The stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. The driver has not elected to perform the mission with only one radio system. The FRMCS on-board equipment is duly registered to the FRMCS Radio Network. No GSM-R Mobile Terminal is duly registered to a GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: The OBU receives a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when selected radio system not registered (single-radio choice)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is fitted with both FRMCS on-board equipment and a GSM-R Mobile Terminal. The stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. The driver has elected to perform the mission with only one radio system (e.g., FRMCS). The selected FRMCS on-board equipment is no longer registered to the FRMCS Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: The OBU receives a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when GSM-R not registered (GSM-R only installed)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is fitted with GSM-R Mobile Terminal only. The stored Radio Network type is GSM-R. No GSM-R Mobile Terminal is duly registered to a GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: The OBU receives a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request for RIU session when GSM-R not registered
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is fitted with a GSM-R Mobile Terminal. The GSM-R Mobile Terminal is not duly registered to a GSM-R Radio Network. No communication session is established.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with a Radio Infill Unit (RIU).

steps.action: The OBU receives a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RIU.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Indication of 'Connection Up' status upon successful safe radio connection
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2. The driver interface is active. The indication status is currently 'No Connection'. A request to set up a safe radio connection with the relevant RBC has been sent.

steps.action: The safe radio connection with the relevant RBC is successfully established (condition [4] of Table 2 is met).
steps.expected: The OBU changes the indication status to 'Connection Up'.

test_cases.title: Indication of 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' upon timer expiry
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2. The indication status is 'No Connection'. The OBU has sent a request to set up a safe radio connection and the 'connection status' timer is running.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'connection status' timer value is known and can be monitored or simulated to expire.

steps.action: Wait for the 'connection status' timer to expire without the safe radio connection being established (condition [2] of Table 2 is met).
steps.expected: The OBU changes the indication status to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'.

test_cases.title: Start of connection status timer upon first request for session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2. No communication session is established. The indication status is 'No Connection'. The 'connection status' timer is not running.
test_cases.assumptions: The state of the 'connection status' timer (running/stopped) is observable via test instrumentation or logs.

steps.action: Trigger a session establishment event (e.g., Start of Mission or mode change report) that causes the OBU to send the first request to set up a safe radio connection with the relevant RBC.
steps.expected: The 'connection status' timer starts immediately upon sending the first request.

test_cases.title: Start of connection status timer upon first request for session maintenance
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2. A communication session is established. The safe radio connection is lost, and the OBU initiates attempts to re-establish it (maintaining the session). The 'connection status' timer is not running.
test_cases.assumptions: The state of the 'connection status' timer (running/stopped) is observable via test instrumentation or logs.

steps.action: Observe the OBU sending the first request to set up a safe radio connection to maintain the existing session after a loss.
steps.expected: The 'connection status' timer starts immediately upon sending this first request.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'Connection Up' to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' upon connection release
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2. The indication status is 'Connection Up'. The safe radio connection is active.

steps.action: The safe radio connection is released by the trackside or OBU (condition [5] of Table 2 is met).
steps.expected: The OBU changes the indication status to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'Connection Up' to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' upon connection loss with stopped requests
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2. The indication status is 'Connection Up'. The safe radio connection is active.

steps.action: The safe radio connection is lost, and the requests to set up a safe radio connection are stopped for a reason other than successful set-up (condition [6] of Table 2 is met).
steps.expected: The OBU changes the indication status to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'Connection Up' to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' upon entering a radio hole
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2. The indication status is 'Connection Up'. The safe radio connection is active. The train is approaching an announced radio hole.

steps.action: The safe radio connection is lost, and the engine (considering front and rear ends) overlaps an announced radio hole (condition [7] of Table 2 is met).
steps.expected: The OBU changes the indication status to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' to 'No Connection' upon stopping requests
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2. The indication status is 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'. No Start of Mission procedure is ongoing.

steps.action: The requests to set up a safe radio connection are stopped with the relevant RBC/RIU for a reason other than successful set-up (condition [3] of Table 2 is met).
steps.expected: The OBU changes the indication status to 'No Connection'.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'No Connection' to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' upon final attempt failure during Start of Mission
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2. The indication status is 'No Connection'. A Start of Mission procedure is ongoing.

steps.action: The final attempt to set up the safe radio connection fails during the ongoing Start of Mission procedure (condition [1] of Table 2 is met).
steps.expected: The OBU changes the indication status to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'.

test_cases.title: Indication of safe radio connection status for current RIU infill area
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1. The OBU has safe radio connections with multiple Radio Infill Units (RIUs) or is capable of connecting to different RIUs in different infill areas. The train is currently in a specific infill area associated with RIU-A.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is configured to manage multiple RIU connections or the test environment simulates the presence of multiple RIUs.

steps.action: The safe radio connection with RIU-A (current infill area) is established.
steps.expected: The OBU indicates 'Connection Up' to the driver, reflecting the status of the connection with RIU-A.

steps.action: The train moves to a new infill area associated with RIU-B, and the safe radio connection with RIU-B is established while the connection with RIU-A is released or lost.
steps.expected: The OBU indicates the status of the safe radio connection with RIU-B (e.g., 'Connection Up' if established) to the driver, not the status of RIU-A.

test_cases.title: Valid position stored after passing LRBG with invalid position
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where train position is monitored. The current train position status is 'invalid'. An LRBG is available ahead of the train.

steps.action: Verify the current train position status is 'invalid'.
steps.expected: The OBU reports the train position status as 'invalid'.

steps.action: Move the train to pass the LRBG.
steps.expected: The OBU regards a valid train position as stored on board. The train position status changes to 'valid'.

steps.action: Check the status of the previously stored invalid train position.
steps.expected: The previously stored invalid train position is deleted.

test_cases.title: Valid position stored after passing ORBG with unknown position
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where train position is monitored. The current train position status is 'unknown'. An ORBG is available ahead of the train.

steps.action: Verify the current train position status is 'unknown'.
steps.expected: The OBU reports the train position status as 'unknown'.

steps.action: Move the train to pass the ORBG.
steps.expected: The OBU regards a valid train position as stored on board. The train position status changes to 'valid'.

steps.action: Check the status of the previously stored invalid train position.
steps.expected: The previously stored invalid train position is deleted.

test_cases.title: Train orientation defined by active cab
test_cases.preconditions: The train has two cabs. Cab A is active. Cab B is inactive.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the train orientation.
steps.expected: The OBU defines the train orientation such that the side of Cab A is considered the front of the train.

test_cases.title: Train orientation defined by last active cab when no cab is active
test_cases.preconditions: The train has two cabs. Cab A was the last active cab. Both Cab A and Cab B are now inactive.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the train orientation.
steps.expected: The OBU defines the train orientation based on the last active cab (Cab A), such that the side of Cab A is considered the front of the train.

test_cases.title: Estimated front end used for location based supervision
test_cases.preconditions: The train has a valid position. The estimated front end, max safe front end, and min safe rear end are distinct. A location based event (e.g., start of a mode profile) is defined at a specific track position.
test_cases.assumptions: The specific function being tested does not have an explicit exception in SUBSET-026 requiring a different reference (e.g., it is not an End Section timer or level transition border).

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end reaches the location of the location based event.
steps.expected: The OBU triggers the supervision action (e.g., mode change) when the estimated front end reaches the event location.

steps.action: Verify that the max safe front end and min safe rear end were not used as the trigger reference.
steps.expected: The supervision action was not triggered earlier (by max safe front end) or later (by min safe rear end) than the estimated front end position.

test_cases.title: Position reporting with valid LRBG and acceptance of trackside data
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established. Train has passed a balise group (BG1) that is marked as linked and contained in the previously received linking information. Linking consistency is checked on-board. The OBU has reported BG1 to the RBC as LRBGONB.

steps.action: The train moves forward from BG1. The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.
steps.expected: The position report refers to BG1 as the LRBGONB.

steps.action: The RBC sends a message containing trackside information (e.g., MA or profile data) that refers to BG1.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the information and processes it correctly.

test_cases.title: Position reporting with unlinked balise group when linking consistency is not checked
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established. Linking consistency is NOT checked on-board. Train has passed a balise group (BG2) that is not marked as unlinked. The OBU has reported BG2 to the RBC as LRBGONB.

steps.action: The train moves forward from BG2. The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.
steps.expected: The position report refers to BG2 as the LRBGONB, as it is considered LRBG compliant under the 'not marked as unlinked' condition.

steps.action: The RBC sends a message containing trackside information that refers to BG2.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the information.

test_cases.title: Acceptance of trackside data referring to the 8th last reported LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established. The OBU has reported 8 distinct LRBG compliant balise groups to the RBC in sequence: BG1, BG2, BG3, BG4, BG5, BG6, BG7, BG8. BG8 is the current LRBGONB. The train is currently located after BG8.
test_cases.assumptions: The minimum number of LRBGs to be accepted is 8, as per SUBSET-026 §3.6.2.2.2 c).

steps.action: The RBC sends a message containing trackside information that refers to BG1 (the 8th last reported LRBG).
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the information, as BG1 is within the range of the last 8 reported LRBGs.

test_cases.title: Rejection of trackside data referring to the 9th last reported LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established. The OBU has reported 9 distinct LRBG compliant balise groups to the RBC in sequence: BG1, BG2, BG3, BG4, BG5, BG6, BG7, BG8, BG9. BG9 is the current LRBGONB. The train is currently located after BG9.
test_cases.assumptions: The minimum number of LRBGs to be accepted is 8, as per SUBSET-026 §3.6.2.2.2 c).

steps.action: The RBC sends a message containing trackside information that refers to BG1 (the 9th last reported LRBG).
steps.expected: The OBU does not accept the information, as BG1 is outside the range of the last 8 reported LRBGs.

test_cases.title: Position reporting with unknown LRBG when position is unknown
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established. The train position is unknown (e.g., after a power cycle without position recovery or loss of position data).

steps.action: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.
steps.expected: The position report contains an LRBG identifier set to 'unknown'.

steps.action: The train passes a balise group (BG10) that is LRBG compliant (linked and announced in linking, or not marked as unlinked depending on configuration).
steps.expected: The OBU updates its LRBGONB to BG10.

steps.action: The OBU sends the next position report to the RBC.
steps.expected: The position report refers to BG10 as the LRBGONB.

test_cases.title: OBU takes into account information valid for the current train orientation
test_cases.preconditions: Train is moving in a mode where orientation is defined (e.g., FS). Train orientation is set to Nominal. A balise group is passed in the Nominal direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise message containing a text message or order, with validity direction set to 'Nominal'.

steps.action: Train passes a balise group in the Nominal direction while train orientation is Nominal. The balise transmits information valid for the Nominal direction.
steps.expected: The OBU takes the information into account (e.g., displays the text message or executes the order).

test_cases.title: OBU ignores information valid for the opposite direction to train orientation
test_cases.preconditions: Train is moving in a mode where orientation is defined (e.g., FS). Train orientation is set to Nominal. A balise group is passed in the Nominal direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise message containing a text message or order, with validity direction set to 'Reverse'.

steps.action: Train passes a balise group in the Nominal direction while train orientation is Nominal. The balise transmits information valid for the Reverse direction.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the information (the text message is not displayed and the order is not executed).

test_cases.title: OBU takes into account information valid for both directions
test_cases.preconditions: Train is moving in a mode where orientation is defined (e.g., FS). Train orientation is set to Nominal. A balise group is passed in the Nominal direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise message containing a text message or order, with validity direction set to 'Both'.

steps.action: Train passes a balise group in the Nominal direction while train orientation is Nominal. The balise transmits information valid for Both directions.
steps.expected: The OBU takes the information into account.

test_cases.title: OBU rejects one-direction data when train orientation cannot be related to trackside direction
test_cases.preconditions: Train orientation cannot be related to the direction of the trackside device (e.g., no coordinate system assigned to the balise group). Train is passing a balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise message containing data, with validity direction set to 'Nominal' (one direction only).

steps.action: Train passes a balise group where the orientation cannot be related to the trackside direction. The balise transmits data valid for one direction only (Nominal).
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the data.

test_cases.title: OBU evaluates data valid for both directions when train orientation cannot be related to trackside direction
test_cases.preconditions: Train orientation cannot be related to the direction of the trackside device (e.g., no coordinate system assigned to the balise group). Train is passing a balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise message containing data, with validity direction set to 'Both'.

steps.action: Train passes a balise group where the orientation cannot be related to the trackside direction. The balise transmits data valid for Both directions.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the data (takes it into account).

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data: Value n applies over distance n+1
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where continuous profile data is processed. Previously received profile data is stored.
test_cases.test_inputs: Continuous profile data structure: Value(1) = Speed Limit A, Distance(2) = 100m, Value(2) = Speed Limit B, Distance(3) = 200m.

steps.action: OBU receives continuous profile data with Value(1) and Distance(2).
steps.expected: The OBU applies Value(1) for the distance defined by Distance(2) (100m) starting from the reference point.

steps.action: OBU receives the next part of the profile with Value(2) and Distance(3).
steps.expected: The OBU applies Value(2) for the distance defined by Distance(3) (200m) starting from the end of the previous segment.

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data: Previously received data applies over the first distance
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has previously received profile data with Value(0) = Speed Limit X. New profile data is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: New continuous profile data: Value(1) = Speed Limit Y, Distance(1) = 50m (implicit first distance from previous reference).

steps.action: OBU receives new continuous profile data where the first distance is defined relative to the previous reference.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the previously received data (Value(0)) for the first distance segment until the new Value(1) becomes valid.

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data: Last value applies without limit unless end-of-profile
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is processing continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Continuous profile data ending with Value(n) = Speed Limit Z, not marked as end-of-profile.

steps.action: OBU receives the last value of a continuous profile that is not an end-of-profile value.
steps.expected: The OBU applies Value(n) for an unlimited distance beyond the last defined segment.

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data: Value followed by zero distance is taken into account
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is processing continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Continuous profile data: Value(1) = Speed Limit A, Distance(2) = 0m, Value(2) = Speed Limit B.

steps.action: OBU receives profile data where Distance(2) is 0.
steps.expected: The OBU still takes Value(1) into account (it is not ignored due to the zero distance).

test_cases.title: Location data: Distances are unsigned increments
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is processing location data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location data structure with Value(1), Distance(2) = 10m, Value(2), Distance(3) = 20m.

steps.action: OBU receives location data with incremental distances.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets Distance(2) as the distance between Value(1) and Value(2), and Distance(3) as the distance between Value(2) and Value(3).

test_cases.title: Location data: Previously received data remains in use over the first distance
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has previously received location data. New location data is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: New location data with a first distance segment.

steps.action: OBU receives new location data.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the previously received location data for the first distance segment.

test_cases.title: Non-continuous profile data: Elements defined by value and length
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is processing non-continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Non-continuous profile data: Element 1 (Value A, Length 100m), Distance to Element 2 = 50m, Element 2 (Value B, Length 200m).

steps.action: OBU receives non-continuous profile data with multiple elements.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets the data as a set of elements, where each element has a value and a length.

test_cases.title: Non-continuous profile data: Starts given by unsigned incremental distances
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is processing non-continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Non-continuous profile data with Element 1 and Element 2, where Distance to Element 2 is 50m from the start of Element 1.

steps.action: OBU receives non-continuous profile data with incremental distances between element starts.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the start of Element 2 as 50m from the start of Element 1.

test_cases.title: Non-continuous profile data: Elements may overlap
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is processing non-continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Non-continuous profile data: Element 1 (Length 100m), Distance to Element 2 = 50m, Element 2 (Length 100m).

steps.action: OBU receives non-continuous profile data where the start of Element 2 is within the length of Element 1.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the data and processes the overlapping elements according to the specification.

test_cases.title: Linking information: First distance is to the first announced balise group
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is processing linking information.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information: Distance(1) = 100m, Value(1) = Linking Data for BG1.

steps.action: OBU receives linking information with a first distance and value.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets Distance(1) as the distance to the first announced balise group (BG1) and Value(1) as the linking data for BG1.

test_cases.title: Linking information: Further distances are between consecutive announced balise groups
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is processing linking information with multiple balise groups.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information: Distance(1) = 100m, Value(1) = BG1, Distance(2) = 50m, Value(2) = BG2.

steps.action: OBU receives linking information with multiple distances and values.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets Distance(2) as the distance between BG1 and BG2, and Value(2) as the linking data for BG2.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy taken from linking information
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is checked. Linking information containing a location accuracy value for Balise Group BG1 is stored. The train is approaching BG1.

steps.action: The train passes Balise Group BG1, which becomes the LRBG.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the location accuracy value provided in the linking information for BG1.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from National Value when linking is unavailable
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is checked. No linking information containing location accuracy for Balise Group BG2 is available. A National Value for location accuracy is applicable for the current location.

steps.action: The train passes Balise Group BG2, which becomes the LRBG.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the applicable National Value for the location accuracy of BG2.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from Default Value when no National Value applies
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is checked. No linking information containing location accuracy for Balise Group BG3 is available. No National Value for location accuracy is applicable for the current location.

steps.action: The train passes Balise Group BG3, which becomes the LRBG.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the Default Value for the location accuracy of BG3.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy not updated upon receipt of further linking information
test_cases.preconditions: The location accuracy of Balise Group BG1 has been determined from linking information. The train has passed BG1 and BG1 is the current LRBG.

steps.action: New linking information is received that contains a different location accuracy value for BG1.
steps.expected: The OBU does not update the location accuracy of BG1; it retains the previously determined value.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy not updated when linking is no longer checked
test_cases.preconditions: The location accuracy of Balise Group BG1 has been determined. Linking consistency is currently checked.

steps.action: The system state changes such that linking consistency is no longer checked.
steps.expected: The OBU does not update the location accuracy of BG1; it retains the previously determined value.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy not updated when new National Values become applicable
test_cases.preconditions: The location accuracy of Balise Group BG1 has been determined. The train is moving into an area where a new National Value for location accuracy becomes applicable.

steps.action: The train enters the area where the new National Value applies.
steps.expected: The OBU does not update the location accuracy of BG1; it retains the previously determined value.

test_cases.title: Confidence interval delimitation with min and max safe front ends
test_cases.preconditions: The train is moving. The location accuracy of the reference balise group, over-reading amount, and under-reading amount are known. No consist-length-related situation applies.

steps.action: The OBU calculates the train front end position confidence interval.
steps.expected: The OBU delimits the confidence interval with a min safe front end in rear of the estimated front end and a max safe front end in advance of the estimated front end, using the sum of location accuracy, over-reading, and under-reading amounts.

test_cases.title: SOLR selection while linking consistency is checked
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is checked. The train has passed Balise Group BG1 (referenced in linking info) and then Balise Group BG2 (announced in linking info).

steps.action: The train passes Balise Group BG2.
steps.expected: The OBU sets BG2 as the Single On-board Location Reference (SOLR) because it is the most recently received balise group announced in linking information.

test_cases.title: SOLR selection while linking consistency is not checked
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is not checked. The train has passed Balise Group BG1 and then Balise Group BG2.

steps.action: The train passes Balise Group BG2.
steps.expected: The OBU sets BG2 as the Single On-board Location Reference (SOLR) because it is the last received balise group.

test_cases.title: Linking replacement rule applied before SOLR update
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU receives new linking information that affects the current SOLR.

steps.action: The OBU processes the received linking information.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the linking replacement rule before updating the SOLR.

test_cases.title: Relocation before replacement rule for non-linking information
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU receives location-based information (e.g., MA) referred to a balise group different from the current SOLR.

steps.action: The OBU processes the received location-based information.
steps.expected: The OBU relocates the information to the SOLR before applying the corresponding replacement rule.

test_cases.title: Processing location based information into min, estimated, and max items
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU receives location-based information that requires processing into multiple location items.

steps.action: The OBU processes the location-based information.
steps.expected: The OBU creates up to three location items: 'min', 'estimated', and 'max', and applies the clauses associated with each type as per SUBSET-026 Table 2a.

test_cases.title: Relocation of location items to SOLR using linking information
test_cases.preconditions: A balise group becomes the SOLR. Location-based information is referred to a former reference balise group (FRBG). Linking information is available and known for the distance between FRBG and SOLR.

steps.action: The OBU evaluates the location-based information.
steps.expected: The OBU relocates each location item to the SOLR by subtracting the distance between FRBG and SOLR retrieved from linking information, with appropriate adjustments for 'min' and 'max' items.

test_cases.title: Relocation of location items to SOLR using travelled distance
test_cases.preconditions: A balise group becomes the SOLR. Location-based information is referred to a former reference balise group (FRBG). Linking information is not available or known for the distance between FRBG and SOLR.

steps.action: The OBU evaluates the location-based information.
steps.expected: The OBU relocates each location item to the SOLR by subtracting the estimated, min, or max travelled distance between FRBG and SOLR, computed from train front end positions.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by reaching standstill
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train moving, position report parameters stored.

steps.action: The train decelerates and reaches standstill (speed 0 km/h).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by leaving standstill
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train at standstill, position report parameters stored.

steps.action: The train accelerates from standstill to a speed greater than 0 km/h.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by mode change
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train in Full Supervision (FS) mode, position report parameters stored.

steps.action: A mode change occurs (e.g., from FS to On Sight due to loss of MA).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by level change
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train in a valid mode, position report parameters stored.

steps.action: The level changes (e.g., from Level 2 to Level 1).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by driver confirming train integrity
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'No integrity information' or 'Confirmed by external source', position report parameters stored.

steps.action: The driver confirms train integrity via the DMI.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by loss of train integrity
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'Confirmed by driver' or 'Confirmed by external source', position report parameters stored.

steps.action: A loss of train integrity is detected (e.g., brake pipe pressure drop).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by successful session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, no communication session established, RBC contact information available.

steps.action: A communication session with the RBC is successfully established.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by passing LRBG without stored parameters
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, no position report parameters stored on-board.

steps.action: The train passes an LRBG compliant balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by crossing RBC/RBC border with min safe rear end
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train approaching an RBC/RBC border, position report parameters stored.

steps.action: The train's min safe rear end crosses the RBC/RBC border.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by crossing RBC/RBC border with max safe front end
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train approaching an RBC/RBC border, position report parameters stored.

steps.action: The train's max safe front end crosses the RBC/RBC border.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by level transition border crossing (L2 to L0/NTC/1)
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train approaching a level transition border leading to Level 0, NTC or 1, position report parameters stored.

steps.action: The train's min safe rear end crosses the level transition border.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by error detection
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, position report parameters stored.

steps.action: An error as defined in SUBSET-026 §3.16.4 is detected.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Reporting train integrity status 'No integrity information'
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'No integrity information'.

steps.action: A position report is sent to the RBC (e.g., due to reaching standstill).
steps.expected: The position report contains the train integrity status 'No integrity information' and does not contain a confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Reporting train integrity status 'Confirmed by driver' with length
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'Confirmed by driver', valid train length available.

steps.action: A position report is sent to the RBC (e.g., due to reaching standstill).
steps.expected: The position report contains the train integrity status 'Confirmed by driver' and the confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Reporting train integrity status 'Confirmed by external source' with length
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'Confirmed by external source', valid train length available.

steps.action: A position report is sent to the RBC (e.g., due to reaching standstill).
steps.expected: The position report contains the train integrity status 'Confirmed by external source' and the confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Reporting train integrity status 'Lost' without length
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'Lost'.

steps.action: A position report is sent to the RBC (e.g., due to reaching standstill).
steps.expected: The position report contains the train integrity status 'Lost' and does not contain a confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'No integrity information' to 'Confirmed by driver'
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'No integrity information', valid train position and length available.

steps.action: The driver confirms train integrity.
steps.expected: The train integrity status changes to 'Confirmed by driver'.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'Confirmed by driver' to 'Lost'
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'Confirmed by driver'.

steps.action: A loss of train integrity is detected.
steps.expected: The train integrity status changes to 'Lost'.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'Lost' to 'No integrity information'
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'Lost'.

steps.action: The conditions for 'Lost' are no longer met and no new confirmation is received (e.g., after a reset or specific timeout defined in Table 2c).
steps.expected: The train integrity status changes to 'No integrity information'.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'No integrity information' to 'Confirmed by external source'
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'No integrity information', valid train position and length available.

steps.action: An external source confirms train integrity.
steps.expected: The train integrity status changes to 'Confirmed by external source'.

test_cases.title: Geographical position display on driver request
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has valid geographical position information stored (e.g., from a balise group). The train is moving. The geographical position display is currently not active.

steps.action: Verify the DMI status before the request.
steps.expected: The geographical position is not displayed on the DMI.

steps.action: The driver requests the geographical position display via the DMI.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the geographical position of the train's estimated front end in relation to the track kilometre.

test_cases.title: Stopping geographical position display on driver request
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has valid geographical position information stored. The geographical position display is currently active on the DMI.

steps.action: Verify the DMI status before the request.
steps.expected: The geographical position is displayed on the DMI.

steps.action: The driver requests to stop the geographical position display via the DMI.
steps.expected: The OBU stops displaying the geographical position on the DMI.

test_cases.title: Geographical position calculation includes distance travelled
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has stored geographical position information from a reference balise group with a known track kilometre reference and offset. The train is moving in the direction of the track kilometre counting.
test_cases.assumptions: The odometer is functioning correctly and the distance travelled is measurable.

steps.action: Record the initial geographical position displayed (or calculated) immediately after passing the reference balise group, accounting for the offset.
steps.expected: The initial position corresponds to the track kilometre reference value adjusted by the offset.

steps.action: Move the train a known distance D (e.g., 100 meters) in the direction of the track kilometre counting.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the new geographical position by adding the distance D to the previous position.

steps.action: Request the geographical position display on the DMI.
steps.expected: The displayed track kilometre value is equal to the initial value plus D.

test_cases.title: Roll-away distance supervision start and remaining distance calculation
test_cases.preconditions: Train is at standstill in a mode where Roll Away Protection is active (e.g., FS or OS). The National Value for maximum roll-away distance is set to 10 m. The train is not in a balise group location that would trigger other specific location-based supervisions.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU logs or exposes the 'remaining distance' value for test observation. The odometer reading is accurate (0 error) for this test.

steps.action: Initiate the Roll Away Protection supervision (e.g., by entering a standstill state where this protection is active).
steps.expected: The OBU calculates and stores the remaining distance to be travelled as 10 m (the National Value).

steps.action: Move the train forward by 3 m (simulated via odometer input).
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance to 7 m (10 m - 3 m).

steps.action: Move the train forward by another 7 m (total 10 m).
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance to 0 m.

test_cases.title: Post Trip reversing distance supervision start
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Post Trip (PT) mode. The National Value for maximum reversing distance is set to 50 m. The train is at standstill.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU logs or exposes the 'remaining distance' value for test observation.

steps.action: Initiate the reversing supervision in Post Trip mode.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates and stores the remaining distance to be travelled as 50 m.

steps.action: Move the train in the reverse direction by 20 m.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance to 30 m (50 m - 20 m).

test_cases.title: Staff Responsible distance supervision with virtual train front position
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Staff Responsible (SR) mode. The maximum permitted distance to run is set to 1000 m (via RBC or National Value). The train is at standstill. Odometer under-reading is 0 m, over-reading is 0 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU logs or exposes the 'remaining distance' for estimated, max safe, and min safe front ends. The virtual train front position is created at the start of supervision.

steps.action: Initiate the Staff Responsible distance supervision.
steps.expected: The OBU creates a virtual train front position. The remaining distance for the estimated front end is 1000 m. The remaining distance for the max safe front end is 1000 m. The remaining distance for the min safe front end is 1000 m.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 100 m. Simulate an odometer under-reading of 5 m (actual distance 100 m, odometer reads 95 m) and over-reading of 5 m (actual distance 100 m, odometer reads 105 m).
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distances based on the virtual train front position logic: Estimated front end remaining distance is 900 m (1000 - 100). Max safe front end remaining distance is 905 m (1000 - 100 + 5, accounting for under-reading making the max safe position further ahead). Min safe front end remaining distance is 895 m (1000 - 100 - 5, accounting for over-reading making the min safe position further behind).

test_cases.title: Staff Responsible distance supervision restart upon update
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Staff Responsible (SR) mode. Initial maximum permitted distance is 1000 m. The train has moved 200 m. Odometer errors are 0 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU logs or exposes the 'remaining distance' value for test observation.

steps.action: Initiate the Staff Responsible distance supervision with 1000 m limit. Move the train 200 m.
steps.expected: The remaining distance is 800 m.

steps.action: Receive an update from the RBC setting the maximum permitted distance to 500 m.
steps.expected: The OBU deletes the previous virtual train position and creates a new one. The remaining distance is recalculated as 500 m (new limit) minus 0 m (distance travelled since restart), resulting in 500 m.

test_cases.title: Trip suppression distance supervision after Override
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Stand By (SB) or Post Trip (PT) mode. Override function is triggered. The National Value for trip suppression distance is 50 m. The train is at standstill.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU logs or exposes the 'remaining distance' value for test observation.

steps.action: Trigger the Override function.
steps.expected: The OBU starts the trip suppression distance supervision. The remaining distance is calculated as 50 m.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 10 m.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance to 40 m (50 m - 10 m).

test_cases.title: MA rejection when SSP/gradient does not cover full length (Non-infill MA)
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, train in FS mode. A valid MA is received via RBC. The MA is a non-infill MA. The SSP and gradient data provided with the MA (or already on board) end before the Supervised Location (SvL) of the MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with EOA at 1000m, SvL at 1000m. SSP/Gradient data available only up to 800m from train front.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'full length' for a non-infill MA is defined as at least from the estimated front end of the train to the supervised location.

steps.action: Receive an MA where the SSP and gradient data do not cover the distance from the estimated train front end to the Supervised Location.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the MA and the related mode profile (if any). The previous MA remains valid and supervision continues based on the previous MA.

test_cases.title: MA rejection when SSP/gradient does not cover full length (Infill MA)
test_cases.preconditions: Level 1, train in FS mode. A new MA is received via infill (balise). The MA is an infill MA. The SSP and gradient data provided with the MA (or already on board) do not cover the distance from the infill location reference to the Supervised Location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA with infill reference at 0m (current position), SvL at 500m. SSP/Gradient data available only up to 300m from the infill reference.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'full length' for an infill MA is defined as at least from the infill location reference to the supervised location.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA where the SSP and gradient data do not cover the distance from the infill location reference to the Supervised Location.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the MA and the related mode profile (if any). The previous MA remains valid.

test_cases.title: MA rejection when SSP/gradient does not cover full length (Supervised Manoeuvre, opposite orientation)
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, train in FS mode. A Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation is received. The validity direction of the MA is opposite to the current train orientation. The SSP and gradient data do not cover the distance from the estimated front end of the train derived from the new train orientation to the Supervised Location.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with opposite orientation. New train front end estimated at 0m (relative to new orientation). SvL at 200m. SSP/Gradient data available only up to 100m from the new front end.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'full length' for this case is defined as at least from the estimated front end of the train derived from the new train orientation to the supervised location.

steps.action: Receive an MA for a Supervised Manoeuvre with opposite orientation where the SSP and gradient data do not cover the distance from the estimated front end (new orientation) to the Supervised Location.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the MA and the related mode profile (if any). The previous MA remains valid.

test_cases.title: MA acceptance when SSP/gradient covers full length
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, train in FS mode. A valid MA is received via RBC. The MA is a non-infill MA. The SSP and gradient data provided with the MA (or already on board) cover the distance from the estimated front end of the train to the Supervised Location.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with EOA at 1000m, SvL at 1000m. SSP/Gradient data available up to 1200m from train front.

steps.action: Receive an MA where the SSP and gradient data cover the full length from the estimated train front end to the Supervised Location.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the MA and the related mode profile (if any). The new MA becomes the active MA for supervision.

test_cases.title: Replacement of route suitability loading gauge information
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where location based information is stored (e.g., Full Supervision). Existing route suitability loading gauge information is stored for a specific track section.
test_cases.test_inputs: New track description message containing route suitability loading gauge information for the same track section.

steps.action: Receive a new track description message containing route suitability loading gauge information.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces all previously stored route suitability loading gauge information with the new information.

steps.action: Query the stored route suitability loading gauge information.
steps.expected: Only the new loading gauge information is present; the old information is no longer stored.

test_cases.title: Replacement of adhesion factor information from start location
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has stored adhesion factor information for a track section starting at location L1 and ending at L2. The train is located before L1.
test_cases.test_inputs: New track description message containing adhesion factor information starting at location L3 (where L1 < L3 < L2).

steps.action: Receive a new track description message containing adhesion factor information starting at location L3.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the stored adhesion factor information from location L3 onwards. The adhesion factor information between L1 and L3 remains unchanged.

steps.action: Query the stored adhesion factor information for the section between L1 and L3.
steps.expected: The original adhesion factor information is still stored for this section.

steps.action: Query the stored adhesion factor information for the section from L3 onwards.
steps.expected: The new adhesion factor information is stored for this section.

test_cases.title: Replacement of linking information (non-infill) from reference balise group
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has stored linking information with a reference balise group BG1. The train is located before BG1.
