steps.expected: İşlem engellenmez; yeniden kimlik doğrulama isteği yapılmaz ve başvuru durumu görüntülenir.

test_cases.title: Tarayıcı ile portal arasındaki iletişimin şifreli ve bütünlüklü olması
test_cases.preconditions: Portal test ortamına erişilebilmekte ve ağ trafiğini yakalayabilen bir araç (ör. Wireshark veya Burp Suite) hazır bulunmaktadır.

steps.action: Tarayıcıdan portal giriş sayfasına gidilir ve ağ trafiği yakalama aracıyla istekler izlenir.
steps.expected: Tarayıcı ile sunucu arasındaki tüm iletişim HTTPS (TLS) protokolü üzerinden gerçekleşir; açık metin HTTP isteği gözlenmez.

steps.action: Giriş formuna geçerli bir kullanıcı adı ve parola girilerek gönderilir; ağ trafiği yakalama aracıyla gönderilen veri paketi incelenir.
steps.expected: Gönderilen kullanıcı adı ve parola verileri şifreli olarak iletilir; yakalanan paketlerde bu bilgiler açık metin olarak okunamaz.

steps.action: Giriş işlemi sırasında ağ trafiği yakalama aracında TLS el sıkışma (handshake) detayları kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: TLS oturumu başarıyla kurulur ve kullanılan sertifika geçerli bir CA tarafından imzalanmıştır; güvenlik uyarısı verilmez.

test_cases.title: Sunucular arası iletişimin şifreli ve bütünlüklü olması
test_cases.preconditions: Portal uygulama sunucusu ile veritabanı sunucusu (veya entegre dış servis) arasındaki ağ trafiğini izleyebilen yetkili bir test ortamı mevcuttur.
test_cases.assumptions: Sunucular arası iletişimin izlenebilmesi için ağ yakalama yetkisi bulunmaktadır.

steps.action: Portal üzerinden bir işlem (ör. başvuru oluşturma) başlatılır ve uygulama sunucusu ile veritabanı sunucusu arasındaki ağ trafiği yakalanır.
steps.expected: Sunucular arası veri aktarımı şifreli bir kanal (ör. TLS veya IPSec) üzerinden gerçekleşir; veritabanı sorguları ve iletilen veriler açık metin olarak gözlenmez.

steps.action: Yakalanan sunucular arası trafik paketleri incelenerek protokol türü kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: İletişim, gizliliği ve bütünlüğü koruyan bir şifreleme mekanizması kullanmaktadır; düz TCP/IP üzerinden açık veri akışı yoktur.

test_cases.title: Güvensiz HTTP isteğinin HTTPS'e yönlendirilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Portal test ortamına erişilebilmektedir.

steps.action: Tarayıcı adres çubuğuna portalin HTTP protokolüyle (http://) adresi yazılarak erişim denenir.
steps.expected: Tarayıcı, isteği otomatik olarak HTTPS protokolüne (https://) yönlendirir; kullanıcı açık metin HTTP üzerinden veri gönderemez.

steps.action: Yönlendirme sonrası sayfa yüklenir ve adres çubuğu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Adres çubuğunda https:// protokolü görünür ve güvenli bağlantı simgesi (kilit) mevcuttur.

test_cases.title: Geçersiz sayısal aralık girdisinin reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Sistemde sayısal aralık kısıtı olan bir form alanı (ör. 1-100 arası) mevcut bir test senaryosunda tanımlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Sayısal aralık dışı değerler (ör. 0, 101, -5).
test_cases.assumptions: Form alanının kabul edilebilir aralığı 1-100 olarak tanımlanmıştır.

steps.action: Form alanına 0 değeri girilir ve gönderim yapılır.
steps.expected: Sistem girdiyi reddeder ve geçerlilik hatası mesajı gösterir.

steps.action: Form alanına 101 değeri girilir ve gönderim yapılır.
steps.expected: Sistem girdiyi reddeder ve geçerlilik hatası mesajı gösterir.

steps.action: Form alanına -5 değeri girilir ve gönderim yapılır.
steps.expected: Sistem girdiyi reddeder ve geçerlilik hatası mesajı gösterir.

test_cases.title: Geçersiz karakter seti ve uzunluk girdisinin reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Sistemde karakter seti ve uzunluk kısıtı olan bir metin alanı (ör. sadece alfanümerik, max 50 karakter) mevcut bir test senaryosunda tanımlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçersiz karakterler içeren string, 51 karakterlik string.
test_cases.assumptions: Metin alanının kabul edilebilir karakter seti alfanümerik ve maksimum uzunluğu 50 karakterdir.

steps.action: Metin alanına geçersiz karakterler içeren bir string (ör. 'abc!@#') girilir ve gönderim yapılır.
steps.expected: Sistem girdiyi reddeder ve geçerlilik hatası mesajı gösterir.

steps.action: Metin alanına 51 karakterlik bir string girilir ve gönderim yapılır.
steps.expected: Sistem girdiyi reddeder ve geçerlilik hatası mesajı gösterir.

test_cases.title: Geçerli girdilerin kabul edilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Sistemde sayısal aralık (1-100) ve metin (alfanümerik, max 50) kısıtları olan form alanları mevcut bir test senaryosunda tanımlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli sayısal değer (50), geçerli metin değeri ('Test123').

steps.action: Sayısal alana 50 değeri, metin alanına 'Test123' değeri girilir ve gönderim yapılır.
steps.expected: Sistem girdileri kabul eder ve işlemi başarıyla tamamlar.

test_cases.title: Hata mesajlarının genel ve güvenli olması
test_cases.preconditions: Sistemde hata üretebilecek bir işlem (ör. veritabanı bağlantısı hatası veya yetkisiz erişim) tetiklenebilir durumda.
test_cases.test_inputs: Hata üreten bir istek.
test_cases.assumptions: Kullanıcı, iz kayıtlarına erişim yetkisine sahip değildir.

steps.action: Sistemde bir hata durumu (ör. beklenmeyen bir sunucu hatası) tetiklenir.
steps.expected: Kullanıcıya gösterilen hata mesajı genel bir bilgilendirme içerir (ör. 'Bir hata oluştu, lütfen daha sonra tekrar deneyin').

steps.action: Hata mesajının içeriği incelenir.
steps.expected: Mesajda veritabanı şeması, kod satırı, stack trace veya diğer teknik ayrıntılar bulunmaz.

test_cases.title: Ayrıntılı hata bilgisinin yetkili personele gösterilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: İz kayıtlarına erişim yetkisi olan bir personel hesabı mevcut. Sistemde hata üretebilecek bir işlem tetiklenebilir durumda.
test_cases.test_inputs: Hata üreten bir istek.
test_cases.assumptions: Personel hesabı, Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §11 ve §7.2 uyarınca iz kayıtlarına erişim yetkisine sahiptir.

steps.action: Sistemde bir hata durumu tetiklenir.
steps.expected: Hata kaydı iz kayıtlarına yazılır.

steps.action: Yetkili personel hesabıyla iz kayıtları incelenir.
steps.expected: Kayıtlarda hata ile ilgili ayrıntılı teknik bilgi (ör. hata kodu, stack trace) bulunur.

test_cases.title: Oturum süresi dolmadan önce uyarı gösterimi ve taslak kaydı
test_cases.preconditions: AAL2 ile oturum açmış bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı. §14'te belirlenen toplam oturum süresine yaklaşılmış durumda (örneğin 10 dakika kalmış).
test_cases.assumptions: §14'te belirlenen uyarı süresi 10 dakika olarak varsayılmıştır.

steps.action: Oturum açılışından itibaren §14'te belirlenen toplam sürenin son 10 dakikası içinde bir form sayfasında veri girilir.
steps.expected: Kullanıcıya oturum süresinin dolmak üzere olduğu ve yeniden doğrulama gerekeceği konusunda bir uyarı mesajı gösterilir.

steps.action: Uyarı gösterildikten sonra formda yeni bir alan doldurulur ve sayfa yenilenmeden beklenir.
steps.expected: Girilen veriler arka planda taslak olarak kaydedilir; sayfa yenilendiğinde veriler kaybolmaz.

test_cases.title: Oturum süresi dolunca yeniden doğrulama ve kaldığı adıma dönüş
test_cases.preconditions: AAL2 ile oturum açmış bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı. Toplam oturum süresi dolmuştur.

steps.action: Toplam oturum süresi dolduğunda korumalı bir sayfada işlem yapmaya çalışılır.
steps.expected: İşlem reddedilir ve kullanıcı yeniden kimlik doğrulama ekranına yönlendirilir.

steps.action: Yeniden kimlik doğrulama (parola ve ikinci faktör) başarıyla tamamlanır.
steps.expected: Kullanıcı, oturumun sonlandığı andan önce bulunduğu form adımına ve daha önce girdiği verilerle birlikte geri döner; veri kaybı yaşanmaz.

test_cases.title: Oturum süresinin etkinlikle uzatılamaması
test_cases.preconditions: AAL2 ile oturum açmış bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı. Toplam oturum süresi dolmak üzeredir.

steps.action: Toplam oturum süresi dolmadan hemen önce, formda sürekli veri girerek veya sayfayı yenileyerek etkinliği sürdürmeye çalışılır.
steps.expected: Toplam oturum süresi dolunca oturum sonlandırılır; etkinliğe rağmen süre uzatılmaz ve yeniden kimlik doğrulama istenir.

test_cases.title: Metin tabanlı CAPTCHA kullanılmaması
test_cases.preconditions: Giriş sayfasına erişim sağlanmıştır.

steps.action: Giriş sayfası yüklenir ve kimlik doğrulama formu incelenir.
steps.expected: Formda metin tabanlı CAPTCHA (örneğin 'a+b=?' veya 'şu kelimeyi yazın') bulunmaz.

test_cases.title: Bot doğrulama eşiği aşıldığında etkileşimsiz tarayıcı kanıtı istenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: §14'te belirlenen bot doğrulama sorgusu eşiği aşılmış bir IP adresi veya oturum durumu.
test_cases.assumptions: Bot doğrulama eşiği 5 başarısız deneme olarak varsayılmıştır.

steps.action: Bot doğrulama eşiği aşıldıktan sonra giriş denemesi yapılır.
steps.expected: Kullanıcıya metin tabanlı CAPTCHA yerine etkileşimsiz tarayıcı kanıtı (örneğin JavaScript tabanlı doğrulama) istenir.

test_cases.title: Etkileşimsiz kanıt yetmezse nesne tanıma sorgusu gösterilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Etkileşimsiz tarayıcı kanıtı başarısız olmuş veya atlanmış bir durum.

steps.action: Etkileşimsiz tarayıcı kanıtı sağlanamayan bir istekte giriş denemesi yapılır.
steps.expected: Kullanıcıya WCAG 2.2 SC 3.3.8 nesne tanıma istisnasına giren bir sorgu (örneğin 'aşağıdaki resimdeki nesneyi seçin') gösterilir; metin tabanlı CAPTCHA gösterilmez.

test_cases.title: İmzası doğrulanmayan KÖA bildiriminin reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Ödeme işlemi başlatılmış bir başvuru. KÖA'dan gelen bildirim imzası geçersiz veya eksik.

steps.action: KÖA'dan imzası doğrulanamayan bir ödeme sonucu bildirimi gönderilir.
steps.expected: Portal bildirimi reddeder; başvuru durumu 'ödendi' olarak değiştirilmez.

test_cases.title: KÖA erişilemezse başvurunun 'ödeme bekliyor' durumunda tutulması
test_cases.preconditions: Ödeme işlemi başlatılmış bir başvuru. KÖA servisi erişilemez durumda.
test_cases.assumptions: §14'te belirlenen ödeme bekleme süresi 72 saat olarak varsayılmıştır.

steps.action: KÖA erişilemezken ödeme sonucu sorgulanır.
steps.expected: Başvuru durumu 'ödeme bekliyor' olarak kalır; 'ödendi' durumuna geçmez.

steps.action: §14'te belirlenen aralıkla (15 dakikada bir) belirsiz işlem sorgusu yapılır.
steps.expected: Sistem, KÖA erişilebilir hale gelene kadar belirsiz işlemleri 15 dakikada bir sorgulamaya devam eder.

test_cases.title: AAL2 altı doğrulama düzeyinde sınırlı kip açılması
test_cases.preconditions: e-Devlet'ten gelen kimlik belirtecinde doğrulama düzeyi AAL1 olarak bildirilen bir vatandaş hesabı.

steps.action: AAL1 doğrulama düzeyiyle e-Devlet üzerinden giriş yapılır.
steps.expected: Oturum sınırlı kipte açılır; kullanıcıya daha güçlü bir yöntemle yeniden giriş önerisi gösterilir.

steps.action: Sınırlı kipte kişisel veri veya başvuru içeriği görüntülenmeye çalışılır.
steps.expected: Kişisel veri ve başvuru içeriği gösterilmez; erişim engellenir.

test_cases.title: Doğrulama düzeyi alanı yoksa sınırlı kip açılması
test_cases.preconditions: e-Devlet'ten gelen kimlik belirtecinde doğrulama düzeyi alanı eksik olan bir vatandaş hesabı.

steps.action: Doğrulama düzeyi alanı eksik bir belirteçle giriş yapılır.
steps.expected: Oturum sınırlı kipte açılır; kullanıcıya daha güçlü bir yöntemle yeniden giriş önerisi gösterilir.

test_cases.title: Şirket temsilcisi parolası için geçerlilik süresi bildirimi
test_cases.preconditions: VBP'nin doğruladığı bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı. Parola geçerlilik süresi dolmak üzeredir.
test_cases.assumptions: §14'te belirlenen bildirim süresi 30 gün önce olarak varsayılmıştır.

steps.action: Parola geçerlilik süresinin dolmasına 30 gün kala kullanıcı giriş yapar.
steps.expected: Kullanıcıya parola geçerlilik süresinin dolmak üzere olduğu ve parolayı değiştirmesi gerektiği konusunda bir bildirim gösterilir.

test_cases.title: Sızıntı eşleşmesinde parola değişikliğinin zorunlu tutulması
test_cases.preconditions: VBP'nin doğruladığı bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı. Parola, bilinen sızıntı listesinde tespit edilmiştir.

steps.action: Sızıntı listesindeki parolayla giriş yapılır.
steps.expected: Giriş reddedilir veya kabul edilse bile kullanıcıya parola değişikliği zorunlu tutulur; süre dolmadan değişiklik istenir.

test_cases.title: TOTP doğrulamasında geçerli ve bir önceki adımın kabul edilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: TOTP doğrulayıcısı bağlı bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı.
test_cases.assumptions: §14'te belirlenen adım süresi 30 saniye olarak varsayılmıştır.

steps.action: Geçerli TOTP adımı için üretilen kod girilir.
steps.expected: Doğrulama başarılı olur.

steps.action: Bir sonraki girişte, bir önceki geçerli adımın kodu girilir.
steps.expected: Doğrulama başarılı olur (bir önceki adım kabul edilir).

test_cases.title: TOTP doğrulamasında eski ve ileri adımların reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: TOTP doğrulayıcısı bağlı bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı.
test_cases.assumptions: §14'te belirlenen adım süresi 30 saniye olarak varsayılmıştır.

steps.action: İki adım öncesine ait TOTP kodu girilir.
steps.expected: Doğrulama başarısız olur; kod reddedilir.

steps.action: Bir adım ileriye ait TOTP kodu girilir.
steps.expected: Doğrulama başarısız olur; kod reddedilir.

test_cases.title: TOTP kodunun yalnızca bir kez kabul edilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: TOTP doğrulayıcısı bağlı bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı.

steps.action: Geçerli bir TOTP kodu girilerek doğrulama yapılır.
steps.expected: Doğrulama başarılı olur.

steps.action: Aynı TOTP kodu, aynı adım içinde ikinci kez girilir.
steps.expected: Doğrulama başarısız olur; kod tekrar kullanılamaz.

test_cases.title: Başarısız deneme eşiğinde doğrulayıcının devre dışı bırakılması
test_cases.preconditions: Parola ve TOTP ikinci faktörü bağlı bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı.
test_cases.assumptions: §14'te belirlenen devre dışı bırakma eşiği 5 başarısız deneme olarak varsayılmıştır.

steps.action: Yanlış parola ve yanlış TOTP koduyla 5 kez giriş denemesi yapılır.
steps.expected: 5. denemeden sonra doğrulayıcılar (parola ve TOTP) devre dışı bırakılır; kullanıcıya hesap kurtarma yönlendirmesi gösterilir.

test_cases.title: Başarılı girişte doğrulayıcı sayaçlarının sıfırlanması
test_cases.preconditions: 3 başarısız deneme yapılmış, devre dışı bırakma eşiği 5 olan bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı.

steps.action: Doğru parola ve TOTP koduyla başarılı bir giriş yapılır.
steps.expected: Giriş başarılı olur; başarısız deneme sayacı sıfırlanır.

steps.action: Ardından 4 kez yanlış giriş denemesi yapılır.
steps.expected: Doğrulayıcılar devre dışı bırakılmaz; sayaç 4'te kalır.

test_cases.title: AAL2 şirket temsilcisi için hareketsizlik sonrası parola ile devam
test_cases.preconditions: AAL2 ile oturum açmış bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı. Hareketsizlik süresi dolmuş, toplam süre dolmamış.

steps.action: Hareketsizlik süresi dolduktan sonra korumalı bir sayfada işlem yapmaya çalışılır.
steps.expected: Kullanıcıya yalnızca parola girmesi istenir; ikinci faktör istenmez.

steps.action: Doğru parola girilir.
steps.expected: Oturum devam eder; kullanıcı kaldığı yerden işlem yapabilir.

test_cases.title: AAL2 vatandaş için hareketsizlik sonrası e-Devlet yönlendirmesi
test_cases.preconditions: AAL2 ile oturum açmış bir vatandaş hesabı. Hareketsizlik süresi dolmuş, toplam süre dolmamış.

steps.action: Hareketsizlik süresi dolduktan sonra korumalı bir sayfada işlem yapmaya çalışılır.
steps.expected: Kullanıcı e-Devlet'te taze doğrulama için yönlendirilir; parola ile devam etmesine izin verilmez.

test_cases.title: AAL3 personel için hareketsizlik sonrası oturum sırrının silinmesi
test_cases.preconditions: AAL3 ile oturum açmış bir personel hesabı. Hareketsizlik süresi dolmuş.

steps.action: Hareketsizlik süresi dolduktan sonra korumalı bir sayfada işlem yapmaya çalışılır.
steps.expected: Oturum sırrı sunucudan silinmiştir; kullanıcıya tam AAL3 kimlik doğrulama (FIDO2 ve PIN) istenir.

test_cases.title: Vatandaş/temsilci için eşzamanlı oturum sınırının aşılması
test_cases.preconditions: 3 etkin oturumu olan bir vatandaş veya şirket temsilcisi hesabı.
test_cases.assumptions: §14'te belirlenen eşzamanlı oturum sınırı 3 olarak varsayılmıştır.

steps.action: 4. oturum açma denemesi yapılır.
steps.expected: En eski oturum sonlandırılır; yeni oturum açılır.

steps.action: En eski oturumun sonlandırıldığına dair bildirim kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Kullanıcıya en eski oturumun sonlandırıldığı bildirilir.

test_cases.title: Personel/sistem yöneticisi için eşzamanlı oturum sınırının aşılması
test_cases.preconditions: 1 etkin oturumu olan bir personel veya sistem yöneticisi hesabı.
test_cases.assumptions: §14'te belirlenen personel eşzamanlı oturum sınırı 1 olarak varsayılmıştır.

steps.action: 2. oturum açma denemesi yapılır.
steps.expected: Yeni oturum açılır; eski oturum sonlandırılır.

steps.action: SIEM kayıtları incelenir.
steps.expected: Oturum sınır aşımı olayı SIEM'e iletilmiştir.

test_cases.title: İzin verilmeyen dosya türünün reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Başvuru formunda dosya yükleme alanı mevcut.
test_cases.assumptions: §14'te izin verilen dosya türleri PDF, JPG, PNG olarak varsayılmıştır.

steps.action: İzin verilmeyen bir dosya türü (örneğin .exe) yüklenmeye çalışılır.
steps.expected: Yükleme reddedilir; ret nedeni dosya adıyla birlikte metin olarak bildirilir.

test_cases.title: Uzantı ile içerik imzasının uyuşmaması
test_cases.preconditions: Başvuru formunda dosya yükleme alanı mevcut.

steps.action: İçeriği .exe olan ancak uzantısı .pdf olarak değiştirilmiş bir dosya yüklenmeye çalışılır.
steps.expected: Yükleme reddedilir; ret nedeni dosya adıyla birlikte metin olarak bildirilir.

test_cases.title: Dosya boyut sınırının aşılması
test_cases.preconditions: Başvuru formunda dosya yükleme alanı mevcut.
test_cases.assumptions: §14'te belirlenen dosya boyut sınırı 10 MB olarak varsayılmıştır.

steps.action: 10 MB'dan büyük bir dosya (örneğin 11 MB) yüklenmeye çalışılır.
steps.expected: Yükleme reddedilir; ret nedeni dosya adıyla birlikte metin olarak bildirilir.

test_cases.title: Start of Mission in Level 2 triggers session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Level 2. No communication session is established. Safe radio connection is not set up.

steps.action: Perform Start of Mission procedure in Level 2.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the establishment of a communication session (requests safe radio connection set-up).

test_cases.title: Trackside order triggers session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Level 2. No communication session is established. Safe radio connection is not set up.

steps.action: Receive an order from trackside to establish a communication session.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the establishment of a communication session (requests safe radio connection set-up).

test_cases.title: Mode change to be reported to RBC triggers session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Level 2. No communication session is established. Safe radio connection is not set up. A mode change occurs that requires reporting to the RBC (not End of Mission).

steps.action: Execute a mode change that must be reported to the RBC in Level 2.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the establishment of a communication session (requests safe radio connection set-up).

test_cases.title: Manual level change to Level 2 triggers session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Level 1. No communication session is established. Safe radio connection is not set up.

steps.action: Driver manually changes the level to Level 2.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the establishment of a communication session (requests safe radio connection set-up).

test_cases.title: Engine rear end reaching end of announced radio hole triggers session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Level 2. A radio hole has been announced. The engine rear end is approaching the end of the radio hole. No communication session is established.

steps.action: Move the train so that the engine rear end reaches the end of the announced radio hole.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the establishment of a communication session (requests safe radio connection set-up).

test_cases.title: Previous session terminated due to loss of safe radio connection triggers new session
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Level 2. A communication session was previously established but is considered terminated due to loss of safe radio connection.

steps.action: Wait for the condition where the previous session is considered terminated due to loss of safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the establishment of a new communication session (requests safe radio connection set-up).

test_cases.title: Driver manually selecting RBC contact information outside Start of Mission triggers session
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Level 2. Outside Start of Mission procedure. No communication session is established.

steps.action: Driver manually selects RBC contact information.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the establishment of a communication session (requests safe radio connection set-up).

test_cases.title: Successful session establishment sequence
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Level 2. Trigger for session establishment is active. Safe radio connection can be set up.

steps.action: Trigger session establishment.
steps.expected: OBU requests set-up of safe radio connection.

steps.action: Safe radio connection is successfully set up.
steps.expected: OBU sends Initiation of communication session message.

steps.action: OBU receives system version message from trackside.
steps.expected: OBU considers the session established and sends a session established report.

test_cases.title: Session establishment with incompatible system version
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Level 2. Trigger for session establishment is active. Safe radio connection can be set up. Trackside sends an incompatible system version.

steps.action: Trigger session establishment and complete safe radio connection set-up.
steps.expected: OBU sends Initiation of communication session message.

steps.action: OBU receives system version message indicating no compatible version.
steps.expected: OBU sends 'No compatible version supported' message, informs the driver, and terminates the session.

test_cases.title: Retry on safe radio connection failure during Start of Mission
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Level 2. Start of Mission procedure is active. First attempt to set up safe radio connection fails.

steps.action: Trigger session establishment during Start of Mission.
steps.expected: OBU requests set-up of safe radio connection.

steps.action: First request for safe radio connection fails.
steps.expected: OBU immediately repeats the request for safe radio connection set-up.

test_cases.title: Radio system selection based on trackside order (FRMCS-only RBC)
test_cases.preconditions: Both FRMCS and GSM-R radio systems are fitted. Trackside order to establish session with an RBC interfaced with FRMCS only.

steps.action: Receive trackside order to establish session with FRMCS-only RBC.
steps.expected: OBU requests set-up of safe radio connection using FRMCS.

test_cases.title: Radio system selection based on driver's single-radio choice
test_cases.preconditions: Both FRMCS and GSM-R radio systems are fitted. Stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. During Start of Mission, driver elected to use only GSM-R. No trackside order specifying radio system.

steps.action: Trigger session establishment (e.g., mode change report).
steps.expected: OBU requests set-up of safe radio connection using GSM-R.

test_cases.title: Radio system selection based on stored Radio Network information
test_cases.preconditions: Both FRMCS and GSM-R radio systems are fitted. Stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. No trackside order specifying radio system. No driver single-radio choice. Preferred radio system from previous session is FRMCS.

steps.action: Trigger session establishment.
steps.expected: OBU requests set-up of safe radio connection using FRMCS (preferred radio system).

test_cases.title: Memorisation of radio system used for successful connection
test_cases.preconditions: Both FRMCS and GSM-R radio systems are fitted. Session establishment is triggered. GSM-R is selected and successfully sets up safe radio connection.

steps.action: Complete session establishment using GSM-R.
steps.expected: OBU stores GSM-R as the radio system used for the successful safe radio connection set-up.

test_cases.title: Abort session establishment on desk closure during Start of Mission
test_cases.preconditions: Session establishment is in progress (safe radio connection requested, not yet established). Start of Mission is active.

steps.action: Driver closes the desk during Start of Mission while session establishment is in progress.
steps.expected: OBU aborts the session establishment process and releases the safe radio connection (if any).

test_cases.title: Abort session establishment on End of Mission
test_cases.preconditions: Session establishment is in progress (safe radio connection requested, not yet established).

steps.action: End of Mission is performed while session establishment is in progress.
steps.expected: OBU aborts the session establishment process and releases the safe radio connection (if any).

test_cases.title: Abort session establishment on trackside termination order
test_cases.preconditions: Session establishment is in progress (safe radio connection requested, not yet established).

steps.action: Receive an order from trackside to terminate the communication session while session establishment is in progress.
steps.expected: OBU aborts the session establishment process and releases the safe radio connection (if any).

test_cases.title: Abort session establishment on passing Level 2 exit border
test_cases.preconditions: Session establishment is in progress (safe radio connection requested, not yet established). Train is in Level 2 area.

steps.action: Train passes with its min safe rear end a level transition border from a Level 2 area to an area where Level 2 operation is not supported.
steps.expected: OBU aborts the session establishment process and releases the safe radio connection (if any).

test_cases.title: Abort session establishment on passing RBC/RBC border
test_cases.preconditions: Session establishment is in progress (safe radio connection requested, not yet established). Train is approaching an RBC/RBC border.

steps.action: Train passes an RBC/RBC border with its min safe rear end.
steps.expected: OBU aborts the session establishment process and releases the safe radio connection (if any).

test_cases.title: Use stored RBC contact information for 'last known RBC' order
test_cases.preconditions: RBC contact information is stored on board. Trackside sends order to establish session with 'last known RBC' (special RBC identity value) including a telephone number.

steps.action: Receive trackside order to establish session with 'last known RBC'.
steps.expected: OBU disregards the telephone number in the order and contacts the RBC using its stored RBC contact information.

test_cases.title: Ignore 'last known RBC' order when no contact information stored
test_cases.preconditions: No RBC contact information is stored on board. Trackside sends order to establish session with 'last known RBC' (special RBC identity value).

steps.action: Receive trackside order to establish session with 'last known RBC'.
steps.expected: OBU ignores the order and does not attempt to establish a communication session.

test_cases.title: Prevention of duplicate session establishment with the same RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2, Start of Mission is completed, and a communication session with RBC-A is currently being established (safe radio connection requested but not yet confirmed).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is capable of receiving a second trigger for session establishment while the first is in progress.

steps.action: Trigger a second session establishment request with the same RBC-A (e.g., via a mode change that requires reporting to the RBC) while the first session establishment is still in progress.
steps.expected: The OBU does not initiate a new, separate communication session establishment process with RBC-A. It continues the existing establishment process or ignores the redundant trigger.

test_cases.title: Prevention of new session while an established session is active
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2, and a communication session with RBC-A is fully established and active. No Termination of Communication Session message has been sent to RBC-A.

steps.action: Trigger a new session establishment request with the same RBC-A (e.g., via manual selection of RBC contact information for RBC-A outside Start of Mission).
steps.expected: The OBU does not open a further communication session with RBC-A. The existing session remains active and uninterrupted.

test_cases.title: Termination of existing session when establishing a new one with a different RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2, and a communication session with RBC-A is established. The OBU is capable of handling only one communication session through GSM-R.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is configured for single-session GSM-R operation.

steps.action: Receive an order from trackside to establish a communication session with a different RBC (RBC-B).
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the existing session with RBC-A (sends Termination of Communication Session) and initiates the establishment of a new session with RBC-B.

test_cases.title: Preservation of existing session during RBC transition with Accepting RBC order
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2, and a communication session with RBC-A (currently supervising) is established. The OBU is capable of handling multiple communication sessions through GSM-R.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is configured for multi-session GSM-R operation.

steps.action: Receive an RBC transition order that includes an embedded order to establish a session with an Accepting RBC (RBC-B).
steps.expected: The OBU does not terminate the existing session with RBC-A. It initiates the establishment of a new session with RBC-B while maintaining the session with RBC-A.

test_cases.title: Evaluation of information validity in Sleeping mode based on crossing direction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Sleeping (SL) mode. The train is moving in the nominal direction. A balise group is ahead in the nominal direction.
test_cases.assumptions: The balise group contains information valid only for the reverse direction.

steps.action: The train crosses the balise group in the nominal direction.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the information from the balise group because it is valid only for the opposite (reverse) direction, even though the train is in SL mode.

test_cases.title: Evaluation of information validity in Shunting mode based on crossing direction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Shunting (SH) mode. The train is moving in the reverse direction. A balise group is ahead in the reverse direction.
test_cases.assumptions: The balise group contains information valid only for the nominal direction.

steps.action: The train crosses the balise group in the reverse direction.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the information from the balise group because it is valid only for the opposite (nominal) direction, even though the train is in SH mode.

test_cases.title: Immediate MA request upon receipt of new parameters if repetition period is met
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2, communication session established. The OBU has previously received MA request parameters with a repetition period of 10 seconds. The last MA request was sent 12 seconds ago.

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from the RBC with a repetition period of 10 seconds.
steps.expected: The OBU immediately sends an MA request to the RBC because the time since the last MA request (12s) is greater than or equal to the newly received repetition period (10s).

test_cases.title: No immediate MA request upon receipt of new parameters if repetition period is not met
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2, communication session established. The OBU has previously received MA request parameters with a repetition period of 10 seconds. The last MA request was sent 5 seconds ago.

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from the RBC with a repetition period of 10 seconds.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send an immediate MA request. It waits for the new repetition period (10 seconds) to elapse from the last MA request before sending the next one.

test_cases.title: No Supervised Location defined while supervising a Limit of Authority
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2, supervising a Movement Authority that includes a Limit of Authority (LOA) with a target speed above zero. The train is approaching the LOA.

steps.action: The train enters the area where the LOA is supervised.
steps.expected: The OBU does not define any Supervised Location (SvL) on board. None of the SvL candidates (end of overlap, Danger Point, end of End Section) are used as SvL.

test_cases.title: Level 1 signalling speed restriction remains valid after switching to Level 2
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1, and a signalling related speed restriction of 50 km/h is active. The train is approaching a Level 2 area.

steps.action: The OBU switches from Level 1 to Level 2.
steps.expected: The signalling related speed restriction of 50 km/h remains valid and is applied by the OBU.

steps.action: A Level 2 Movement Authority (MA) is received and accepted by the OBU.
steps.expected: The signalling related speed restriction is no longer applied, as the Level 2 MA is now supervising the train.

test_cases.title: Maximum Train Speed defined as Static Speed Restriction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a normal operating mode. The train's actual maximum speed is 200 km/h.

steps.action: The OBU processes the train data and configuration.
steps.expected: The OBU defines the Maximum Train Speed as 200 km/h and handles this value as the Maximum Train Speed category of Static Speed Restriction (SSP).

test_cases.title: Initial state for permitted braking distance speed restrictions
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a normal operating mode. No permitted braking distance data has been received from trackside.

steps.action: The OBU initializes the speed restriction monitoring.
steps.expected: The OBU uses 'no speed restriction' as the initial state for permitted braking distance. No permitted-braking-distance limit constrains the train speed.

test_cases.title: Immediate re-establishment attempt after safe radio connection loss
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established with the trackside. The safe radio connection is active and was set up via a specific radio system (e.g., GSM-R). The train is in a supervised mode (e.g., FS).
test_cases.assumptions: The radio system used for the initial connection is available and functional for re-establishment.

steps.action: Simulate a loss of the safe radio connection (EURORADIO indicates loss) while the communication session is established.
steps.expected: The OBU immediately initiates an attempt to set up a new safe radio connection using the same radio system that was used for the previous successful connection.

test_cases.title: Repeated attempts until safe radio connection is re-established
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established. The safe radio connection is lost. The defined time for considering the session terminated has not yet elapsed. The train has not passed the termination location.
test_cases.assumptions: The radio environment allows for re-establishment after a short delay.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts attempting to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Allow the first re-establishment attempt to fail (EURORADIO indicates failure).
steps.expected: The OBU repeats the attempt to set up the safe radio connection.

steps.action: Allow the second re-establishment attempt to fail.
steps.expected: The OBU repeats the attempt to set up the safe radio connection.

steps.action: Allow the third re-establishment attempt to succeed.
steps.expected: The OBU stops repeating the attempts as the safe radio connection is now set up.

test_cases.title: Attempts stop when session is considered terminated due to timeout
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established. The safe radio connection is lost. The defined time for considering the session terminated (as per Appendix A.3.1) is known and can be monitored.
test_cases.assumptions: The defined time for session termination is short enough to be tested within a reasonable timeframe, or the system clock can be adjusted for testing purposes.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts attempting to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Ensure all re-establishment attempts fail and wait until the defined time for session termination elapses.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the session as terminated and stops repeating the attempts to set up the safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Attempts stop when train passes RIU termination location
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established with an RIU. The safe radio connection is lost. The OBU has received an RIU order to terminate the communication session at a specific location. The train is approaching that location.
test_cases.assumptions: The RIU order to terminate the session is valid and the location is reachable.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts attempting to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Move the train so that it passes the location indicated in the RIU order to terminate the communication session.
steps.expected: The OBU stops repeating the attempts to set up the safe radio connection as the train has passed the termination location.

test_cases.title: Termination initiated by trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established with the RBC. The train is in a supervised mode (e.g., FS). No termination condition defined in other sections is currently active.

steps.action: The RBC sends an order to terminate the communication session.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination of the communication session by sending the 'Termination of communication session' message.

test_cases.title: Termination initiated by internal condition without trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established with the RBC. The train is in a supervised mode (e.g., FS).
test_cases.assumptions: A specific termination condition defined in SUBSET-026 (e.g., loss of safe radio connection or specific mode transition) is triggered.

steps.action: A termination condition defined in SUBSET-026 is fulfilled without an explicit trackside order (e.g., simulate loss of safe radio connection).
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination of the communication session by sending the 'Termination of communication session' message.

test_cases.title: No termination initiated without order or condition
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established with the RBC. The train is in a stable supervised mode (e.g., FS). No trackside order to terminate is received. No internal termination condition is fulfilled.

steps.action: Wait for a duration longer than the fixed waiting time for session maintenance, ensuring no trackside order or internal condition triggers termination.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send a 'Termination of communication session' message. The session remains established.

test_cases.title: Repetition of Termination message upon missing acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established. The OBU has initiated termination and sent the 'Termination of communication session' message. The RBC is configured to not send an acknowledgement.
test_cases.assumptions: The fixed waiting time is T_wait. The defined number of repetitions is N_rep.

steps.action: The OBU sends the 'Termination of communication session' message. No acknowledgement is received within the fixed waiting time T_wait.
steps.expected: After T_wait, the OBU repeats the 'Termination of communication session' message.

steps.action: No acknowledgement is received within the fixed waiting time T_wait after the first repetition.
steps.expected: After T_wait, the OBU repeats the 'Termination of communication session' message again.

test_cases.title: Session considered terminated after max repetitions without acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session is established. The OBU has initiated termination. The RBC is configured to not send an acknowledgement.
test_cases.assumptions: The fixed waiting time is T_wait. The defined number of repetitions is N_rep (e.g., 3).

steps.action: The OBU sends the 'Termination of communication session' message and repeats it N_rep times, with no acknowledgement received within T_wait after each sending.
steps.expected: After the last repetition and the subsequent fixed waiting time T_wait elapses without an acknowledgement, the OBU considers the communication session terminated.

steps.action: Check the internal state of the OBU regarding the communication session.
steps.expected: The OBU state indicates that the communication session is terminated. No further 'Termination of communication session' messages are sent.

test_cases.title: GSM-R Mobile Terminal registration at power-up
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered off. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected and powered on. The OBU has a valid GSM-R Radio Network identity stored (either memorised or default).

steps.action: Power up the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU orders the registration of the connected GSM-R Mobile Terminal to the GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: GSM-R Mobile Terminal registration after driver enters new identity
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in a stable state. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected. The current GSM-R Radio Network identity is different from the one to be entered.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new valid GSM-R Radio Network identity.

steps.action: The driver enters a new GSM-R Radio Network identity into the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU orders the registration of the connected GSM-R Mobile Terminal to the new GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: GSM-R Mobile Terminal registration when ordered by trackside
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected but is not registered to the GSM-R Radio Network specified in the trackside order. No established communication session is using the terminal, and no safe radio connection is being set up.
test_cases.test_inputs: A Radio Network transition order from trackside specifying a GSM-R Radio Network type (GSM-R or FRMCS+GSM-R) and identity.

steps.action: The OBU receives a Radio Network transition order from trackside specifying a GSM-R Radio Network.
steps.expected: The OBU stores the Radio Network type and orders the registration of the connected GSM-R Mobile Terminal to the specified GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: Use of default Radio Network type after System Failure
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has experienced a System Failure and has no memorised Radio Network type (neither from trackside nor driver). A default Radio Network type is configured on-board.

steps.action: The OBU recovers from the System Failure and initializes its radio network management.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the default Radio Network type configured on-board for its operations.

test_cases.title: Use of default Radio Network type at very first power-up
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is at its very first power-up and has no memorised Radio Network type. A default Radio Network type is configured on-board.

steps.action: Power up the OBU for the first time.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the default Radio Network type configured on-board.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when FRMCS not registered (FRMCS only installed)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has only FRMCS on-board equipment installed (no GSM-R). The stored Radio Network type is FRMCS. The FRMCS on-board equipment is not registered to the FRMCS Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: The OBU receives a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when FRMCS not registered (FRMCS+GSM-R, both installed, no single-radio choice)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has both FRMCS and GSM-R installed. The stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. The driver has not elected to perform the mission with only one radio system. The FRMCS on-board equipment is not registered to the FRMCS Radio Network. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is duly registered to a GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: The OBU receives a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when GSM-R not registered (FRMCS+GSM-R, both installed, no single-radio choice)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has both FRMCS and GSM-R installed. The stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. The driver has not elected to perform the mission with only one radio system. The FRMCS on-board equipment is duly registered to the FRMCS Radio Network. No GSM-R Mobile Terminal is duly registered to a GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: The OBU receives a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when selected radio system not registered (single-radio choice)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has both FRMCS and GSM-R installed. The stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. The driver has elected to perform the mission with only one radio system (e.g., FRMCS). The selected FRMCS on-board equipment is no longer registered to the FRMCS Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: The OBU receives a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when GSM-R not registered (GSM-R only installed)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has only GSM-R installed (no FRMCS). The stored Radio Network type is GSM-R. No GSM-R Mobile Terminal is duly registered to a GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: The OBU receives a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request for RIU session when GSM-R not registered
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has GSM-R installed. No GSM-R Mobile Terminal is duly registered to a GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with a Radio Infill Unit (RIU).

steps.action: The OBU receives a trackside order to establish a communication session with a RIU.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Indication of 'Connection Up' status
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2, a communication session is being established with an RBC, and the safe radio connection has just been successfully set up.

steps.action: Observe the driver display for the safe radio connection status indicator.
steps.expected: The indication status displays 'Connection Up'.

test_cases.title: Indication of 'No Connection' status
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2, no communication session is established, and no safe radio connection is active.

steps.action: Observe the driver display for the safe radio connection status indicator.
steps.expected: The indication status displays 'No Connection'.

test_cases.title: Indication of 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' status
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2, a communication session was established, and the safe radio connection has been lost.

steps.action: Observe the driver display for the safe radio connection status indicator.
steps.expected: The indication status displays 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'.

test_cases.title: Start of connection status timer on first request for session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2, no communication session is established, and the connection status timer is not running.
test_cases.assumptions: The internal state of the connection status timer is observable via test instrumentation or logs.

steps.action: Trigger a session establishment (e.g., Start of Mission) causing the OBU to send the first request to set up a safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The connection status timer starts immediately upon sending the first request.

test_cases.title: Start of connection status timer on first request for session maintenance
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2, a communication session is established, the safe radio connection is lost, and the connection status timer is not running.
test_cases.assumptions: The internal state of the connection status timer is observable via test instrumentation or logs.

steps.action: The OBU sends the first request to set up a new safe radio connection to maintain the session.
steps.expected: The connection status timer starts immediately upon sending the first request.

test_cases.title: Transition from No Connection to Connection Up
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2, the indication status is 'No Connection', and a request to set up a safe radio connection is in progress.

steps.action: The safe radio connection is successfully set up (Condition [4] met).
steps.expected: The indication status transitions from 'No Connection' to 'Connection Up'.

test_cases.title: Transition from Connection Up to Connection Lost/Set-Up failed
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2, the indication status is 'Connection Up', and the connection status timer is running.

steps.action: The safe radio connection is lost and the requests to set up a safe radio connection are stopped for a reason other than successful set-up (Condition [6] met).
steps.expected: The indication status transitions from 'Connection Up' to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'.

test_cases.title: Transition from Connection Lost/Set-Up failed to No Connection
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2, the indication status is 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed', and no Start of Mission procedure is ongoing.

steps.action: The requests to set up a safe radio connection are stopped for a reason other than successful set-up (Condition [3] met).
steps.expected: The indication status transitions from 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' to 'No Connection'.

test_cases.title: Indication of RIU connection status for current infill area
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1, has safe radio connections with multiple RIUs, and is currently located in a specific infill area.

steps.action: Observe the driver display for the safe radio connection status indicator while the train is in the current infill area.
steps.expected: The indication status reflects the safe radio connection status with the RIU of the current infill area, not other RIUs.

test_cases.title: Valid position stored after passing LRBG with invalid position
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where train position is monitored. The current train position status is 'invalid'. An LRBG is available ahead of the train.

steps.action: Verify the current train position status is 'invalid'.
steps.expected: The OBU reports the train position status as 'invalid'.

steps.action: Move the train to pass the LRBG.
steps.expected: The OBU regards a valid train position as stored on board. The train position status changes to 'valid'.

steps.action: Check the internal state for any previously stored invalid train position.
steps.expected: The previously stored invalid train position is deleted.

test_cases.title: Valid position stored after passing ORBG with unknown position
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where train position is monitored. The current train position status is 'unknown'. An ORBG is available ahead of the train.

steps.action: Verify the current train position status is 'unknown'.
steps.expected: The OBU reports the train position status as 'unknown'.

steps.action: Move the train to pass the ORBG.
steps.expected: The OBU regards a valid train position as stored on board. The train position status changes to 'valid'.

steps.action: Check the internal state for any previously stored invalid train position.
steps.expected: Any previously stored invalid train position is deleted.

test_cases.title: Train orientation defined by active cab
test_cases.preconditions: The train has two cabs. Cab A is active. Cab B is inactive.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the current train orientation definition.
steps.expected: The OBU defines the front of the train as the side of Cab A (the active cab).

test_cases.title: Train orientation defined by last active cab when no cab is active
test_cases.preconditions: The train has two cabs. Cab A was the last active cab. Both Cab A and Cab B are now inactive.

steps.action: Deactivate the last active cab (Cab A) so that no cab is active.
steps.expected: The OBU retains the orientation defined by the last active cab.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the current train orientation definition.
steps.expected: The OBU defines the front of the train as the side of Cab A (the last active cab).

test_cases.title: Estimated front end used for location based supervision
test_cases.preconditions: The train has a valid position. The estimated front end, max safe front end, and min safe rear end are distinct. A location based event (e.g., start of a mode profile) is defined at a distance from the estimated front end.
test_cases.assumptions: The specific function being tested does not have an explicit exception in SUBSET-026 requiring a different reference (e.g., it is not an End Section timer or level transition border).

steps.action: Configure a location based supervision event to trigger when the train front end reaches a specific track position.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the estimated front end position as the reference for calculating the distance to the event.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end reaches the event location.
steps.expected: The OBU triggers the location based event based on the estimated front end position.

test_cases.title: Max safe front end used for End Section timer start
test_cases.preconditions: The train has a valid position. The estimated front end, max safe front end, and min safe rear end are distinct. An End Section timer start location is defined.
test_cases.assumptions: The function being tested is the End Section timer start location supervision, which explicitly uses the max safe front end as per SUBSET-026 §3.6.1.6 exception.

steps.action: Configure the End Section timer start location at a specific track position.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the max safe front end position as the reference for calculating the distance to the End Section timer start location.

steps.action: Move the train such that the max safe front end reaches the End Section timer start location.
steps.expected: The OBU starts the End Section timer based on the max safe front end position.

test_cases.title: Min safe rear end used for level transition border
test_cases.preconditions: The train has a valid position. The estimated front end, max safe front end, and min safe rear end are distinct. A level transition border is defined.
test_cases.assumptions: The function being tested is the passing of a level transition border, which explicitly uses the min safe rear end as per SUBSET-026 §3.6.1.6 exception.

steps.action: Configure a level transition border at a specific track position.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the min safe rear end position as the reference for calculating the distance to the level transition border.

steps.action: Move the train such that the min safe rear end passes the level transition border.
steps.expected: The OBU registers the passing of the level transition border based on the min safe rear end position.

test_cases.title: Position reporting with valid LRBG and acceptance of trackside data
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established. Linking consistency check is enabled on-board. The train has passed a balise group (BG1) that is marked as linked and is contained in the previously received linking information. The OBU has reported BG1 to the RBC as LRBGONB. The RBC has acknowledged the position report.

steps.action: The train moves forward from BG1. The OBU generates a new position report to the RBC.
steps.expected: The position report refers to BG1 as the LRBGONB. The distance is calculated from the train front end to BG1.

steps.action: The RBC sends a trackside message (e.g., MA or profile data) that refers to BG1 as the location reference.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the message and processes the location data relative to BG1.

test_cases.title: Position reporting when linking consistency is not checked
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established. Linking consistency check is disabled on-board. The train passes a balise group (BG2) that is not marked as unlinked. The OBU has reported BG2 to the RBC as LRBGONB.

steps.action: The train moves forward from BG2. The OBU generates a new position report to the RBC.
steps.expected: The position report refers to BG2 as the LRBGONB, as it is not marked as unlinked and linking consistency is not checked.

test_cases.title: Acceptance of trackside data referring to the 8th last reported LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established. The OBU has reported 8 distinct LRBG compliant balise groups to the RBC in sequence: BG1, BG2, ..., BG8. BG8 is the most recent LRBGONB. The RBC is configured to use an older reference.

steps.action: The RBC sends a trackside message that refers to BG1 (the 8th last reported LRBG) as the location reference.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the message and processes the location data relative to BG1, as it is within the minimum number of 8 last reported LRBGs.

test_cases.title: Rejection of trackside data referring to the 9th last reported LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established. The OBU has reported 9 distinct LRBG compliant balise groups to the RBC in sequence: BG1, BG2, ..., BG9. BG9 is the most recent LRBGONB. BG1 is the 9th last reported LRBG.

steps.action: The RBC sends a trackside message that refers to BG1 (the 9th last reported LRBG) as the location reference.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the message or does not process the location data, as BG1 is outside the minimum number of 8 last reported LRBGs.

test_cases.title: Position reporting with unknown LRBG when position is invalid
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established. The train position is invalid (e.g., due to a SoM procedure or loss of position data). The OBU has not passed a new LRBG compliant balise group since the position became invalid.

steps.action: The OBU generates a position report to the RBC while the train position is invalid and no valid LRBGONB is available.
steps.expected: The OBU reports the LRBG identifier as 'unknown' in the position report.

test_cases.title: OBU takes into account information valid for the train orientation
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in a driving mode (e.g., FS) with a known train orientation (e.g., nominal). A balise group is passed in the direction corresponding to the train orientation.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise message containing data valid for the nominal direction.

steps.action: Train passes a balise group transmitting data valid for the nominal direction while the train orientation is nominal.
steps.expected: The OBU takes the information into account and applies the data (e.g., updates speed profile or location).

test_cases.title: OBU ignores information valid for the opposite direction
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in a driving mode (e.g., FS) with a known train orientation (e.g., nominal). A balise group is passed in the direction corresponding to the train orientation.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise message containing data valid for the reverse direction only.

steps.action: Train passes a balise group transmitting data valid for the reverse direction only while the train orientation is nominal.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the information and does not apply the data.

test_cases.title: OBU rejects one-direction data when orientation cannot be related to trackside direction
test_cases.preconditions: Train orientation cannot be related to the direction of the trackside device (e.g., no coordinate system assigned to the balise group).
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise message containing data valid for the nominal direction only.

steps.action: Train receives data valid for the nominal direction only from a trackside device whose direction cannot be related to the train orientation.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the data.

test_cases.title: OBU evaluates data valid for both directions when orientation cannot be related
test_cases.preconditions: Train orientation cannot be related to the direction of the trackside device (e.g., no coordinate system assigned to the balise group).
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise message containing data valid for both directions.

steps.action: Train receives data valid for both directions from a trackside device whose direction cannot be related to the train orientation.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the data and applies it.

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data interpretation: value applies over following distance
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has previously received continuous profile data. Train is in a mode where speed profile supervision is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: New continuous profile data with value(n) and distance(n+1) > 0.

steps.action: OBU receives new continuous profile data where value(n) is followed by distance(n+1) > 0.
steps.expected: The OBU applies value(n) for the distance interval defined by distance(n+1).

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data interpretation: previously received data applies over first distance
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has previously received continuous profile data with value(0) and distance(1).
test_cases.test_inputs: New continuous profile data starting with value(1) and distance(2).

steps.action: OBU receives new continuous profile data. The first distance in the new data is distance(1).
steps.expected: The OBU uses the previously received data (value(0)) for the first distance interval (distance(1)).

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data interpretation: last value applies without limit
test_cases.preconditions: OBU receives continuous profile data ending with value(n) which is not an end-of-profile value.
test_cases.test_inputs: Continuous profile data where the last value is a standard speed value.

steps.action: OBU receives continuous profile data where the last value(n) is not an end-of-profile value.
steps.expected: The OBU applies value(n) for an unlimited distance beyond the last defined interval.

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data interpretation: value followed by zero distance is taken into account
test_cases.preconditions: OBU receives continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Continuous profile data where distance(n+1) = 0.

steps.action: OBU receives continuous profile data where distance(n+1) is 0.
steps.expected: The OBU still takes the corresponding profile value(n) into account.

test_cases.title: Location data interpretation: distances are unsigned increments
test_cases.preconditions: OBU receives location data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location data with multiple values and incremental distances.

steps.action: OBU receives location data with value(n) and distance(n+1).
steps.expected: The OBU interprets distance(n+1) as the unsigned incremental distance between value(n) and value(n-1).

test_cases.title: Location data interpretation: previously received data applies over first distance
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has previously received location data.
test_cases.test_inputs: New location data starting with distance(1).

steps.action: OBU receives new location data. The first distance is distance(1).
steps.expected: The OBU uses the previously received data for the first distance interval (distance(1)).

test_cases.title: Non-continuous profile data interpretation: elements with incremental starts
test_cases.preconditions: OBU receives non-continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Non-continuous profile data with multiple elements (value(n) for length(n)).

steps.action: OBU receives non-continuous profile data with element(n) and distance(n) > 0.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets distance(n) as the unsigned incremental distance from the start of element(n-1) to the start of element(n).

test_cases.title: Non-continuous profile data interpretation: first distance uses previously received data
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has previously received non-continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: New non-continuous profile data starting with distance(1).

steps.action: OBU receives new non-continuous profile data. The first distance is distance(1).
steps.expected: The OBU uses the previously received data (or initial data/default values) for the first distance interval (distance(1)).

test_cases.title: Non-continuous profile data interpretation: elements may overlap
test_cases.preconditions: OBU receives non-continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Non-continuous profile data where length(n-1) > distance(n).

steps.action: OBU receives non-continuous profile data where the length of element(n-1) is greater than the distance to the start of element(n).
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the data and processes the overlapping elements without error.

test_cases.title: Linking information interpretation: first distance to first announced balise group
test_cases.preconditions: OBU receives linking information.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information with distance(1) and value(1).

steps.action: OBU receives linking information with distance(1) and value(1).
steps.expected: The OBU interprets distance(1) as the distance to the first announced balise group and value(1) as the linking data of that group.

test_cases.title: Linking information interpretation: further distances between consecutive groups
test_cases.preconditions: OBU receives linking information with multiple balise groups.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information with distance(n) and value(n) for n > 1.

steps.action: OBU receives linking information with distance(n) and value(n) for n > 1.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets distance(n) as the distance between the start of the previous announced balise group and the current one, and value(n) as the linking data of the current group.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from linking information
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is checked. Linking information containing a specific location accuracy value for Balise Group A is stored. The train is approaching Balise Group A.

steps.action: The train passes Balise Group A, which becomes the LRBG.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the location accuracy value provided in the linking information for Balise Group A.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from National Value when linking is unavailable
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is checked. No linking information containing location accuracy for Balise Group B is available. A National Value for location accuracy is defined and applicable for this area.

steps.action: The train passes Balise Group B, which becomes the LRBG.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the applicable National Value as the location accuracy for Balise Group B.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from Default Value when no National Value applies
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is checked. No linking information containing location accuracy for Balise Group C is available. No National Value for location accuracy is applicable for this area.

steps.action: The train passes Balise Group C, which becomes the LRBG.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the Default Value as the location accuracy for Balise Group C.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy not updated upon new linking information
test_cases.preconditions: The location accuracy of Balise Group A has been determined from initial linking information (Value X). The train has passed Balise Group A and it is the current LRBG.

steps.action: New linking information is received that specifies a different location accuracy (Value Y) for Balise Group A.
steps.expected: The OBU retains the original location accuracy (Value X) for Balise Group A and does not update it to Value Y.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy not updated when linking check stops
test_cases.preconditions: The location accuracy of Balise Group A has been determined (Value X). The train is in a state where linking consistency is checked.

steps.action: The system transitions to a state where linking consistency is no longer checked (e.g., loss of linking information validity).
steps.expected: The OBU retains the previously determined location accuracy (Value X) for Balise Group A.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy not updated when new National Values apply
test_cases.preconditions: The location accuracy of Balise Group A has been determined (Value X). The train is in an area where a specific National Value applies.

steps.action: The train enters an area where a different National Value for location accuracy becomes applicable.
steps.expected: The OBU retains the previously determined location accuracy (Value X) for Balise Group A and does not switch to the new National Value.

test_cases.title: Confidence interval calculation with standard parameters
test_cases.preconditions: The train is moving. The estimated front end position is known. The location accuracy of the reference balise group, over-reading amount, and under-reading amount are known. The train is not in a consist-length-related situation defined in §3.6.4.1.5.

steps.action: The OBU calculates the train position confidence interval.
steps.expected: The min safe front end is calculated as (Estimated Front End - Under-reading Amount - Location Accuracy). The max safe front end is calculated as (Estimated Front End + Over-reading Amount + Location Accuracy). No consist length uncertainty is added.

test_cases.title: Confidence interval calculation with consist length uncertainty
test_cases.preconditions: The train is in a consist-length-related situation defined in SUBSET-026 §3.6.4.1.5 (e.g., train length not fully known or specific consist configuration). The estimated front end position, location accuracy, over/under-reading amounts, and consist length uncertainty are known.

steps.action: The OBU calculates the train position confidence interval.
steps.expected: The min safe front end and max safe front end are calculated including the consist length uncertainty in addition to the location accuracy and over/under-reading amounts, as specified for this situation.

test_cases.title: SOLR selection with linking consistency checked (Reference BG)
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is checked. Linking information is stored. Balise Group A is the reference of the linking information. The train passes Balise Group A.

steps.action: The train passes Balise Group A.
steps.expected: The OBU sets Balise Group A as the Single On-board Location Reference (SOLR).

test_cases.title: SOLR selection with linking consistency checked (Announced BG)
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is checked. Linking information is stored that announces Balise Group B. The train passes Balise Group B.

steps.action: The train passes Balise Group B.
steps.expected: The OBU sets Balise Group B as the Single On-board Location Reference (SOLR).

test_cases.title: SOLR selection with linking consistency checked (Unknown ID with Repositioning)
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is checked. Linking information is stored that announces a balise group with ID 'unknown' which contains repositioning information. The train passes this balise group.

steps.action: The train passes the balise group with ID 'unknown' carrying repositioning information.
steps.expected: The OBU sets this balise group as the Single On-board Location Reference (SOLR).

test_cases.title: SOLR selection with linking consistency not checked
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is not checked (e.g., no linking information stored or validity lost). The train passes Balise Group C.

steps.action: The train passes Balise Group C.
steps.expected: The OBU sets Balise Group C as the Single On-board Location Reference (SOLR).

test_cases.title: Linking replacement rule applied before SOLR update
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU receives new linking information. The new linking information implies a change in the SOLR according to the replacement rules.

steps.action: The OBU processes the received linking information.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the linking replacement rule (SUBSET-026 §3.7.3.1 m)) to determine the new SOLR before updating the SOLR variable.

test_cases.title: Relocation before replacement for non-linking information
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU receives location-based information (e.g., MA) referred to a balise group different from the current SOLR. The information is not linking information.

steps.action: The OBU processes the received location-based information.
steps.expected: The OBU relocates the information to the current SOLR before applying the corresponding replacement rule of §3.7.3.1.

test_cases.title: Processing location based information into min/estimated/max items
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU receives location-based information that, according to SUBSET-026 Table 2a, requires processing into 'min', 'estimated', and 'max' location items.

steps.action: The OBU processes the received location-based information.
steps.expected: The OBU creates up to three location items: 'min', 'estimated', and 'max'. The specific clauses associated with each item type in Table 2a are applied using the corresponding location item.

test_cases.title: Relocation of location items to new SOLR using linking distance
test_cases.preconditions: The train passes a new balise group which becomes the new SOLR. There is existing location-based information referred to the old SOLR (FRBG). Linking information is available and known for the distance between FRBG and the new SOLR. The last relocation of the item was not performed per clause 3.6.4.2.5 c).

steps.action: The OBU evaluates the location-based information referred to the old SOLR.
steps.expected: The OBU relocates the location item to the new SOLR by subtracting the distance between the FRBG and the new SOLR retrieved from linking information from the item's distance to the FRBG.

test_cases.title: Relocation of 'min' location item with FRBG accuracy adjustment
test_cases.preconditions: The train passes a new balise group which becomes the new SOLR. There is a 'min' location item referred to the old SOLR (FRBG). The last relocation of this item was performed per clause 3.6.4.2.5 c) towards a BG not received earlier than the reference BG of this item. Linking information is available for the distance between FRBG and the new SOLR.

steps.action: The OBU evaluates the 'min' location item.
steps.expected: The OBU relocates the 'min' location item by subtracting the distance between FRBG and the new SOLR (from linking info) diminished by twice the location accuracy of the FRBG from the item's distance to the FRBG.

test_cases.title: Relocation of 'max' location item with FRBG accuracy adjustment
test_cases.preconditions: The train passes a new balise group which becomes the new SOLR. There is a 'max' location item referred to the old SOLR (FRBG). The last relocation of this item was performed per clause 3.6.4.2.5 c) towards a BG not received earlier than the reference BG of this item. Linking information is available for the distance between FRBG and the new SOLR.

steps.action: The OBU evaluates the 'max' location item.
steps.expected: The OBU relocates the 'max' location item by subtracting the distance between FRBG and the new SOLR (from linking info) augmented by twice the location accuracy of the FRBG from the item's distance to the FRBG.

test_cases.title: Relocation using travelled distance when linking is not available
test_cases.preconditions: The train passes a new balise group which becomes the new SOLR. There is location-based information referred to the old SOLR (FRBG). Linking information is not available or not known for the distance between FRBG and the new SOLR (e.g., repositioning BG encountered).

steps.action: The OBU evaluates the location-based information.
steps.expected: The OBU relocates the location item by subtracting the estimated, min, or max travelled distance between the FRBG and the new SOLR (computed from train front end positions) from the item's distance to the FRBG, depending on the item type.

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon reaching standstill
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train moving, position report parameters stored.

steps.action: Train decelerates and reaches standstill (speed 0 km/h).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon leaving standstill
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train at standstill, position report parameters stored.

steps.action: Train accelerates from standstill to a speed greater than 0 km/h.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon mode change
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train in Full Supervision (FS) mode, position report parameters stored.

steps.action: A mode change occurs (e.g., transition to Supervision mode due to loss of MA).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon level change
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train in a valid mode, position report parameters stored.

steps.action: A level change occurs (e.g., transition from Level 2 to Level 1).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon driver confirmation of train integrity
