test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'No integrity information' or 'Confirmed by external source', position report parameters stored.

steps.action: Driver confirms train integrity via DMI.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon detection of loss of train integrity
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'Confirmed by driver' or 'Confirmed by external source', position report parameters stored.

steps.action: Loss of train integrity is detected (e.g., via external source or driver input).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon successful session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, no communication session established, RBC contact information available.

steps.action: A communication session with the RBC is successfully established.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon passing LRBG compliant balise group without stored parameters
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, no position report parameters stored on-board.

steps.action: Train passes an LRBG compliant balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon crossing RBC/RBC border with min safe rear end
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train approaching an RBC/RBC border, position report parameters stored.

steps.action: The train's min safe rear end crosses the RBC/RBC border.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon crossing RBC/RBC border with max safe front end
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train approaching an RBC/RBC border, position report parameters stored.

steps.action: The train's max safe front end crosses the RBC/RBC border.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon crossing level transition border (L2 to L0/NTC/1) with min safe rear end
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train approaching a level transition border leading to Level 0, NTC or 1, position report parameters stored.

steps.action: The train's min safe rear end crosses the level transition border.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon detection of error defined in 3.16.4
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, position report parameters stored.

steps.action: An error as defined in SUBSET-026 §3.16.4 is detected.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Report train integrity status as 'No integrity information' without train length
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'No integrity information'.

steps.action: A position report is triggered (e.g., by reaching standstill).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report containing train integrity status 'No integrity information' and no confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Report train integrity status as 'Confirmed by driver' with confirmed train length
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'Confirmed by driver', valid train length available.

steps.action: A position report is triggered (e.g., by reaching standstill).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report containing train integrity status 'Confirmed by driver' and the confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Report train integrity status as 'Confirmed by external source' with confirmed train length
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'Confirmed by external source', valid train length available.

steps.action: A position report is triggered (e.g., by reaching standstill).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report containing train integrity status 'Confirmed by external source' and the confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Report train integrity status as 'Lost' without train length
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'Lost'.

steps.action: A position report is triggered (e.g., by reaching standstill).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report containing train integrity status 'Lost' and no confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'No integrity information' to 'Confirmed by driver'
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'No integrity information', valid train position and length available.

steps.action: Driver confirms train integrity.
steps.expected: The train integrity status changes to 'Confirmed by driver'.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'No integrity information' to 'Confirmed by external source'
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'No integrity information', valid train position and length available.

steps.action: External source confirms train integrity.
steps.expected: The train integrity status changes to 'Confirmed by external source'.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'Confirmed by driver' to 'Lost'
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'Confirmed by driver'.

steps.action: Loss of train integrity is detected.
steps.expected: The train integrity status changes to 'Lost'.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'Confirmed by external source' to 'Lost'
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'Confirmed by external source'.

steps.action: Loss of train integrity is detected.
steps.expected: The train integrity status changes to 'Lost'.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'Lost' to 'No integrity information'
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'Lost'.

steps.action: Conditions for transition to 'No integrity information' are met (e.g., new session established or specific reset condition).
steps.expected: The train integrity status changes to 'No integrity information'.

test_cases.title: Geographical position display on driver request
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has valid geographical position information stored (e.g., from a recent balise group). The train is moving. The geographical position display is currently not active.

steps.action: Verify the DMI status before the request.
steps.expected: The geographical position is not displayed on the DMI.

steps.action: The driver requests the geographical position display via the DMI.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the geographical position of the train's estimated front end in relation to the track kilometre.

test_cases.title: Stopping geographical position display on driver request
test_cases.preconditions: The geographical position display is currently active on the DMI.

steps.action: Verify the DMI status before the request.
steps.expected: The geographical position is displayed on the DMI.

steps.action: The driver requests to stop the geographical position display via the DMI.
steps.expected: The OBU stops displaying the geographical position on the DMI.

test_cases.title: Geographical position calculation includes distance travelled
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has received geographical position information from a balise group. The track kilometre reference is known. The train is moving in the direction of increasing track kilometre.
test_cases.assumptions: The offset from the reference balise group to the track kilometre reference is 0 m for simplicity, or a known constant value. The odometer is functioning correctly.

steps.action: The train passes the geographical reference balise group. The OBU stores the track kilometre reference value (e.g., TK 100.000).
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the initial geographical position based on the track kilometre reference and the offset.

steps.action: The train travels a known distance (e.g., 100 m) away from the reference balise group in the direction of the track kilometre counting direction.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the geographical position by adding the distance travelled (100 m) to the initial reference value. The displayed or internal position reflects the sum of the reference value, offset, and distance travelled.

test_cases.title: Roll-away distance supervision start calculation
test_cases.preconditions: Train is at standstill. Roll-away protection supervision is active. The National Value for maximum roll-away distance is set to 10 m. The train is not in a balise group location context that would override this supervision.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the calculated remaining distance for roll-away protection for test observation.

steps.action: Initiate the roll-away protection supervision (e.g., by entering a mode where it is required or by a test command).
steps.expected: The OBU calculates and displays the remaining distance to be travelled as 10 m (the full National Value), as the estimated distance travelled away from the start location is 0.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 3 m (simulated via odometer input).
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance to be travelled to 7 m (10 m - 3 m).

test_cases.title: Post Trip reversing distance supervision start calculation
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Post Trip mode. The National Value for maximum reversing distance is set to 50 m. The train is at a standstill.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the calculated remaining reversing distance for test observation.

steps.action: Start the supervision for reversing in Post Trip mode.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance for reversing as 50 m.

steps.action: Move the train in the reversing direction by 20 m.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining reversing distance to 30 m (50 m - 20 m).

test_cases.title: Standstill supervision distance tracking with direction
test_cases.preconditions: Train is at standstill. Standstill supervision is active. The maximum distance for standstill supervision is 10 m. The train orientation is forward.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU tracks the distance in the concerned direction (forward) for standstill supervision.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 5 m.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance for standstill supervision as 5 m (10 m - 5 m).

steps.action: Move the train backward by 2 m.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance for standstill supervision as 7 m (10 m - (5 m - 2 m)), as the net distance travelled away from the start location in the concerned direction (forward) is 3 m.

test_cases.title: Trip suppression distance after Override with direction
test_cases.preconditions: Override function has been triggered. The trip suppression distance is 20 m. The train is moving in the direction of travel.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU tracks the distance in the direction of travel for trip suppression after Override.

steps.action: Move the train in the direction of travel by 10 m.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining trip suppression distance as 10 m (20 m - 10 m).

steps.action: Move the train opposite to the direction of travel by 5 m.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining trip suppression distance as 15 m (20 m - (10 m - 5 m)), as the net distance travelled away from the start location in the concerned direction is 5 m.

test_cases.title: Staff Responsible distance with virtual train front position
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Staff Responsible mode. The maximum permitted distance to run is 100 m. The odometer under-reading amount is 2 m and the over-reading amount is 3 m since the supervision started.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the remaining distances from the estimated, max safe, and min safe front ends for test observation.

steps.action: Start the Staff Responsible distance supervision.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance from the estimated front end as 100 m, from the max safe front end as 98 m (100 m - 2 m), and from the min safe front end as 103 m (100 m + 3 m).

steps.action: Move the train forward by 40 m.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance from the estimated front end to 60 m (100 m - 40 m), from the max safe front end to 58 m (100 m - 40 m - 2 m), and from the min safe front end to 63 m (100 m - 40 m + 3 m).

test_cases.title: Zero distance to former EOA/LOA after Override without valid position
test_cases.preconditions: Override function has been triggered in SB or PT mode. There is no valid train position stored on-board. The zero distance to the former EOA/LOA supervision is started.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the remaining distance for the zero distance supervision for test observation.

steps.action: Start the supervision for the zero distance to the former EOA/LOA.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance from the estimated front end as 0 m, from the max safe front end as -2 m (0 m - 2 m), and from the min safe front end as 3 m (0 m + 3 m), assuming under-reading of 2 m and over-reading of 3 m.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 5 m.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance from the estimated front end to -5 m (0 m - 5 m), from the max safe front end to -7 m (0 m - 5 m - 2 m), and from the min safe front end to -2 m (0 m - 5 m + 3 m).

test_cases.title: MA rejection when SSP/gradient does not cover full length (Non-infill MA)
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, train in Full Supervision (FS) mode. A valid MA is currently active. The train is moving.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA message from RBC where the associated SSP and gradient data ends before the Supervised Location (SvL) of the new MA.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'full length' for a non-infill MA is defined as the distance from the estimated front end of the train to the supervised location.

steps.action: The RBC sends a new MA with SSP and gradient data that covers only a portion of the distance from the train's estimated front end to the new MA's supervised location.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the new MA and its related mode profile. The previous MA remains valid and supervision continues based on the old MA.

steps.action: The RBC sends a new MA with SSP and gradient data that covers the full distance from the train's estimated front end to the new MA's supervised location.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new MA and its related mode profile. Supervision updates to the new MA.

test_cases.title: MA rejection when SSP/gradient does not cover full length (Infill MA)
test_cases.preconditions: Level 1 or 2, train in Full Supervision (FS) mode. An infill MA is expected via balise.
test_cases.test_inputs: An infill MA message where the SSP and gradient data ends before the Supervised Location (SvL) of the infill MA, starting from the infill location reference.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'full length' for an infill MA is defined as the distance from the infill location reference to the supervised location.

steps.action: The OBU receives an infill MA via balise where the SSP and gradient data does not cover the distance from the infill location reference to the supervised location.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the infill MA and its related mode profile. The previous MA remains valid.

steps.action: The OBU receives an infill MA via balise where the SSP and gradient data covers the full distance from the infill location reference to the supervised location.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the infill MA and its related mode profile. Supervision updates to the new MA.

test_cases.title: MA rejection when SSP/gradient does not cover full length (Supervised Manoeuvre, opposite orientation)
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, train in Full Supervision (FS) mode. A Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation is received with a validity direction opposite to the current train orientation.
test_cases.test_inputs: An MA for a Supervised Manoeuvre where the SSP and gradient data ends before the Supervised Location (SvL), calculated from the estimated front end of the train derived from the new train orientation.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'full length' for this case is defined as the distance from the estimated front end of the train derived from the new train orientation to the supervised location.

steps.action: The RBC sends an MA for a Supervised Manoeuvre with opposite validity direction, where the SSP and gradient data does not cover the distance from the estimated front end (new orientation) to the supervised location.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the MA and its related mode profile. The previous MA remains valid.

steps.action: The RBC sends an MA for a Supervised Manoeuvre with opposite validity direction, where the SSP and gradient data covers the full distance from the estimated front end (new orientation) to the supervised location.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the MA and its related mode profile. Supervision updates to the new MA.

test_cases.title: Replacement of route suitability loading gauge information
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where location based information is stored (e.g., Full Supervision). Existing route suitability loading gauge information is stored for a specific track section.
test_cases.test_inputs: New track description data containing route suitability loading gauge information for the same track section.

steps.action: Receive new track description data containing route suitability loading gauge information.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces all previously stored route suitability loading gauge information with the new information.

steps.action: Query the stored route suitability loading gauge information.
steps.expected: Only the new information is present; the old information is no longer stored.

test_cases.title: Replacement of adhesion factor information from start location
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has stored adhesion factor information for a track section starting at location L1 and ending at L2. The train is located before L1.
test_cases.test_inputs: New adhesion factor information starting at location L3, where L3 is within the range [L1, L2].

steps.action: Receive new adhesion factor information starting at location L3.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the stored adhesion factor information from location L3 onwards. The information before L3 remains unchanged.

steps.action: Query the stored adhesion factor information for locations before L3 and after L3.
steps.expected: Locations before L3 retain the old adhesion factor values. Locations from L3 onwards contain the new adhesion factor values.

test_cases.title: Replacement of linking information (non-infill) from reference balise group
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has stored linking information with a reference balise group BG_old. The train is located before BG_old.
test_cases.test_inputs: New linking information received as non-infill information with a reference balise group BG_new, where BG_new is different from BG_old.

steps.action: Receive new linking information as non-infill information with reference balise group BG_new.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces all stored linking information from the reference balise group BG_new onwards. Linking information associated with balise groups before BG_new remains unchanged.

steps.action: Query the stored linking information.
steps.expected: Linking information for balise groups before BG_new is unchanged. Linking information from BG_new onwards is replaced with the new data.

test_cases.title: Replacement of linking information (infill) from infill reference location
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has stored linking information. The train is located before the infill reference location.
test_cases.test_inputs: New linking information received as infill information with an infill reference location (balise group at next main signal) BG_infill.

steps.action: Receive new linking information as infill information with infill reference location BG_infill.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces all stored linking information from the infill reference location BG_infill onwards.

steps.action: Query the stored linking information.
steps.expected: Linking information from BG_infill onwards is replaced with the new infill data. Information before BG_infill remains unchanged.

test_cases.title: Resumption of initial state for PBD speed restrictions
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has stored Speed Restriction to ensure Permitted Braking Distance (PBD) information for a track section. The train is located before the start of this restriction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside request to resume initial state for PBD speed restrictions beyond a given location L_req.

steps.action: Receive a trackside request to resume initial state for PBD speed restrictions beyond location L_req.
steps.expected: The OBU resumes the initial state for the stored PBD speed restriction information beyond location L_req.

steps.action: Query the stored PBD speed restriction information beyond L_req.
steps.expected: The PBD speed restriction information beyond L_req is in its initial state (e.g., no restriction or default value as defined in 3.11.11.11).

test_cases.title: Resumption of initial state for axle load speed profiles
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has stored axle load speed profile information for a track section. The train is located before the start of this profile.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside request to resume initial state for axle load speed profiles beyond a given location L_req.

steps.action: Receive a trackside request to resume initial state for axle load speed profiles beyond location L_req.
steps.expected: The OBU resumes the initial state for the stored axle load speed profile information beyond location L_req.

steps.action: Query the stored axle load speed profile information beyond L_req.
steps.expected: The axle load speed profile information beyond L_req is in its initial state (e.g., no restriction or default value as defined in 3.11.4.5).

test_cases.title: Resumption of initial state for grouped track condition types
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has stored track condition information for types such as sound horn, non stopping area, tunnel stopping area, etc. The train is located before the start of these conditions.
test_cases.test_inputs: A single trackside request to resume initial state for all stored track condition information of the listed types (sound horn, non stopping area, tunnel stopping area, powerless section – lower pantograph, powerless section – switch off the main power switch, radio hole, air tightness, switch off regenerative brake, switch off eddy current brake for service brake, switch off eddy current brake for emergency brake, switch off magnetic shoe brake) beyond a given location L_req.

steps.action: Receive a single trackside request to resume initial state for the listed track condition types beyond location L_req.
steps.expected: The OBU resumes the initial state for all the specified track condition types beyond location L_req.

steps.action: Query the stored track condition information for the listed types beyond L_req.
steps.expected: All specified track condition types beyond L_req are in their initial states (e.g., sound horn off, stopping allowed, pantograph up, etc., as defined in 3.12.1.3).

test_cases.title: Resumption of initial state for route suitability data
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has stored route suitability information (loading gauge, traction system, axle load). The train is located before the start of this information.
test_cases.test_inputs: A single trackside request to resume initial state for all stored route suitability information beyond a given location L_req.

steps.action: Receive a single trackside request to resume initial state for all stored route suitability information beyond location L_req.
steps.expected: The OBU resumes the initial state for all stored route suitability information beyond location L_req.

steps.action: Query the stored route suitability information beyond L_req.
steps.expected: All route suitability information beyond L_req is in its initial state (as defined in 3.12.2.10).

test_cases.title: Resumption of initial state for Station Platform track conditions
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has stored track condition information of the type Station Platform. The train is located before the start of this information.
test_cases.test_inputs: A single trackside request to resume initial state for all stored track condition information of the type Station Platform beyond a given location L_req.

steps.action: Receive a single trackside request to resume initial state for all stored Station Platform track condition information beyond location L_req.
steps.expected: The OBU resumes the initial state for the stored Station Platform track condition information beyond location L_req.

steps.action: Query the stored Station Platform track condition information beyond L_req.
steps.expected: The Station Platform track condition information beyond L_req is in its initial state (as defined in 3.12.1.3).

test_cases.title: Supervised Manoeuvre with same validity direction as train orientation
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where location based information is stored. The train is oriented in a specific direction (e.g., forward). Existing location based information is stored.
test_cases.test_inputs: A Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with a validity direction matching the current train orientation (e.g., forward).

steps.action: Receive a Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with a validity direction matching the current train orientation.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the normal replacement rules of SUBSET-026 §3.7.3.1. The previously stored location based information is replaced according to these rules, not deleted entirely.

steps.action: Query the stored location based information.
steps.expected: The location based information reflects the new Supervised Manoeuvre data, with old data replaced as per §3.7.3.1 rules.

test_cases.title: Supervised Manoeuvre with opposite validity direction to train orientation
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where location based information is stored. The train is oriented in a specific direction (e.g., forward). Existing location based information is stored.
test_cases.test_inputs: A Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with a validity direction opposite to the current train orientation (e.g., backward).

steps.action: Receive a Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with a validity direction opposite to the current train orientation.
steps.expected: The OBU does not apply the normal replacement rules of §3.7.3.1. Instead, it deletes all previously stored location based information.

steps.action: Query the stored location based information.
steps.expected: All previously stored location based information is deleted. The OBU is in a state where no location based information is stored (or initial state is resumed).

test_cases.title: MA request includes all applicable reasons when multiple triggers occur simultaneously
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC. MA request parameters received from RBC. Train is in a mode where MA requests are allowed. The train is positioned such that the perturbation location criterion is met (train front passes the defined location). Simultaneously, the Section timer for the current MA is about to expire (the defined time before expiration is reached).
test_cases.assumptions: The RBC has configured MA request parameters that enable triggering based on perturbation location and Section timer. The 'Start' selection is not active, and no track description deletion has occurred.

steps.action: Position the train so that the train front passes the location defined by the perturbation-location criterion.
steps.expected: The OBU triggers an MA request. The reason 'With respect to perturbation location' is included in the request.

steps.action: Ensure that at the same moment, the defined time before the expiration of the Section timer is reached.
steps.expected: The OBU includes the reason 'With respect to MA timer elapsing' in the same MA request sent to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the MA request message sent to the RBC.
steps.expected: The MA request contains both reasons: 'With respect to perturbation location' and 'With respect to MA timer elapsing'.

test_cases.title: MA request includes 'Start' reason when driver selects Start
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC. Train is at standstill. No other MA request triggers are active (no perturbation location passed, no timer expiration imminent, no track description deletion).
test_cases.assumptions: The driver is authorized to select 'Start'.

steps.action: The driver selects 'Start' on the DMI.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an MA request to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the MA request message sent to the RBC.
steps.expected: The MA request contains the reason 'Start selected by driver'.

test_cases.title: MA request includes 'Track description deletion' reason when applicable
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC. The OBU has stored track description. A condition occurs that causes part of the track description to be deleted according to SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4, excluding situations a, b, f, and k (e.g., situation c: deletion due to new MA reception that does not cover the entire stored description).
test_cases.assumptions: The deletion of track description is triggered by a valid event defined in A.3.4 (not a, b, f, or k).

steps.action: Trigger a track description deletion event that is not one of situations a, b, f, or k (e.g., by receiving a new MA that causes partial deletion of stored track description).
steps.expected: The OBU sends an MA request to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the MA request message sent to the RBC.
steps.expected: The MA request contains the reason 'Track description deletion'.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered when train front passes perturbation location
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC. MA request parameters received from RBC, including the triggering time criterion for perturbation location. The train is running at warning speed towards a perturbation location.
test_cases.assumptions: The perturbation location is defined in the MA. The train is running at the warning speed as specified in the MA.

steps.action: Run the train at warning speed towards the perturbation location.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the location where the MA request should be triggered based on the defined time before reaching the perturbation location.

steps.action: Allow the train front to pass the calculated location.
steps.expected: The OBU triggers and sends an MA request to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the MA request message sent to the RBC.
steps.expected: The MA request contains the reason 'With respect to perturbation location'.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered when Section timer expiration time is reached
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC. MA request parameters received from RBC, including the triggering time criterion for Section timer. The train has an MA with a Section timer that is running.
test_cases.assumptions: The Section timer is active and will expire. The defined time before expiration is set in the MA request parameters.

steps.action: Wait until the defined time before the expiration of the Section timer is reached.
steps.expected: The OBU triggers and sends an MA request to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the MA request message sent to the RBC.
steps.expected: The MA request contains the reason 'With respect to MA timer elapsing'.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered when LOA speed timer expiration time is reached
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC. MA request parameters received from RBC, including the triggering time criterion for LOA speed timer. The train has an MA with a LOA speed timer that is running.
test_cases.assumptions: The LOA speed timer is active and will expire. The defined time before expiration is set in the MA request parameters.

steps.action: Wait until the defined time before the expiration of the LOA speed timer is reached.
steps.expected: The OBU triggers and sends an MA request to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the MA request message sent to the RBC.
steps.expected: The MA request contains the reason 'With respect to MA timer elapsing'.

test_cases.title: MA request sent when track description is deleted (situation c)
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC. The OBU has stored track description. A new MA is received that causes part of the stored track description to be deleted (situation c in A.3.4).
test_cases.assumptions: The new MA does not cover the entire stored track description, leading to partial deletion.

steps.action: Receive a new MA from the RBC that causes part of the stored track description to be deleted (situation c).
steps.expected: The OBU sends an MA request to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the MA request message sent to the RBC.
steps.expected: The MA request contains the reason 'Track description deletion'.

test_cases.title: No MA request sent when track description is deleted (situation a)
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC. The OBU has stored track description. A condition occurs that causes part of the track description to be deleted according to situation a in A.3.4 (e.g., deletion due to reception of a new MA that fully covers the stored description).
test_cases.assumptions: Situation a in A.3.4 is an exception where no MA request is required.

steps.action: Trigger a track description deletion event that corresponds to situation a in A.3.4 (e.g., reception of a new MA that fully covers the stored description).
steps.expected: The OBU does not send an MA request to the RBC.

test_cases.title: No MA request sent when track description is deleted (situation b)
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC. The OBU has stored track description. A condition occurs that causes part of the track description to be deleted according to situation b in A.3.4 (e.g., deletion due to reception of a new MA that is identical to the stored description).
test_cases.assumptions: Situation b in A.3.4 is an exception where no MA request is required.

steps.action: Trigger a track description deletion event that corresponds to situation b in A.3.4 (e.g., reception of a new MA that is identical to the stored description).
steps.expected: The OBU does not send an MA request to the RBC.

test_cases.title: No MA request sent when track description is deleted (situation f)
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC. The OBU has stored track description. A condition occurs that causes part of the track description to be deleted according to situation f in A.3.4 (e.g., deletion due to reception of a new MA that is a subset of the stored description).
test_cases.assumptions: Situation f in A.3.4 is an exception where no MA request is required.

steps.action: Trigger a track description deletion event that corresponds to situation f in A.3.4 (e.g., reception of a new MA that is a subset of the stored description).
steps.expected: The OBU does not send an MA request to the RBC.

test_cases.title: No MA request sent when track description is deleted (situation k)
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC. The OBU has stored track description. A condition occurs that causes part of the track description to be deleted according to situation k in A.3.4 (e.g., deletion due to reception of a new MA that is a superset of the stored description).
test_cases.assumptions: Situation k in A.3.4 is an exception where no MA request is required.

steps.action: Trigger a track description deletion event that corresponds to situation k in A.3.4 (e.g., reception of a new MA that is a superset of the stored description).
steps.expected: The OBU does not send an MA request to the RBC.

test_cases.title: End Section timer start upon passing start location
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in a mode where MA is active (e.g., FS). An MA with an End Section timer start location is stored. The train's max safe front end is located before the End Section timer start location.

steps.action: Move the train forward so that its max safe front end passes the End Section timer start location.
steps.expected: The End Section timer starts counting.

test_cases.title: End Section timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: End Section timer is running. The MA includes an LOA with a non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority. Location based information per Appendix A.3.4 is stored.

steps.action: Wait until the End Section timer value exceeds the time-out value given by trackside.
steps.expected: The EOA/LOA is withdrawn to the train's current position. The location based information listed in Appendix A.3.4 is deleted. The non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority is set to zero.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer start in Level 2
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2 operation. Communication session with RBC is established. Train is in FS mode.

steps.action: Receive a new MA message from the RBC containing a LOA speed.
steps.expected: The LOA speed timer starts at the time stamp of the received message.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer start in Level 1
test_cases.preconditions: Level 1 operation. Train is in FS mode. A balise group giving an MA with a LOA speed is ahead.

steps.action: Pass the first encountered balise of the balise group that gives the MA.
steps.expected: The LOA speed timer starts at the moment of passing the first balise.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: LOA speed timer is running. The MA includes an LOA with a non-zero speed. Location based information per Appendix A.3.4 is stored.

steps.action: Wait until the LOA speed timer value exceeds the time-out value received from trackside.
steps.expected: The speed associated with the LOA is set to zero. The LOA becomes an EOA. The Supervised Location is defined per §3.8.4.5. The location based information listed in Appendix A.3.4 is deleted.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start upon passing start location
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in a mode where MA is active. An MA with an Overlap timer start location and a finite time-out value is stored. The train's max safe front end is located before the Overlap timer start location.

steps.action: Move the train forward so that its max safe front end passes the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer starts counting.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start with infinite time-out value
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in a mode where MA is active. An MA with an Overlap timer start location and a time-out value of 'infinite' is stored. The train's max safe front end is located before the Overlap timer start location.

steps.action: Move the train forward so that its max safe front end passes the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer is considered as started.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: Overlap timer is running. The MA includes an Overlap with a release speed and a non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority. Location based information per Appendix A.3.4 is stored.

steps.action: Wait until the Overlap timer value exceeds the time-out value given by trackside.
steps.expected: The overlap information is deleted. The release speed associated with the Overlap is deleted. The Supervised Location is redetermined per §3.8.4.5. The location based information listed in Appendix A.3.4 is deleted. The non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority is set to zero.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer expiration upon train standstill
test_cases.preconditions: Overlap timer has been started. The train is moving. The MA includes an Overlap with a release speed and a non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority.

steps.action: Bring the train to a standstill while the Overlap timer is running.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the Overlap timer as expired. The overlap information is deleted. The release speed is deleted. The Supervised Location is redetermined per §3.8.4.5. The non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority is set to zero.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer expiration upon receiving new MA with rear start location
test_cases.preconditions: No Overlap timer is running. The train's max safe front end is at a specific position. The MA includes an Overlap with a release speed and a non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority.

steps.action: Receive a new MA where the Overlap timer start location is in rear of the train's max safe front end.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the Overlap timer as exceeded its time-out value. The overlap information is deleted. The release speed is deleted. The Supervised Location is redetermined per §3.8.4.5. The non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority is set to zero.

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with valid Overlap
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in FS mode. An MA with an Overlap is stored. The Overlap timer is running and has not timed out. A Danger Point and an End Section are also defined in the MA.

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location (SvL) determined by the OBU.
steps.expected: The SvL is set to the end of the Overlap.

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with timed-out Overlap and valid Danger Point
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in FS mode. An MA with an Overlap and a Danger Point is stored. The Overlap timer has timed out (Overlap deleted). An End Section is also defined.

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location (SvL) determined by the OBU.
steps.expected: The SvL is set to the Danger Point.

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with no Overlap and no Danger Point
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in FS mode. An MA with an End Section is stored. No Overlap and no Danger Point are defined in the MA.

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location (SvL) determined by the OBU.
steps.expected: The SvL is set to the end of the End Section.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation in FS mode
test_cases.preconditions: Level 1 or Level 2. Train is in Full Supervision (FS) mode. Linking information for the relevant main signal balise group is available.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation in AD mode
test_cases.preconditions: Level 1 or Level 2. Train is in Automatic Driving (AD) mode. Linking information for the relevant main signal balise group is available.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation in LS mode
test_cases.preconditions: Level 1 or Level 2. Train is in Limited Supervision (LS) mode. Linking information for the relevant main signal balise group is available.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA rejection in non-FS/AD/LS mode
test_cases.preconditions: Level 1 or Level 2. Train is in a mode other than FS, AD, or LS (e.g., SM or SB). Linking information for the relevant main signal balise group is available.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA.
steps.expected: The OBU does not evaluate the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation with available linking information
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in FS, AD, or LS mode. Linking information is available for the main signal balise group to which the infill MA refers.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA rejection without linking information
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in FS, AD, or LS mode. Linking information is NOT available for the main signal balise group to which the infill MA refers.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA.
steps.expected: The OBU does not evaluate the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Non-infill MA from RBC replaces all previous MA data
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, train in FS, communication session with RBC established, a valid MA with specific speed restrictions and section timers is currently supervised.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA from the RBC with different speed restrictions and section timers.

steps.action: Receive a new MA from the RBC that contains different speed restrictions and section timer values than the currently supervised MA.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces all data of the previous MA with the new data. The new speed restrictions and section timers are applied and displayed.

test_cases.title: Non-infill MA from main-signal balise group replaces all previous MA data
test_cases.preconditions: Level 1, train in FS, a valid MA is currently supervised. The train is approaching a main signal balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: A non-infill MA transmitted by the main-signal balise group with different data than the previous MA.

steps.action: The train passes the main-signal balise group which transmits a non-infill MA with different speed restrictions and section timers than the currently supervised MA.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces all data of the previous MA with the new data. The new speed restrictions and section timers are applied and displayed.

test_cases.title: Infill MA replaces only data beyond the next main signal balise group
test_cases.preconditions: Level 1, train in FS, a valid MA is currently supervised. Linking information for the next main signal balise group is available. The train is before the next main signal balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: An infill MA received from a preceding balise group or loop, referring to the next main signal balise group, with different data beyond that point.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA that refers to the next main signal balise group. The infill MA contains different speed restrictions and section timers for the sections beyond the next main signal balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU keeps the data of the previous MA up to the next main signal balise group. The OBU replaces only the data beyond the announced balise group at the next main signal with the new infill data.

test_cases.title: Infill MA starts a new MA section at the infill location reference
test_cases.preconditions: Level 1, train in FS, a valid MA is currently supervised. Linking information for the next main signal balise group is available. The train is before the next main signal balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: An infill MA received from a preceding balise group, referring to the next main signal balise group.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA that refers to the next main signal balise group. The infill MA defines a new section starting at the next main signal balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU starts a new MA section at the infill location reference, which is the balise group at the next main signal. The new section is displayed as the first section of the updated MA beyond the infill point.

test_cases.title: New MA with SvL while supervising LOA is treated as MA shortening
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, train in FS, the OBU is supervising an MA ending with an LOA (Limit of Authority). Location-based information (e.g., speed restrictions, section timers) is stored beyond the LOA.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA from the RBC defining an SvL (Stop Location) at a location closer than the current LOA.

steps.action: Receive a new MA from the RBC that defines an SvL at a location closer than the currently supervised LOA.
steps.expected: The OBU treats this as an MA shortening. The OBU deletes the stored location-based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4 that is beyond the new SvL. The new SvL is displayed as the end of the MA.

test_cases.title: New MA with SvL while supervising LOA is treated as MA shortening even if SvL is far
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, train in FS, the OBU is supervising an MA ending with an LOA. Location-based information is stored beyond the LOA.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA from the RBC defining an SvL at a location far ahead, but still defining an SvL instead of an LOA.

steps.action: Receive a new MA from the RBC that defines an SvL at a location far ahead, while the OBU was supervising an LOA.
steps.expected: The OBU treats this as an MA shortening regardless of the SvL location. The OBU deletes the stored location-based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4 that is beyond the new SvL. The new SvL is displayed as the end of the MA.

test_cases.title: Repositioning information is not treated as MA shortening
test_cases.preconditions: Level 1, train in FS, a valid MA is currently supervised. Linking information announces a following balise group as unknown but containing repositioning information.
test_cases.test_inputs: Repositioning information contained in a balise group message.

steps.action: Receive repositioning information from a balise group that updates the length of the current MA section.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the length of the current MA section. The OBU does not treat this as an MA shortening. No location-based information is deleted as a result of this update.

test_cases.title: New MA ending with LOA is not treated as MA shortening
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, train in FS, a valid MA is currently supervised ending with an SvL.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA from the RBC ending with an LOA.

steps.action: Receive a new MA from the RBC that ends with an LOA, replacing the previous MA that ended with an SvL.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the new MA. The OBU does not treat this as an MA shortening. No location-based information is deleted as a result of this update.

test_cases.title: Acceptance of MA shortening when train is in rear of Indication supervision limit
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session with RBC established. Train is running in a mode with a valid MA (e.g., FS). The current MA has an EOA/LOA at a known distance ahead. The train front end position is estimated to be significantly in rear of the proposed shortened MA's Indication supervision limit.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC sends a 'Request to shorten MA' message containing a proposed shortened MA with an EOA closer to the train than the current EOA, including a mode profile and a list of balise groups for SH area.

steps.action: The RBC sends a request to shorten the MA with a proposed shortened MA where the Indication supervision limit is ahead of the train's estimated front end position.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the request. The proposed shortened MA, its mode profile, and the list of balise groups for SH area are stored as the new MA data.

steps.action: The OBU sends a response to the RBC regarding the shortening request.
steps.expected: The OBU informs the RBC that the request has been accepted (e.g., via 'Train Accepted' or specific acknowledgement message).

test_cases.title: Rejection of MA shortening when train is in advance of Indication supervision limit
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session with RBC established. Train is running in a mode with a valid MA. The train front end position is estimated to be in advance of (or at) the proposed shortened MA's Indication supervision limit.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC sends a 'Request to shorten MA' message containing a proposed shortened MA where the Indication supervision limit is behind the train's estimated front end position.

steps.action: The RBC sends a request to shorten the MA with a proposed shortened MA where the Indication supervision limit is in rear of the train's estimated front end position.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the request. The previously received MA, mode profile, and list of balise groups for SH area remain valid and unchanged.

steps.action: The OBU sends a response to the RBC regarding the shortening request.
steps.expected: The OBU informs the RBC that the request has been rejected (e.g., via 'Train Rejected' or specific negative acknowledgement message).

test_cases.title: Boundary condition: Train front end exactly at Indication supervision limit
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session with RBC established. Train is running in a mode with a valid MA. The train front end position is estimated to be exactly at the proposed shortened MA's Indication supervision limit.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC sends a 'Request to shorten MA' message containing a proposed shortened MA where the Indication supervision limit coincides with the train's estimated front end position.
test_cases.assumptions: The requirement states 'in rear' for acceptance and 'in advance' for rejection. The behavior at the exact limit is interpreted as not being 'in rear', thus triggering rejection to ensure safety (conservative approach).

steps.action: The RBC sends a request to shorten the MA with a proposed shortened MA where the Indication supervision limit is exactly at the train's estimated front end position.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the request (as the train is not in rear of the limit). The previous MA remains valid.

steps.action: The OBU sends a response to the RBC regarding the shortening request.
steps.expected: The OBU informs the RBC that the request has been rejected.

test_cases.title: OBU ignores announcement for unsupported infill medium and continues with previous MA
test_cases.preconditions: Level 1, mode FS, LS or AD. The OBU is not equipped with the specific infill transmission medium requested (e.g., no Radio Infill Unit hardware or software support). A valid Movement Authority (MA) and track description are currently stored and supervised. An announcement balise group is present on the track requesting the unsupported medium.
test_cases.test_inputs: Announcement balise group data requesting an infill medium not supported by the OBU (e.g., Radio Infill).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU's configuration explicitly excludes the requested infill medium. The previous MA allows continued movement through the area where the announcement is located.

steps.action: The train passes the announcement balise group that requests an infill transmission medium for which the OBU is not equipped.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the announcement information. No new infill session is initiated, and no error related to missing hardware is triggered that would stop the train.

steps.action: The train continues to move according to the previously received Movement Authority (MA) and track description.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to supervise the train based on the previous MA. The permitted speed and end of authority remain unchanged from the state before passing the announcement balise group.

test_cases.title: OBU ignores loop infill after reading next main signal balise group
test_cases.preconditions: Level 1, mode FS, LS or AD; linking information stored (including the main signal balise group BGa); loop infill area information stored and a communication session with the loop infill unit established.

steps.action: Level 1, loop infill session established; the train passes and reads the next main signal balise group indicated in the order.
steps.expected: The OBU registers the reading of the main signal balise group.

steps.action: After reading the main signal balise group, the OBU receives new infill information from the loop referring to that balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the infill information (its infill MA is not applied: no trip, no emergency brake).

test_cases.title: OBU ignores loop infill after detecting missed next main signal balise group
test_cases.preconditions: Level 1, mode FS, LS or AD; linking information stored (including the main signal balise group BGa with reaction 'no reaction'); loop infill area information stored and a communication session with the loop infill unit established.

steps.action: Level 1, loop infill session established; the train passes the last possible location of the next main signal balise group without reading it, triggering the missed detection.
steps.expected: The OBU detects the balise group as missed.

steps.action: After detecting the missed balise group, the OBU receives new infill information from the loop referring to that balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the infill information (its infill MA is not applied: no trip, no emergency brake).

test_cases.title: Order to establish RIU session ignored when GSM-R is not installed
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is configured without a GSM-R radio system. The train is in Level 1.
test_cases.test_inputs: A balise group containing an order to establish a communication session with a Radio Infill Unit.

steps.action: The train passes a balise group that contains an order to establish a communication session with a Radio Infill Unit.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the order. No communication session is established, and no attempt to connect to a GSM-R network is made.

test_cases.title: Termination of existing RIU session and establishment of new one upon reaching location
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 with GSM-R installed. An active communication session exists with RIU-A. The OBU receives a balise group order to establish a session with RIU-B at a specific location ahead.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group order specifying RIU-B and the location where the action should be performed.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is capable of handling multiple sessions or can switch sessions as per its design.

steps.action: The train reaches the location indicated in the balise group order.
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the existing communication session with RIU-A.

steps.action: The OBU attempts to establish a new communication session with RIU-B.
steps.expected: A communication session is established with RIU-B.

test_cases.title: Information sent to RIU upon entering infill area and reading next main signal balise
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 with an active session with an RIU. The OBU has received a balise group order defining an infill area with a start location and a next main signal balise group identifier.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement passing the start location and then the next main signal balise group.

steps.action: The train passes the location indicated in the balise group order (entry into the infill area).
steps.expected: The OBU sends information to the Radio Infill Unit indicating entry into the infill area.

steps.action: The train reads the next main signal balise group indicated in the order.
steps.expected: The OBU sends information to the Radio Infill Unit indicating that the next main signal balise group has been read.

test_cases.title: Information sent to RIU upon detecting missed next main signal balise
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 with an active session with an RIU. The OBU has received a balise group order defining an infill area with a next main signal balise group identifier. The train passes the expected location of the balise group without reading it.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement passing the expected location of the next main signal balise group without detection.

steps.action: The OBU detects that the next main signal balise group indicated in the order was missed.
steps.expected: The OBU sends information to the Radio Infill Unit indicating that the next main signal balise group was missed.

test_cases.title: Content of information sent to RIU
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 with an active session with an RIU. The OBU is about to send information to the RIU (e.g., upon entering the infill area).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger event for sending information (e.g., passing the infill area start location).

steps.action: The OBU sends information to the Radio Infill Unit.
steps.expected: The transmitted message includes the train identity (ETCS-ID), a position report, the identifier of the next main signal balise group, and a time stamp.

test_cases.title: Consistency check of radio infill data
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 with an active session with an RIU. The RIU sends radio infill data that violates consistency rules defined in SUBSET-026 §3.16.3.1 and §3.16.3.3 (e.g., inconsistent speed profiles or invalid identifiers).
test_cases.test_inputs: Radio infill data with intentional inconsistencies.
test_cases.assumptions: The specific consistency rules from SUBSET-026 §3.16.3.1 and §3.16.3.3 are known and implemented.

steps.action: The OBU receives radio infill data from the RIU that fails the consistency check.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the inconsistent data and does not apply it to the supervision. An error or warning may be logged or displayed.

test_cases.title: Ignoring further radio infill information after reading next main signal balise
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 with an active session with an RIU. The OBU has read the next main signal balise group indicated in the infill order.
test_cases.test_inputs: Further radio infill information related to the already read balise group.

steps.action: The OBU receives further radio infill information from the RIU that is related to the next main signal balise group which has already been read.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the further radio infill information. The supervision remains unchanged.

test_cases.title: Ignoring further radio infill information after detecting missed next main signal balise
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 with an active session with an RIU. The OBU has detected that the next main signal balise group indicated in the infill order was missed.
test_cases.test_inputs: Further radio infill information related to the missed balise group.

steps.action: The OBU receives further radio infill information from the RIU that is related to the next main signal balise group which was detected as missed.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the further radio infill information. The supervision remains unchanged.

test_cases.title: Termination of RIU session upon trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 with an active session with an RIU.
test_cases.test_inputs: A termination order received from a balise group or the RIU.

steps.action: The OBU receives a termination order for the communication session from a balise group or the RIU.
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the communication session with the Radio Infill Unit.

test_cases.title: Termination of RIU session when leaving Level 1
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 with an active session with an RIU.
test_cases.test_inputs: A change of operational level from Level 1 to another level (e.g., Level 2 or Level 0).

steps.action: The OBU changes its operational level from Level 1 to another level.
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the communication session with the Radio Infill Unit.

test_cases.title: Order to establish session via RIU ignored in degraded single-session mode
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is configured or simulated to be in a degraded situation where it can handle only one communication session established through GSM-R. An existing communication session with a Radio Infill Unit (RIU-A) is active. The OBU is in Level 1.
test_cases.test_inputs: An order to establish a communication session with a different Radio Infill Unit (RIU-B) received via the active RIU-A.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU's capability to handle multiple sessions is limited to one due to the degraded configuration.

steps.action: The OBU receives an order via the active RIU-A to establish a new communication session with RIU-B.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the order. The existing session with RIU-A remains active, and no new session with RIU-B is established.

test_cases.title: OBU acknowledges a received emergency message with its identifier
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, radio session with the supervising RBC is established. The train is in a mode where emergency messages are processed (e.g., FS, OS, LS, AD, SM). No emergency message is currently stored.

steps.action: The RBC sends an emergency message to the OBU containing a specific identification number (NID_EM).
steps.expected: The OBU receives the message and stores it.

steps.action: The OBU processes the received emergency message.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement message (Message 147) to the RBC. The acknowledgement message contains the same identification number (NID_EM) as the received emergency message.

test_cases.title: OBU acknowledges a repeated emergency message with the same identifier
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, radio session with the supervising RBC is established. The OBU has already received and acknowledged an emergency message with identification number NID_EM_1.

steps.action: The RBC sends a new emergency message with the same identification number (NID_EM_1) as the previously received one.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the previous emergency message with the new one.

steps.action: The OBU processes the new emergency message.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement message to the RBC. The acknowledgement message contains the identification number NID_EM_1.

test_cases.title: Rejection of new MA after accepted conditional emergency stop
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established. Train is in a mode where it can accept a conditional emergency stop (e.g., OS or FS). A valid MA is currently active. The train has not passed the new stop location defined in the emergency stop message.
test_cases.test_inputs: 1. Conditional Emergency Stop message with a new stop location ahead of the train's min safe front end. 2. A new Movement Authority (MA) message with a valid EOA/LOA.

steps.action: Send a conditional emergency stop message to the OBU with a new stop location that is ahead of the train's current position (min safe front end).
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the emergency stop message. The new stop location is applied as a new EOA/SvL with no release speed (or as per 3.10.2.2 logic). The emergency stop is active.

steps.action: While the emergency stop is active and not yet revoked, send a new Movement Authority (MA) message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the new MA. The current supervision (based on the emergency stop) remains unchanged. The new MA is not applied.

test_cases.title: Rejection of new MA after accepted unconditional emergency stop
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established. Train is in a mode where it can accept an unconditional emergency stop (e.g., OS or FS). A valid MA is currently active.
test_cases.test_inputs: 1. Unconditional Emergency Stop message. 2. A new Movement Authority (MA) message with a valid EOA/LOA.

steps.action: Send an unconditional emergency stop message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the message and trips the train immediately (emergency brake applied). The emergency stop is active.

steps.action: While the emergency stop is active and not yet revoked, send a new Movement Authority (MA) message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the new MA. The train remains in the tripped state (or emergency brake state) and the new MA is not applied.

test_cases.title: Acceptance of new MA after emergency stop revocation
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established. Train is in a mode where it can accept a conditional emergency stop. A valid MA is currently active.
test_cases.test_inputs: 1. Conditional Emergency Stop message. 2. Revocation of the emergency stop. 3. A new Movement Authority (MA) message.

steps.action: Send a conditional emergency stop message to the OBU with a new stop location ahead of the train.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the emergency stop message. The emergency stop is active.

steps.action: Send a revocation message for the emergency stop to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU revokes the emergency stop. The previous supervision (or a new MA if provided with the revocation) is restored or the train is ready to accept a new MA.

steps.action: Send a new Movement Authority (MA) message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new MA. The new EOA/LOA is applied and the train can proceed according to the new MA.

test_cases.title: OBU acknowledges emergency message revocation with correct timestamp
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, mode FS, OS, LS or SM, radio session established with the RBC. An emergency message with a specific identifier has been previously received and acknowledged by the OBU.
test_cases.test_inputs: A revocation message from the RBC referring to the identifier of the previously received emergency message, containing a valid timestamp.

steps.action: The RBC sends a revocation message for the previously received emergency message.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the revocation message.

steps.action: The OBU processes the revocation message.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement message to the RBC.

steps.action: The OBU sends the acknowledgement message.
steps.expected: The acknowledgement message refers to the timestamp of the revocation message sent by the trackside.

test_cases.title: OBU does not acknowledge inconsistent revocation message
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, mode FS, OS, LS or SM, radio session established with the RBC. An emergency message with a specific identifier has been previously received and acknowledged by the OBU.
test_cases.test_inputs: A revocation message from the RBC that is considered inconsistent (e.g., invalid format or missing required fields).

steps.action: The RBC sends an inconsistent revocation message.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the revocation message.

steps.action: The OBU processes the revocation message.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send an acknowledgement message to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Trackside speed limit prevails over National value in On-Sight mode
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in On-Sight (OS) mode. National value for OS speed limit is 30 km/h. Trackside sends a Mode Profile with a speed limit of 20 km/h.

steps.action: Train enters the On-Sight area defined by the Mode Profile with the trackside speed limit of 20 km/h.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the trackside speed limit of 20 km/h as the mode-related speed restriction, overriding the National value of 30 km/h.

test_cases.title: Trackside speed limit prevails over National value in Limited Supervision mode
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Limited Supervision (LS) mode. National value for LS speed limit is 100 km/h. Trackside sends a Mode Profile with a speed limit of 80 km/h.

steps.action: Train enters the Limited Supervision area defined by the Mode Profile with the trackside speed limit of 80 km/h.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the trackside speed limit of 80 km/h as the mode-related speed restriction, overriding the National value of 100 km/h.

test_cases.title: Trackside speed limit prevails over National value in Shunting mode
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Shunting (SH) mode. National value for SH speed limit is 30 km/h. Trackside sends a Mode Profile with a speed limit of 15 km/h.

steps.action: Train enters the Shunting area defined by the Mode Profile with the trackside speed limit of 15 km/h.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the trackside speed limit of 15 km/h as the mode-related speed restriction, overriding the National value of 30 km/h.

test_cases.title: Trackside speed limit higher than National value is applied in On-Sight mode
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in On-Sight (OS) mode. National value for OS speed limit is 30 km/h. Trackside sends a Mode Profile with a speed limit of 40 km/h.

steps.action: Train enters the On-Sight area defined by the Mode Profile with the trackside speed limit of 40 km/h.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the trackside speed limit of 40 km/h as the mode-related speed restriction, overriding the National value of 30 km/h.

test_cases.title: Trackside speed limit higher than National value is applied in Limited Supervision mode
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Limited Supervision (LS) mode. National value for LS speed limit is 100 km/h. Trackside sends a Mode Profile with a speed limit of 120 km/h.

steps.action: Train enters the Limited Supervision area defined by the Mode Profile with the trackside speed limit of 120 km/h.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the trackside speed limit of 120 km/h as the mode-related speed restriction, overriding the National value of 100 km/h.

test_cases.title: Trackside speed limit higher than National value is applied in Shunting mode
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Shunting (SH) mode. National value for SH speed limit is 30 km/h. Trackside sends a Mode Profile with a speed limit of 35 km/h.

steps.action: Train enters the Shunting area defined by the Mode Profile with the trackside speed limit of 35 km/h.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the trackside speed limit of 35 km/h as the mode-related speed restriction, overriding the National value of 30 km/h.

test_cases.title: PBD speed restriction calculation upon receipt of trackside data
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where speed supervision is active (e.g., FS). No PBD speed restriction is currently active. Trackside is configured to send a valid PBD profile.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid PBD profile containing start/end locations, PBD distance, brake type (Emergency), and gradient.

steps.action: Transmit a valid PBD profile from trackside to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates and applies a speed restriction to ensure the permitted braking distance. The calculated speed restriction is visible in the speed profile.

test_cases.title: No recalculation when non-input parameters change
test_cases.preconditions: A PBD speed restriction is active based on a specific PBD profile. The train is moving.
test_cases.test_inputs: Changes to parameters not listed as inputs for PBD calculation (e.g., driver interface settings unrelated to train data, or environmental factors not part of the calculation inputs).
test_cases.assumptions: The specific parameters changed are not among the inputs defined in SUBSET-026 §3.11.11 for the PBD calculation.

steps.action: Change a parameter that is not an input to the PBD speed restriction calculation (e.g., adjust a non-critical display setting or change a train data field that does not affect braking performance).
steps.expected: The OBU does not recalculate the PBD speed restriction. The existing speed restriction value remains unchanged.

test_cases.title: Recalculation when a calculation input changes
test_cases.preconditions: A PBD speed restriction is active. The train data (e.g., mass or brake performance) is accessible for modification.
test_cases.test_inputs: A change to a train data parameter that affects braking performance (e.g., train mass or brake efficiency).

steps.action: Modify a train data parameter that is an input to the PBD calculation (e.g., change the train mass).
steps.expected: The OBU recalculates the PBD speed restriction. The new speed restriction value reflects the changed input.

test_cases.title: Verification of calculation assumptions for PBD speed restriction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where speed supervision is active. Trackside sends a PBD profile with known values for gradient, PBD distance, and brake type (Emergency).
test_cases.test_inputs: A PBD profile with specific values for gradient, PBD distance, and brake type. Train data with known rotating mass and brake characteristics.
test_cases.assumptions: The calculation method and constants (T41, T_bs1, T_bs2, T_traction, etc.) are known and can be verified against the expected output.

steps.action: Transmit a PBD profile with specific values for gradient, PBD distance, and brake type (Emergency).
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the PBD speed restriction using the specified assumptions: rotating-mass-compensated gradient, safe deceleration ignoring adhesion profiles and brake-inhibition/powerless-section conditions, EBD curve reaching zero speed at PBD distance, zero estimated acceleration, and fixed speed-inaccuracy, processing-delay, brake-feedback, and traction cut-off assumptions.

steps.action: Compare the calculated PBD speed restriction with the expected value derived from the specified assumptions.
steps.expected: The calculated speed restriction matches the expected value within the allowed tolerance.

test_cases.title: PBD speed restriction calculation for emergency brake
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where speed supervision is active. Trackside sends a PBD profile requiring the permitted braking distance to be respected using the emergency brake.
test_cases.test_inputs: A PBD profile with brake type set to Emergency and a PBD distance that allows a non-zero speed restriction.

steps.action: Transmit a PBD profile with brake type set to Emergency and a PBD distance that allows a non-zero speed restriction.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the PBD speed restriction as the speed satisfying the EBD-based inequalities of SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.6, rounded down as specified.

test_cases.title: PBD speed restriction set to zero when no speed satisfies inequalities
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where speed supervision is active. Trackside sends a PBD profile requiring the permitted braking distance to be respected using the emergency brake.
test_cases.test_inputs: A PBD profile with brake type set to Emergency and a PBD distance so short that no speed satisfies the EBD-based inequalities.

steps.action: Transmit a PBD profile with brake type set to Emergency and a PBD distance so short that no speed satisfies the EBD-based inequalities.
steps.expected: The OBU sets the PBD speed restriction to zero.

test_cases.title: Tunnel stopping area start indication uses estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: Level 1 or 2, mode FS/OS/LS/AD. A tunnel stopping area is stored on-board with a known start location (Point D). The train is moving towards the tunnel stopping area. The estimated front end position is known and distinct from the max safe front end.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'Tunnel Stopping Area announcement' is displayed when the estimated front end reaches the calculated Point C (which is in rear of Point D).

steps.action: The train moves such that the max safe front end passes the calculated Point C, but the estimated front end is still in rear of Point C.
steps.expected: The 'Tunnel Stopping Area announcement' is NOT displayed.
