test_cases.title: Password hint field is not available during activation
test_cases.preconditions: A new company representative is in the account activation flow.

steps.action: Navigate to the password creation step of the company representative activation process.
steps.expected: The form displays fields for the new password and confirmation, but does not display any field, checkbox, or option to enter or store a password hint.

steps.action: Submit the activation form with a valid password.
steps.expected: The account is activated successfully without any prompt or storage of a password hint.

test_cases.title: Password hint field is not available during password change
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account is logged in.

steps.action: Navigate to the 'Change Password' section in the account settings.
steps.expected: The form displays fields for the current password, new password, and confirmation, but does not display any field, checkbox, or option to enter or store a password hint.

steps.action: Submit the password change form with valid credentials.
steps.expected: The password is changed successfully without any prompt or storage of a password hint.

test_cases.title: No password hint is accessible on the sign-in page
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a password set.

steps.action: Open the portal sign-in page in a browser without being authenticated.
steps.expected: The sign-in form displays fields for username/email and password, but does not display any link, button, or text that provides a password hint or reminder for the user.

test_cases.title: Password selection flow does not include security questions
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account is in the password creation or change state.

steps.action: Initiate the password selection process for a company representative.
steps.expected: The interface displays fields for entering the new password and confirming it, but does not display any knowledge-based authentication questions or security questions (e.g., 'What was the name of your first pet?').

steps.action: Enter a valid password that meets length and blocklist requirements and submit the form.
steps.expected: The password is accepted without requiring answers to any security questions.

test_cases.title: Verification of a long password without truncation
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account with a known password of at least 64 characters that is not on the blocklist.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid password of 64 characters.

steps.action: Log in to the VBP portal using the company representative's username and the full 64-character password.
steps.expected: The system accepts the login and establishes a session, confirming that the entire password was verified without truncation.

test_cases.title: Rejection of a truncated password
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account with a known password of at least 64 characters.
test_cases.test_inputs: A password string that is a prefix of the valid password, shorter than the full length.

steps.action: Log in to the VBP portal using the company representative's username and a password that is a truncated version of the valid password (e.g., missing the last 10 characters).
steps.expected: The system rejects the login attempt with an authentication error, confirming that the system does not accept a subset of the password.

test_cases.title: Blocklisted password rejection during establishment
test_cases.preconditions: A new company representative account is being created (activation step). The blocklist contains a known compromised password of at least 15 characters.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid username and a password that is on the blocklist (e.g., a common breached password) and meets the minimum length requirement.

steps.action: Submit the registration form with a valid username and a password that is known to be on the blocklist.
steps.expected: The system rejects the password and does not create the account with that password.

steps.action: Observe the feedback message displayed to the user.
steps.expected: The system displays a message indicating the password is not allowed (e.g., 'commonly used' or 'compromised') and requests a new password.

test_cases.title: Blocklisted password rejection during change
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account exists. The user is authenticated and on the password change screen. The blocklist contains a known common password of at least 15 characters.
test_cases.test_inputs: The current valid password and a new password that is on the blocklist.

steps.action: Enter the current password and a new password that is known to be on the blocklist, then submit the change request.
steps.expected: The system rejects the new password and the account password remains unchanged.

steps.action: Observe the feedback message displayed to the user.
steps.expected: The system displays a message indicating the new password is not allowed and requests a different password.

test_cases.title: Acceptance of strong password not on blocklist
test_cases.preconditions: A new company representative account is being created (activation step). A candidate password of at least 15 characters is known not to be on the blocklist.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid username and a strong, unique password of at least 15 characters not present in the blocklist.

steps.action: Submit the registration form with a valid username and a strong password that is not on the blocklist.
steps.expected: The system accepts the password and proceeds with account creation.

test_cases.title: Entire password matches blocklist entry
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account exists. A known compromised password (e.g., 'password123456789') is present in the VBP blocklist.

steps.action: Attempt to change the representative's password to the exact string found in the blocklist.
steps.expected: The system rejects the password and indicates that it is on the blocklist.

test_cases.title: Password contains blocklisted substring but is not an exact match
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account exists. The string 'password' is in the blocklist. The candidate password is 'MySecurePassword12345' which contains 'password' as a substring but is not itself in the blocklist.
test_cases.assumptions: The blocklist comparison is performed on the full string, not on substrings.

steps.action: Attempt to change the representative's password to a string that contains a blocklisted word as a substring but is not itself a blocklisted entry.
steps.expected: The system accepts the password, as the full string is not in the blocklist.

test_cases.title: Password is a blocklisted word with added characters
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account exists. The word 'admin' is in the blocklist. The candidate password is 'admin123456789012' which starts with the blocklisted word but is longer and not an exact match.
test_cases.assumptions: The blocklist does not contain 'admin123456789012'.

steps.action: Attempt to change the representative's password to a string that begins with a blocklisted word but has additional characters appended.
steps.expected: The system accepts the password, as the full string is not in the blocklist.

test_cases.title: Rejection of a blocklisted password with reason display
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account is available for password change. A candidate password of at least 15 characters is known to be on the VBP blocklist (e.g., a common breached password).

steps.action: Initiate a password change for the company representative account.
steps.expected: The password change form is displayed.

steps.action: Enter the blocklisted candidate password and submit the form.
steps.expected: VBP rejects the password and displays a message stating the reason for rejection (e.g., 'password is too common' or 'password is on the blocklist').

steps.action: Verify that the password field is cleared or allows re-entry, and that the account password has not been changed.
steps.expected: The user is required to select a different password; the old password remains valid.

test_cases.title: Rejection of a context-specific blocklisted password with reason display
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account is available for password change. A candidate password of at least 15 characters is constructed using context-specific words (e.g., service name 'VatandasBasvuruPortali' or organization name) and is known to be on the VBP blocklist.

steps.action: Initiate a password change for the company representative account.
steps.expected: The password change form is displayed.

steps.action: Enter the context-specific blocklisted candidate password and submit the form.
steps.expected: VBP rejects the password and displays a message stating the reason for rejection (e.g., 'password contains context-specific words' or 'password is on the blocklist').

steps.action: Verify that the user is prompted to select a different password.
steps.expected: The password change is not completed; the user must provide a new password.

test_cases.title: Guidance displayed after blocklist rejection
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account is at the password change or activation step. A password known to be on the blocklist (e.g., a common breached password) is available for testing.
test_cases.test_inputs: A password that is on the blocklist and meets the minimum length requirement.

steps.action: Enter a password that is on the blocklist and submit it.
steps.expected: The system rejects the password and displays a message indicating the reason for rejection (e.g., 'password is too common' or 'password is compromised').

steps.action: Observe the interface immediately following the rejection message.
steps.expected: Guidance on choosing a strong password is displayed to the representative. The guidance should be specific to helping the user choose a stronger password, not just a generic error.

test_cases.title: Guidance displayed during initial password setup
test_cases.preconditions: A new company representative account is being activated for the first time.

steps.action: Navigate to the password creation screen during account activation.
steps.expected: Guidance on choosing a strong password is visible on the screen before any input is submitted.

test_cases.title: Password manager autofill on login page
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a password stored in a password manager configured for the portal's domain.
test_cases.assumptions: The browser supports standard password manager autofill APIs.

steps.action: Navigate to the company representative login page.
steps.expected: The password field is present and accessible.

steps.action: Trigger the browser's password manager autofill for the password field.
steps.expected: The password manager successfully populates the password field with the stored credential.

steps.action: Submit the login form.
steps.expected: The system accepts the autofilled password and logs the user in successfully.

test_cases.title: Password manager autofill on password change page
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative is logged in and has access to the password change page. A new password is stored in the password manager.
test_cases.assumptions: The browser supports standard password manager autofill APIs.

steps.action: Navigate to the password change page.
steps.expected: The new password field is present and accessible.

steps.action: Trigger the browser's password manager autofill for the new password field.
steps.expected: The password manager successfully populates the new password field with the stored credential.

steps.action: Submit the password change form.
steps.expected: The system accepts the autofilled password and updates the account password.

test_cases.title: Paste functionality on password entry pages
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists. A valid password is copied to the clipboard.
test_cases.assumptions: The browser allows paste operations into password fields.

steps.action: Navigate to the company representative login page.
steps.expected: The password field is present and accessible.

steps.action: Click on the password field and paste the copied password from the clipboard.
steps.expected: The pasted password appears in the field (masked or visible depending on UI settings) and is not blocked by the browser or application.

steps.action: Submit the login form.
steps.expected: The system accepts the pasted password and logs the user in successfully.

test_cases.title: Recovery of AAL2 account using two recovery codes from different methods
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account configured for AAL2 authentication. The account has a saved recovery code and a recovery contact configured. The user is in a locked-out or password-reset state requiring recovery.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid saved recovery code, valid recovery contact verification (e.g., code sent to email/SMS).
test_cases.assumptions: The system supports both 'saved recovery codes' and 'recovery contacts' as distinct recovery methods.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process for the AAL2 account.
steps.expected: The system presents options for recovery methods, including the use of recovery codes and recovery contacts.

steps.action: Select the option to use a saved recovery code and enter the valid saved recovery code.
steps.expected: The system accepts the first recovery code and prompts for a second recovery method or code from a different source.

steps.action: Select the option to use a recovery contact and complete the verification process (e.g., enter the code sent to the registered email).
steps.expected: The system accepts the second recovery method. The account recovery is successful, and the user is allowed to reset their password or re-authenticate.

test_cases.title: Recovery of AAL2 account using one recovery code and a bound single-factor authenticator
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account configured for AAL2 authentication. The account has a saved recovery code and a bound single-factor authenticator (e.g., password or TOTP) that is currently accessible for verification.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid saved recovery code, valid single-factor authenticator credentials (e.g., current password or TOTP code).
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows the combination of a recovery code and a single-factor authenticator for AAL2 recovery.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process for the AAL2 account.
steps.expected: The system presents options for recovery methods.

steps.action: Select the option to use a recovery code and enter the valid saved recovery code.
steps.expected: The system accepts the recovery code and prompts for authentication with a bound single-factor authenticator.

steps.action: Provide the valid single-factor authenticator credentials (e.g., enter the current password or TOTP code).
steps.expected: The system verifies the single-factor authenticator. The account recovery is successful, and the user is allowed to reset their password or re-authenticate.

test_cases.title: Recovery of AAL2 account using repeated identity proofing
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account configured for AAL2 authentication that has previously undergone identity proofing. The user has access to the required identity documents for re-proofing.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid identity documents (e.g., national ID, passport) and biometric data if required by the proofing process.
test_cases.assumptions: The system supports 'repeated identity proofing' as a recovery method for AAL2 accounts that were previously identity-proofed.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process for the AAL2 account and select the 'repeated identity proofing' option.
steps.expected: The system initiates the identity proofing workflow, requesting identity documents and/or biometric verification.

steps.action: Submit the required identity documents and complete the biometric verification steps as prompted.
steps.expected: The system verifies the identity. The account recovery is successful, and the user is allowed to reset their password or re-authenticate.

test_cases.title: Recovery of AAL2 account fails with only one recovery code
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account configured for AAL2 authentication. The account has a saved recovery code.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid saved recovery code.
test_cases.assumptions: The system enforces the requirement for two distinct methods or a code plus single-factor auth for AAL2 recovery.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process for the AAL2 account.
steps.expected: The system presents options for recovery methods.

steps.action: Select the option to use a recovery code and enter the valid saved recovery code.
steps.expected: The system accepts the recovery code but does not complete the recovery. It prompts for a second recovery method (different code source) or a single-factor authenticator.

steps.action: Attempt to finalize the recovery without providing the second required factor or method.
steps.expected: The system rejects the recovery attempt and displays an error message indicating that insufficient recovery factors were provided.

test_cases.title: Recovery of AAL2 account fails with two recovery codes from the same method
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account configured for AAL2 authentication. The account has multiple saved recovery codes available.
test_cases.test_inputs: Two valid saved recovery codes.
test_cases.assumptions: The system distinguishes between 'saved recovery codes' and other methods like 'recovery contacts' or 'issued codes'. Using two saved codes is considered the same method.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process for the AAL2 account.
steps.expected: The system presents options for recovery methods.

steps.action: Select the option to use a saved recovery code and enter the first valid saved recovery code.
steps.expected: The system accepts the first code and prompts for a second recovery method.

steps.action: Select the option to use another saved recovery code and enter the second valid saved recovery code.
steps.expected: The system rejects the second code because it is from the same method (saved recovery codes) as the first. It displays an error stating that two different methods are required.

test_cases.title: Disabling multiple authenticators when both reach the failure threshold
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account with a password and a second factor (e.g., TOTP) bound. The failure threshold is 50 consecutive attempts per authenticator.

steps.action: Make 50 consecutive failed authentication attempts using the password on the account.
steps.expected: The password authenticator is disabled.

steps.action: Make 50 consecutive failed authentication attempts using the second factor (e.g., TOTP) on the same account.
steps.expected: The second factor authenticator is disabled.

steps.action: Attempt to authenticate using the correct password and a valid second factor code.
steps.expected: Authentication fails; both authenticators remain disabled.

test_cases.title: Disabling only the authenticator that reaches the threshold
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account with a password and a second factor (e.g., TOTP) bound. The failure threshold is 50 consecutive attempts per authenticator.

steps.action: Make 50 consecutive failed authentication attempts using the password on the account.
steps.expected: The password authenticator is disabled.

steps.action: Make 10 consecutive failed authentication attempts using the second factor (e.g., TOTP) on the same account.
steps.expected: The second factor authenticator remains active.

steps.action: Attempt to authenticate using the correct password and a valid second factor code.
steps.expected: Authentication fails because the password is disabled, but the second factor is not disabled.

test_cases.title: Disabled authenticator requires re-binding before use
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account with a password and a TOTP authenticator bound. The failed-attempt threshold (50) is known. The TOTP authenticator has been disabled by reaching the threshold.

steps.action: Attempt to sign in using the disabled TOTP authenticator (enter a valid TOTP code).
steps.expected: Authentication fails. The system indicates that the authenticator is disabled and must be re-bound.

steps.action: Initiate the re-binding process for the TOTP authenticator, authenticating with the still-active password authenticator as required by the binding process.
steps.expected: The re-binding process is allowed to start. The system verifies the identity using the active password authenticator.

steps.action: Complete the re-binding of the TOTP authenticator to the account.
steps.expected: The TOTP authenticator is successfully re-bound to the account and its status changes to active.

steps.action: Attempt to sign in using the re-bound TOTP authenticator (enter a valid TOTP code).
steps.expected: Authentication succeeds. The representative is logged in.

test_cases.title: Disabled authenticator cannot be used without re-binding
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account with a password and a TOTP authenticator bound. The TOTP authenticator has been disabled by reaching the failed-attempt threshold.

steps.action: Attempt to sign in using the disabled TOTP authenticator (enter a valid TOTP code) without performing any re-binding action.
steps.expected: Authentication fails. The system does not accept the TOTP code and does not log the user in.

steps.action: Check the account status or authenticator list in the user interface.
steps.expected: The TOTP authenticator is shown as disabled or unavailable for authentication until re-bound.

test_cases.title: AAL2 altında gelen federasyon yanıtının sınırlı kipte işlenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: VBP, e-Devlet test ortamına entegredir. Test e-Devlet IdP'si, 'acr' değerini AAL2'nin altında (örneğin AAL1) raporlayacak şekilde yapılandırılabilir. Bir test vatandaş hesabı mevcuttur.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP'nin 'sınırlı kip' davranışı, kişisel veri ve başvuru içeriğinin gizlenmesi ve daha güçlü doğrulama önerisinin gösterilmesi olarak tanımlanmıştır.

steps.action: Vatandaş, e-Devlet üzerinden giriş yapar; test IdP'si AAL2'nin altında bir 'acr' değeri içeren bir kimlik belirteci döndürür.
steps.expected: VBP oturumu 'sınırlı kip'te açar; kişisel veri ve başvuru içeriği gösterilmez, kullanıcıya daha güçlü bir yöntemle yeniden giriş yapması önerilir.

test_cases.title: Gerekli xAL değerlerini karşılamayan yanıtın reddedilmesi veya yönlendirilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: VBP, e-Devlet test ortamına entegredir. Test e-Devlet IdP'si, VBP'nin gerektirdiği minimum IAL/AAL/FAL değerlerini karşılamayan bir yanıt üretecek şekilde yapılandırılabilir (örneğin, gerekli FAL2'yi karşılamayan bir federasyon parametresi).
test_cases.assumptions: VBP'nin 'tanımlı mekanizma'sı, gereksinimlerde belirtildiği gibi isteği reddetmek veya istisna işleme sürecine yönlendirmek şeklindedir. Test, bu mekanizmanın tetiklendiğini gözlemlemek için tasarlanmıştır.

steps.action: Vatandaş, e-Devlet üzerinden giriş yapar; test IdP'si, VBP'nin gerektirdiği minimum xAL değerlerini (IAL, AAL veya FAL) karşılamayan bir yanıt döndürür.
steps.expected: VBP isteği reddeder veya vatandaşı VBP Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §4.2'de tanımlanan istisna işleme sürecine yönlendirir; tam yetkili bir oturum açılmaz.

test_cases.title: Gerekli xAL değerlerini karşılayan yanıtın kabul edilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: VBP, e-Devlet test ortamına entegredir. Test e-Devlet IdP'si, VBP'nin gerektirdiği minimum IAL/AAL/FAL değerlerini karşılayan (örneğin AAL2 ve FAL2) bir yanıt üretecek şekilde yapılandırılmıştır.

steps.action: Vatandaş, e-Devlet üzerinden giriş yapar; test IdP'si, VBP'nin gerektirdiği minimum xAL değerlerini karşılayan bir yanıt döndürür.
steps.expected: VBP yanıtı kabul eder ve vatandaşa tam yetkili bir oturum açar; sınırlı kip veya istisna işleme süreci devreye girmez.

test_cases.title: Session AAL does not exceed the authentication event AAL
test_cases.preconditions: A citizen account with AAL1 (password only) and AAL2 (password + second factor) capabilities. The portal allows selecting the authentication level during sign-in.
test_cases.assumptions: The system exposes the current session AAL level in a debug header or admin view for verification purposes.

steps.action: Sign in to VBP using only the password (AAL1 authentication event).
steps.expected: The session is established. The session AAL is reported as AAL1.

steps.action: While in the AAL1 session, attempt to access a resource that requires AAL2 (e.g., a sensitive application or profile change).
steps.expected: Access is denied or the user is prompted to re-authenticate at AAL2. The session does not automatically upgrade to AAL2 without a new authentication event.

steps.action: Sign in to VBP using password and second factor (AAL2 authentication event).
steps.expected: The session is established. The session AAL is reported as AAL2.

steps.action: While in the AAL2 session, access a resource that requires only AAL1.
steps.expected: Access is granted. The session remains at AAL2 (or is treated as satisfying AAL1), but is not downgraded in a way that invalidates the higher trust level for subsequent AAL2 checks.

test_cases.title: Session AAL is not elevated by subsequent low-AAL actions
test_cases.preconditions: A citizen account with AAL1 and AAL2 capabilities. An active AAL1 session is established.
test_cases.assumptions: The system exposes the current session AAL level for verification.

steps.action: Sign in using only the password (AAL1).
steps.expected: Session AAL is AAL1.

steps.action: Perform a non-authentication action that might be misinterpreted as re-authentication (e.g., re-entering the password in a 'change password' form without completing the full AAL2 flow, or submitting a form that includes the password field).
steps.expected: The session AAL remains AAL1. It does not upgrade to AAL2.

steps.action: Attempt to access an AAL2-protected resource.
steps.expected: Access is denied or a full AAL2 re-authentication is required. The previous action did not elevate the session.

test_cases.title: Authenticated session does not fall back to HTTP
test_cases.preconditions: A valid user account exists. The user is authenticated via HTTPS.

steps.action: Authenticate as a user via an HTTPS URL.
steps.expected: The session is established over HTTPS.

steps.action: Attempt to access a protected resource by manually changing the URL scheme from HTTPS to HTTP while the session is active.
steps.expected: The request is rejected or redirected back to HTTPS; the session is not served over insecure HTTP transport.

test_cases.title: Bot detection blocks automated proofing attempts
test_cases.preconditions: A test environment with automated attack protections (bot detection) enabled for the company representative identity proofing process. A script or tool capable of simulating automated browser behavior (e.g., headless browser or API client without proper browser fingerprinting).
test_cases.test_inputs: Automated request payload simulating a bot attempting to initiate the identity proofing flow.
test_cases.assumptions: The system's bot detection mechanism is configured to block or challenge requests identified as automated.

steps.action: Initiate the company representative identity proofing process using an automated tool that mimics bot behavior (e.g., missing browser headers, rapid sequential requests, or known bot signatures).
steps.expected: The system detects the automated attempt and blocks the request or presents a challenge (e.g., CAPTCHA) that prevents the automated process from proceeding to the next step.

steps.action: Verify the system logs or monitoring dashboard for the blocked attempt.
steps.expected: The event is logged as a blocked automated attack or bot detection trigger, confirming the mitigation was active.

test_cases.title: Web Application Firewall blocks malicious input in proofing forms
test_cases.preconditions: A test environment with WAF settings enabled for the company representative identity proofing process. Access to the proofing form fields.
test_cases.test_inputs: A form submission containing a known SQL injection or XSS payload in a text field (e.g., name or address field).
test_cases.assumptions: The WAF is configured to inspect and block common web attack patterns in form data.

steps.action: Submit the company representative identity proofing form with a malicious payload (e.g., `<script>alert('xss')</script>` or `' OR 1=1 --`) in a standard text input field.
steps.expected: The WAF intercepts the request and returns a block page or error response, preventing the payload from reaching the application backend.

steps.action: Check the WAF logs for the intercepted request.
steps.expected: The log entry shows the request was blocked due to a detected web attack pattern (e.g., XSS or SQLi rule match).

test_cases.title: Behavioral analytics flags abnormal user behavior during proofing
test_cases.preconditions: A test environment with behavioral analytics enabled. A valid company representative account or test applicant profile. Access to the proofing flow.
test_cases.test_inputs: A sequence of user actions that deviate significantly from normal human behavior (e.g., completing all form fields in under 1 second, or navigating the flow in an illogical order).
test_cases.assumptions: The behavioral analytics system is configured to flag or block sessions with high-risk behavioral indicators.

steps.action: Perform the company representative identity proofing flow with abnormal behavior, such as auto-filling all fields instantly or skipping steps in a way that is not possible via the UI.
steps.expected: The system flags the session as suspicious. Depending on configuration, the flow is interrupted, a challenge is presented, or the session is terminated.

steps.action: Review the behavioral analytics report or security log for the session.
steps.expected: The session is recorded with a high-risk score or specific anomaly flags (e.g., 'rapid input', 'impossible navigation').

test_cases.title: Network traffic analysis detects and blocks high-risk IP addresses
test_cases.preconditions: A test environment with network traffic analysis enabled. Access to configure or simulate traffic from a known high-risk or blocklisted IP address.
test_cases.test_inputs: A request to the company representative identity proofing endpoint originating from a known malicious or blocklisted IP address.
test_cases.assumptions: The system maintains a list of high-risk or blocklisted IP addresses and actively filters traffic from them.

steps.action: Send a request to initiate the company representative identity proofing process from an IP address that is on the system's blocklist or identified as high-risk by the traffic analysis module.
steps.expected: The request is blocked or dropped by the network traffic analysis component before reaching the application layer.

steps.action: Check the network security logs.
steps.expected: The log shows the request was rejected due to the source IP being on the blocklist or flagged as high-risk.

test_cases.title: TOTP code is rejected upon second submission within validity window
test_cases.preconditions: An active user account with TOTP bound as a second factor. The tester has access to the TOTP authenticator app and can generate valid codes.

steps.action: Initiate an authentication session and submit a currently valid TOTP code.
steps.expected: The system accepts the code and completes the authentication step.

steps.action: Immediately initiate a new authentication session and submit the same TOTP code again while it is still within its validity period (within the 59-second window).
steps.expected: The system rejects the code and denies authentication.

test_cases.title: Replacement saved recovery code issuance triggers account recovery notification
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account with a registered non-postal notification address (e.g., e-mail) that the tester can access. The representative is authenticated in a session that allows account management actions.

steps.action: Request a replacement for the current saved recovery code from the account management interface.
steps.expected: The system issues a new saved recovery code and invalidates the previous one.

steps.action: Check the registered notification address (e.g., e-mail inbox) for a message.
steps.expected: An account recovery notification is received, indicating that a recovery code replacement has occurred.

test_cases.title: Invalidation of used saved recovery code and issuance of new code
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account with a valid saved recovery code. The tester has access to the account's notification channels to verify the new code issuance.
test_cases.test_inputs: The current valid saved recovery code.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process for the company representative and submit the current valid saved recovery code.
steps.expected: The recovery process is successful, and the account is recovered.

steps.action: Check the account's saved recovery code status in the system or via the notification channel.
steps.expected: The previously used recovery code is marked as invalid, and a new saved recovery code has been issued to the representative.

steps.action: Attempt to use the previously used (now invalid) saved recovery code in a new recovery attempt.
steps.expected: The system rejects the code and indicates that it is no longer valid.

test_cases.title: Accessing account information with valid AAL2 authentication
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account with a password and a second factor (e.g., TOTP) bound. The representative is not currently authenticated.

steps.action: Initiate sign-in as the company representative using the correct password.
steps.expected: The system prompts for the second authentication factor.

steps.action: Provide the correct second factor (e.g., TOTP code).
steps.expected: Authentication completes successfully at AAL2.

steps.action: Navigate to a page containing personal information in the representative's account.
steps.expected: The personal information is displayed and accessible.

test_cases.title: Accessing account information with valid AAL3 authentication
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account configured for AAL3 with a phishing-resistant authenticator (e.g., passkey) and a password. The representative is not currently authenticated.
test_cases.assumptions: The test environment supports AAL3 authentication methods.

steps.action: Initiate sign-in as the company representative using the correct password.
steps.expected: The system prompts for the AAL3 authenticator (e.g., biometric or PIN for passkey).

steps.action: Complete the AAL3 authentication step using the registered authenticator.
steps.expected: Authentication completes successfully at AAL3.

steps.action: Navigate to a page containing personal information in the representative's account.
steps.expected: The personal information is displayed and accessible.

test_cases.title: Attempting to access account information with AAL1 authentication only
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account with a password and a second factor bound. The representative is not currently authenticated.

steps.action: Initiate sign-in as the company representative using the correct password.
steps.expected: The system prompts for the second authentication factor.

steps.action: Attempt to bypass the second factor step or terminate the authentication process after the password step, then attempt to access a URL containing personal information directly.
steps.expected: Access to the personal information is denied. The system does not establish an authenticated session sufficient to view personal data.

test_cases.title: Attempting to access account information with an unregistered authenticator
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account with a password and a second factor (e.g., TOTP) bound. A second, unregistered TOTP app or passkey is available for testing.

steps.action: Initiate sign-in as the company representative using the correct password.
steps.expected: The system prompts for the second authentication factor.

steps.action: Provide a code from the unregistered TOTP app or attempt to use the unregistered passkey.
steps.expected: Authentication fails. The system indicates that the authenticator is not recognized or registered to the account.

steps.action: Attempt to access a page containing personal information in the representative's account.
steps.expected: Access is denied. No authenticated session is established.

test_cases.title: Notification sent upon update of non-core attribute
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account at AAL2 with a registered notification address (e.g., email) that the tester can access. The account has at least one non-core attribute (e.g., phone number or preferred language) that can be updated directly by the subscriber.

steps.action: Sign in as the company representative and navigate to the account settings.
steps.expected: The account settings page is displayed with the current values of the attributes.

steps.action: Update a non-core attribute (e.g., change the mobile phone number) and save the changes.
steps.expected: The system confirms the update and sends a notification to the registered notification address informing the representative of the change.

steps.action: Check the registered notification address (e.g., email inbox).
steps.expected: A notification message is received detailing the update made to the account information.

test_cases.title: Notification sent upon update of core attribute after validation
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account at AAL2 with a registered notification address. The account has a core attribute (e.g., email address or name) that requires validation for changes.
test_cases.assumptions: The system supports a validation mechanism (e.g., OTP or document upload) for core attribute changes.

steps.action: Sign in as the company representative and request an update to a core attribute (e.g., change the primary email address).
steps.expected: The system initiates the validation process for the new core attribute value.

steps.action: Complete the validation process for the new core attribute value.
steps.expected: The system accepts the new value and updates the account record.

steps.action: Check the registered notification address.
steps.expected: A notification message is received informing the representative that the core attribute information in their account has been updated.

test_cases.title: Reporting unauthorized access via the account interface
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account at AAL2, authenticated within the last 5 minutes, with access to the account dashboard.

steps.action: Navigate to the account security or settings section and locate the option to report unauthorized access or potential compromise.
steps.expected: A clear option or form to report unauthorized access or potential compromise is visible and accessible.

steps.action: Submit a report describing a suspected unauthorized access event (e.g., 'I noticed a login from an unknown location').
steps.expected: The system accepts the report and displays a confirmation message indicating that the report has been received.

test_cases.title: Reporting potential compromise of account information
test_cases.preconditions: An active company representative account at AAL2, authenticated within the last 5 minutes.

steps.action: Access the account reporting mechanism and select the option for 'potential compromise of information'.
steps.expected: The system provides a specific channel or form field to detail the potential compromise.

steps.action: Submit the report with details about the suspected data exposure.
steps.expected: The system confirms the submission and logs the report for review by the security team.

test_cases.title: Attempting to report without authentication
test_cases.preconditions: No active session; user is not logged in.

steps.action: Attempt to access the URL or interface for reporting unauthorized access while unauthenticated.
steps.expected: The system redirects to the login page or displays an authentication error; the reporting form is not accessible.

test_cases.title: Generic error message on unexpected server error
test_cases.preconditions: A test environment where an internal server error (e.g., 500) can be triggered, such as by accessing a malformed URL or simulating a backend failure.
test_cases.test_inputs: A request that triggers an internal server error (e.g., invalid parameter causing a 500).

steps.action: Send a request to the portal that triggers an unexpected internal server error.
steps.expected: The response body contains a generic error message (e.g., 'An unexpected error occurred') and does not contain stack traces, SQL queries, secret keys, tokens, or version numbers.

steps.action: Inspect the HTTP response headers and body for any sensitive internal details.
steps.expected: No internal system details such as server version, framework version, or database connection strings are exposed in the response.

test_cases.title: Generic error message on security-sensitive error
test_cases.preconditions: A valid user account and a way to trigger a security-sensitive error, such as an authorization failure or a failed external dependency call that results in an error.
test_cases.test_inputs: A request that triggers a security-sensitive error (e.g., accessing a resource without permission or a failed external service call).

steps.action: Trigger a security-sensitive error, such as attempting to access a resource for which the user does not have permission.
steps.expected: The response body contains a generic error message and does not expose details about the authorization logic, internal resource identifiers, or system architecture.

steps.action: Check the response for any hints about the specific cause of the security error.
steps.expected: The message does not reveal whether the error was due to missing permissions, invalid token, or other internal security mechanisms.

test_cases.title: Session cookie has HttpOnly attribute and is set via Set-Cookie header
test_cases.preconditions: A valid user account exists. An intercepting proxy or browser developer tools are available to inspect HTTP headers and cookies.

steps.action: Sign in to the portal with valid credentials.
steps.expected: The response contains a 'Set-Cookie' header for the session cookie. The cookie attributes include 'HttpOnly'. The session token value is not present in the HTML body or JavaScript variables.

steps.action: Inspect the session cookie in the browser's cookie store or via the proxy.
steps.expected: The session cookie is marked as HttpOnly, preventing access via document.cookie in client-side scripts.

test_cases.title: Non-session cookies not meant for scripts have HttpOnly attribute
test_cases.preconditions: The portal sets at least one non-session cookie that contains sensitive data or is not intended for client-side script access (e.g., a CSRF token cookie if not exposed to JS, or a preference cookie marked as sensitive). If no such cookie exists, this test verifies that no non-HttpOnly cookie contains sensitive session data.
test_cases.assumptions: If the portal does not set any other cookies besides the session cookie, this test case is considered passed by default as there are no other cookies to check for HttpOnly compliance regarding sensitive data.

steps.action: Perform a standard interaction that triggers the setting of any additional cookies (e.g., saving preferences or loading a specific page).
steps.expected: Any cookie set that is not intended to be accessible by client-side scripts (such as a security token) has the 'HttpOnly' attribute set in the 'Set-Cookie' header.

steps.action: Verify that the session token is not exposed in any other cookie or client-side accessible storage.
steps.expected: The session token is only transferred via the 'Set-Cookie' header for the session cookie and is not present in other cookies or JavaScript-accessible storage.

test_cases.title: Strict-Transport-Security header present on all responses
test_cases.preconditions: Access to the portal via HTTPS. An intercepting proxy or browser developer tools are available to inspect response headers.
test_cases.assumptions: The VBP Software Design Document §14 specifies a maximum age of at least 1 year (31536000 seconds) and includes the 'includeSubDomains' directive.

steps.action: Request the main portal page (e.g., /) over HTTPS.
steps.expected: The HTTP response includes a 'Strict-Transport-Security' header. The 'max-age' value is at least 31536000. The 'includeSubDomains' directive is present.

steps.action: Request a static asset (e.g., a CSS or JS file) over HTTPS.
steps.expected: The HTTP response includes a 'Strict-Transport-Security' header with the same max-age and includeSubDomains directives.

steps.action: Request an API endpoint (e.g., /api/status) over HTTPS.
steps.expected: The HTTP response includes a 'Strict-Transport-Security' header with the same max-age and includeSubDomains directives.

test_cases.title: Strict-Transport-Security header on error responses
test_cases.preconditions: Access to the portal via HTTPS. An intercepting proxy or browser developer tools are available to inspect response headers.
test_cases.assumptions: The VBP Software Design Document §14 specifies a maximum age of at least 1 year (31536000 seconds) and includes the 'includeSubDomains' directive.

steps.action: Request a non-existent resource (e.g., /nonexistent-page) over HTTPS.
steps.expected: The HTTP 404 response includes a 'Strict-Transport-Security' header with the correct max-age and includeSubDomains directives.

steps.action: Send a malformed request that triggers a server error (e.g., 500) over HTTPS.
steps.expected: The HTTP 500 response includes a 'Strict-Transport-Security' header with the correct max-age and includeSubDomains directives.

test_cases.title: Valid file upload with matching extension and content
test_cases.preconditions: User is signed in and has permission to upload files. A valid PDF file with a .pdf extension is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid PDF file named 'document.pdf'.

steps.action: Upload the valid PDF file 'document.pdf' through the file upload interface.
steps.expected: The file is accepted and stored successfully. No error message is displayed.

test_cases.title: File upload with mismatched extension and content
test_cases.preconditions: User is signed in and has permission to upload files. A file containing executable content (e.g., a script or binary) is renamed to have a .pdf extension.
test_cases.test_inputs: A file with executable content renamed to 'malicious.pdf'.

steps.action: Upload the file 'malicious.pdf' which contains executable content but has a .pdf extension.
steps.expected: The upload is rejected. An error message indicating that the file content does not match the extension is displayed.

test_cases.title: File upload with unexpected extension
test_cases.preconditions: User is signed in and has permission to upload files. A file with an extension not in the allowed list (e.g., .exe) is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: A file named 'program.exe'.

steps.action: Upload the file 'program.exe'.
steps.expected: The upload is rejected. An error message indicating that the file extension is not allowed is displayed.

test_cases.title: Image upload within maximum pixel size
test_cases.preconditions: User is signed in and has permission to upload images. A valid image file with pixel dimensions below the maximum defined in VBP Software Design Document §14 is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid image file (e.g., 1000x1000 pixels) named 'valid_image.jpg'.
test_cases.assumptions: The maximum pixel size defined in VBP Software Design Document §14 is greater than 1000x1000.

steps.action: Upload the image file 'valid_image.jpg' with dimensions below the maximum allowed size.
steps.expected: The image is accepted and stored successfully. No error message is displayed.

test_cases.title: Image upload exceeding maximum pixel size
test_cases.preconditions: User is signed in and has permission to upload images. A valid image file with pixel dimensions exceeding the maximum defined in VBP Software Design Document §14 is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid image file (e.g., 10000x10000 pixels) named 'large_image.jpg'.
test_cases.assumptions: The maximum pixel size defined in VBP Software Design Document §14 is less than 10000x10000.

steps.action: Upload the image file 'large_image.jpg' with dimensions exceeding the maximum allowed size.
steps.expected: The upload is rejected. An error message indicating that the image pixel size exceeds the maximum allowed limit is displayed.

test_cases.title: Failed sign-in responses do not reveal user existence
test_cases.preconditions: A valid registered user account and an unregistered user identifier are available for testing.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid user credentials, invalid user credentials, unregistered user identifier.

steps.action: Attempt sign-in with a valid user identifier and an incorrect password.
steps.expected: The system returns a generic error message (e.g., 'Invalid credentials') and an HTTP 401 status code.

steps.action: Attempt sign-in with an unregistered user identifier and an arbitrary password.
steps.expected: The system returns the same generic error message and HTTP 401 status code as in step 1.

steps.action: Compare the response times of the requests from step 1 and step 2.
steps.expected: The response times are statistically indistinguishable, preventing user enumeration via timing attacks.

test_cases.title: Registration and forgotten-password responses do not reveal user existence
test_cases.preconditions: A valid registered user email address and an unregistered email address are available for testing.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid registered email, unregistered email.

steps.action: Submit a registration request with an already registered email address.
steps.expected: The system returns a generic response (e.g., 'Registration submitted' or 'Check your email') without explicitly stating the email is already in use, and returns a standard HTTP status code (e.g., 200 or 202).

steps.action: Submit a registration request with an unregistered email address.
steps.expected: The system returns the same generic response and HTTP status code as in step 1.

steps.action: Submit a forgotten-password request for a valid registered email address.
steps.expected: The system returns a generic message (e.g., 'If an account exists, a reset link has been sent') and a standard HTTP status code.

steps.action: Submit a forgotten-password request for an unregistered email address.
steps.expected: The system returns the same generic message and HTTP status code as in step 3.

test_cases.title: Help Desk initiates password reset without setting password
test_cases.preconditions: A Help Desk staff account with permission to initiate password resets and a company representative account are available.
test_cases.test_inputs: Company representative identifier.

steps.action: As Help Desk staff, initiate the password reset process for a company representative.
steps.expected: The system successfully initiates the reset process (e.g., sends a reset link or notification) and does not provide an interface to set or choose a new password for the representative.

steps.action: Verify that the Help Desk staff interface does not contain fields or actions to directly change the representative's password.
steps.expected: No password input fields or 'Set Password' buttons are available in the Help Desk reset workflow.

test_cases.title: Help Desk cannot bypass reset process to set password
test_cases.preconditions: A Help Desk staff account and a company representative account are available. Access to API endpoints or backend tools is available for testing.
test_cases.test_inputs: Company representative identifier, proposed new password.

steps.action: Attempt to call an API endpoint or use a backend tool to directly set the company representative's password using Help Desk credentials.
steps.expected: The request is denied with an authorization error, and the representative's password remains unchanged.

test_cases.title: New session token generated and old one invalidated upon reauthentication
test_cases.preconditions: A user is authenticated with an active session token (Token A). The user has access to a protected resource.
test_cases.assumptions: The system uses reference tokens or stateful sessions where backend invalidation is observable.

steps.action: Capture the current session token (Token A) and verify it is valid by accessing a protected resource.
steps.expected: The request succeeds and returns the protected resource.

steps.action: Trigger a reauthentication event (e.g., change password or perform a sensitive action requiring re-auth) and complete the reauthentication process.
steps.expected: The system issues a new session token (Token B) and the user remains logged in.

steps.action: Attempt to access a protected resource using the old session token (Token A).
steps.expected: The request is denied, and the session is considered invalid.

steps.action: Attempt to access a protected resource using the new session token (Token B).
steps.expected: The request succeeds and returns the protected resource.

test_cases.title: Session token invalidated after explicit logout
test_cases.preconditions: A user is authenticated with an active session token.

steps.action: Capture the current session token and verify it is valid by accessing a protected resource.
steps.expected: The request succeeds.

steps.action: Perform a logout action from the user interface.
steps.expected: The user is redirected to the login page, and the session is terminated.

steps.action: Attempt to access a protected resource using the previously captured session token.
steps.expected: The request is denied, and the user is redirected to the login page or receives an unauthorized error.

test_cases.title: Session token invalidated after inactivity timeout expiration
test_cases.preconditions: A user is authenticated. The inactivity timeout is set to a short duration for testing (e.g., 1 minute).
test_cases.assumptions: The inactivity timeout value is configurable or can be simulated in the test environment.

steps.action: Capture the current session token and verify it is valid by accessing a protected resource.
steps.expected: The request succeeds.

steps.action: Wait for the inactivity timeout period to elapse without any user activity.
steps.expected: The session expires at the backend.

steps.action: Attempt to access a protected resource using the previously captured session token.
steps.expected: The request is denied, and the user is required to reauthenticate.

test_cases.title: Accessing another user's application via IDOR
test_cases.preconditions: Two active user accounts (User A and User B) with distinct applications assigned to each.
test_cases.test_inputs: User A's session token, User B's application ID.

steps.action: Log in as User A and note the ID of an application assigned to User B.
steps.expected: User A is authenticated and the target application ID is identified.

steps.action: Using User A's session, send a request to access the application identified by User B's application ID.
steps.expected: The request is denied (e.g., 403 Forbidden or 404 Not Found) and no data from User B's application is returned.

test_cases.title: Accessing another user's document via IDOR
test_cases.preconditions: Two active user accounts (User A and User B) with distinct documents assigned to each.
test_cases.test_inputs: User A's session token, User B's document ID.

steps.action: Log in as User A and note the ID of a document assigned to User B.
steps.expected: User A is authenticated and the target document ID is identified.

steps.action: Using User A's session, send a request to view or download the document identified by User B's document ID.
steps.expected: The request is denied and the document content is not exposed.

test_cases.title: Accessing related data items of another user's application
test_cases.preconditions: Two active user accounts (User A and User B) with applications that have associated data items (e.g., comments, attachments, logs).
test_cases.test_inputs: User A's session token, User B's application ID and a related data item ID.

steps.action: Log in as User A and identify a related data item (e.g., an attachment) belonging to User B's application.
steps.expected: User A is authenticated and the target data item ID is identified.

steps.action: Using User A's session, send a request to access the specific related data item of User B's application.
steps.expected: The request is denied and the data item is not exposed.

test_cases.title: Accessing own application and data items
test_cases.preconditions: An active user account (User A) with an assigned application and related data items.
test_cases.test_inputs: User A's session token, User A's application ID and related data item IDs.

steps.action: Log in as User A and send a request to access User A's own application.
steps.expected: The application data is returned successfully.

steps.action: Using User A's session, send a request to access a related data item of User A's own application.
steps.expected: The data item is returned successfully.

test_cases.title: Metin dışı içeriklerin alternatif metin ve adlandırma kontrolü
test_cases.preconditions: Portalda görsel, simge ve form içeren bir sayfa (ör. başvuru formu) açık.

steps.action: Sayfadaki bilgilendirici görsellerin (ör. logo, açıklama görseli) HTML kaynak kodu incelenir.
steps.expected: Her bilgilendirici görselin `alt` özniteliği dolu ve içeriğin amacını açıklayan bir metin içerir.

steps.action: Sayfadaki süsleme amaçlı görsellerin HTML kaynak kodu incelenir.
steps.expected: Süsleme amaçlı görsellerin `alt` özniteliği boş (`alt=''`) veya `role='presentation'`/`aria-hidden='true'` ile işaretlenmiştir.

steps.action: Form alanları ve düğmelerin programatik adları (label, aria-label) kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Tüm girdi ve düğme öğelerinin programatik olarak belirlenebilir bir adı vardır.

test_cases.title: Form, tablo ve liste yapılarının programatik belirlenebilirliği
test_cases.preconditions: Tablo, liste ve form içeren bir başvuru sayfası açık.

steps.action: Sayfadaki tabloların HTML yapısı incelenir.
steps.expected: Tablolar `<table>`, `<thead>`, `<tbody>`, `<th>` ve `<td>` etiketleriyle doğru yapılandırılmıştır; veri hücreleri ve başlık hücreleri programatik olarak ayrıştırılabilir.

steps.action: Sayfadaki listelerin HTML yapısı incelenir.
steps.expected: Listeler `<ul>`, `<ol>` ve `<li>` etiketleriyle oluşturulmuştur; madde sıralaması programatik olarak belirlenebilir.

steps.action: Form alanlarının etiket bağlantıları kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Her form alanı `<label>` etiketiyle veya `aria-label` ile ilişkilendirilmiştir; alanın amacı programatik olarak belirlenebilir.

test_cases.title: Ekran yönü kısıtlamasının olmaması
test_cases.preconditions: Portalın ana sayfası ve bir başvuru formu açık.

steps.action: Tarayıcı penceresi dikey (portrait) modda açılır ve sayfa içeriği görüntülenir.
steps.expected: İçerik dikey modda düzgün görüntülenir, kaydırma çubuğu dikeydir, içerik kesilmez.

steps.action: Tarayıcı penceresi yatay (landscape) moda çevrilir ve sayfa içeriği görüntülenir.
steps.expected: İçerik yatay modda düzgün görüntülenir, kaydırma çubuğu yatay olabilir, içerik kesilmez veya kullanılamaz hale gelmez.

steps.action: Cihazın ekran yönü kilidi (eğer varsa) devre dışı bırakılarak yön değiştirilir.
steps.expected: Sayfa yön değişikliğine uyum sağlar, kullanıcı etkileşimi (tıklama, form doldurma) her iki yönde de çalışır.

test_cases.title: Form alanlarının autocomplete özniteliklerinin kontrolü
test_cases.preconditions: Kişisel bilgi toplayan bir form (ad, e-posta, telefon, adres) açık.

steps.action: Ad, soyad, e-posta, telefon ve adres alanlarının HTML kaynak kodu incelenir.
steps.expected: Her alanın `autocomplete` özniteliği vardır ve WCAG 1.3.5'te tanımlanan uygun değerleri (ör. `name`, `email`, `tel`, `street-address`) içerir.

steps.action: Tarayıcının otomatik doldurma özelliği etkinleştirilerek form alanlarına odaklanılır.
steps.expected: Tarayıcı, `autocomplete` değerlerine göre ilgili alanları otomatik doldurma önerisi sunar.

test_cases.title: Metin kontrast oranlarının kontrolü
test_cases.preconditions: Portalın tipik bir sayfası (metin ve arka plan renkleri tanımlı) açık.
test_cases.assumptions: Kontrast oranı hesaplama aracı (ör. tarayıcı eklentisi) kullanılabilir.

steps.action: Sayfadaki normal boyutlu metinlerin (14pt veya 18.66px bold altı) kontrast oranları ölçülür.
steps.expected: Tüm normal boyutlu metinlerin kontrast oranı en az 4.5:1'dir.

steps.action: Sayfadaki büyük boyutlu metinlerin (18pt veya 24px bold ve üzeri) kontrast oranları ölçülür.
steps.expected: Tüm büyük boyutlu metinlerin kontrast oranı en az 3:1'dir.

steps.action: Etkin olmayan (disabled) bileşenler ve logolar hariç tutularak kontrol tekrarlanır.
steps.expected: İstisna dışındaki tüm metinler kontrast şartını sağlar.

test_cases.title: Metnin %200 büyütülebilirliği
test_cases.preconditions: Portalın tipik bir sayfası açık.

steps.action: Tarayıcı zoom seviyesi %200'e ayarlanır.
steps.expected: Metin %200 büyütülür, içerik kaybolmaz veya üst üste binmez.

steps.action: Büyütülmüş sayfada form doldurma ve düğme tıklama işlemleri denenir.
steps.expected: Tüm işlevler %200 zoom seviyesinde çalışır, içerik kaybı yaşanmaz.

test_cases.title: Bilginin metin görüntüsü yerine metinle aktarılması
test_cases.preconditions: Portalın tipik bir sayfası açık.

steps.action: Sayfadaki bilgilendirici metinlerin (başlıklar, paragraflar, etiketler) HTML kaynak kodu incelenir.
steps.expected:
Bilgi metin olarak (`

`, `

`, `` vb.) aktarılır; metin görüntüsü (image of text) kullanılmaz.

steps.action: Logolar ve kullanıcı özelleştirebildiği metin görüntüleri hariç tutularak kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: İstisna dışındaki tüm bilgilendirici içerik metin olarak sunulur.

test_cases.title: Satır yüksekliği, paragraf aralığı ve harf/sözcük aralığı ayarları
test_cases.preconditions: Portalın tipik bir sayfası açık.
test_cases.assumptions: CSS enjeksiyonu veya tarayıcı geliştirici araçları ile stil ayarları yapılabilir.

steps.action: Sayfadaki metinlerin satır yüksekliği (line-height) yazı boyutunun 1.5 katına ayarlanır.
steps.expected: İçerik kaybolmaz, üst üste binmez, işlev kaybı yaşanmaz.

steps.action: Paragraf aralığı (margin/padding) yazı boyutunun 2 katına ayarlanır.
steps.expected: İçerik kaybolmaz, üst üste binmez, işlev kaybı yaşanmaz.

steps.action: Harf aralığı (letter-spacing) yazı boyutunun 0.12 katına ve sözcük aralığı (word-spacing) 0.16 katına ayarlanır.
steps.expected: İçerik kaybolmaz, üst üste binmez, işlev kaybı yaşanmaz.

test_cases.title: Klavye ile tüm işlevlerin kullanılabilirliği
test_cases.preconditions: Portalın tipik bir sayfası açık, fare kullanımı devre dışı.

steps.action: Sadece klavye (Tab, Enter, Space, ok tuşları) kullanarak sayfada gezinilir.
steps.expected: Tüm etkileşimli öğelere (bağlantılar, düğmeler, form alanları) klavyeyle erişilebilir.

steps.action: Klavye ile form doldurma ve gönderme işlemi yapılır.
steps.expected: Form alanları klavyeyle doldurulabilir, gönderme işlemi klavyeyle tamamlanabilir.

steps.action: Dosya yükleme işlevi klavyeyle denenir.
steps.expected: Dosya seçme ve yükleme işlemi klavyeyle tamamlanabilir (tarayıcının dosya seçici penceresi klavyeyle kullanılabilir).

test_cases.title: Sayfa başlıklarının varlığı ve içeriği
test_cases.preconditions: Portalın farklı sayfaları (ana sayfa, form, sonuç) açık.

steps.action: Her sayfanın HTML `<title>` etiketi incelenir.
steps.expected: Her sayfanın bir `<title>` etiketi vardır ve sayfanın konusunu veya amacını tanımlayan bir metin içerir.

steps.action: Sayfa başlıkları tarayıcı sekmesinde görüntülenir.
steps.expected: Başlıklar açıklayıcıdır, boş veya genel (ör. 'Sayfa') değildir.

test_cases.title: Bağlantı amaçlarının programatik belirlenebilirliği
test_cases.preconditions: Portalın tipik bir sayfası açık.

steps.action: Sayfadaki tüm bağlantıların metinleri ve `aria-label` öznitelikleri incelenir.
steps.expected: Her bağlantının amacı bağlantı metninden veya `aria-label`'dan anlaşılır; 'buraya tıklayın' gibi belirsiz metinler kullanılmamıştır.

steps.action: Yalnızca ikon içeren bağlantıların programatik adları kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: İkon bağlantılarının `aria-label` veya `title` özniteliği vardır ve amacı açıklar.

test_cases.title: Klavye odak göstergesinin görünür olması
test_cases.preconditions: Portalın tipik bir sayfası açık.

steps.action: Klavye Tab tuşu ile sayfada gezinilir.
steps.expected: Odaklanan her öğenin etrafında görünür bir odak göstergesi (outline, border, renk değişimi) vardır.

steps.action: Odak göstergesinin kontrast oranı kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Odak göstergesi arka planla yeterli kontrast sağlar, görünürdür.

test_cases.title: Sayfa dilinin programatik belirlenebilirliği
test_cases.preconditions: Portalın Türkçe ve İngilizce sayfaları açık.

steps.action: Türkçe bir sayfanın `<html>` etiketinin `lang` özniteliği incelenir.
steps.expected: `lang` özniteliği 'tr' veya 'tr-TR' değerini içerir.

steps.action: İngilizce bir sayfanın `<html>` etiketinin `lang` özniteliği incelenir.
steps.expected: `lang` özniteliği 'en' veya 'en-GB'/'en-US' değerini içerir.

test_cases.title: Farklı dildeki bölümlerin dil işaretlemesi
test_cases.preconditions: İngilizce arayüzde Türkçe resmî belge adları içeren bir sayfa açık.

steps.action: İngilizce sayfadaki Türkçe metinlerin (ör. belge adları) HTML etiketleri incelenir.
steps.expected: Türkçe metinler `lang='tr'` özniteliğiyle işaretlenmiştir.

steps.action: Türkçe sayfadaki İngilizce metinlerin (varsa) HTML etiketleri incelenir.
steps.expected: İngilizce metinler `lang='en'` özniteliğiyle işaretlenmiştir.

test_cases.title: UI bileşenlerinin ad, rol ve durum bildirimleri
test_cases.preconditions: Portalın tipik bir sayfası açık, ekran okuyucu veya geliştirici araçları kullanılabilir.

steps.action: Form alanları, düğmeler ve menülerin ARIA rolleri ve adları kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Her bileşenin programatik olarak belirlenebilir bir adı ve rolü vardır (ör. `role='button'`, `aria-label`).

steps.action: Kullanıcı ayarlayabildiği bir bileşen (ör. açılır menü, onay kutusu) değiştirilir.
steps.expected: Durum değişikliği `aria-expanded`, `aria-checked` gibi ARIA öznitelikleriyle programatik olarak yansıtılır.

steps.action: Dinamik içerik güncellemeleri (ör. hata mesajı gösterimi) kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Değişiklikler `aria-live` bölgesi veya `role='alert'` ile yardımcı teknolojilere bildirilir.

test_cases.title: Ortak hesap kullanımı ve izlenebilirlik denetimi
test_cases.preconditions: Portal ve arka ofis için tanımlı, tek bir kişiye ait etkin test hesapları mevcut olmalıdır.

steps.action: Portal üzerinden tek bir kişiye ait hesapla oturum açılır ve bir işlem (ör. başvuru oluşturma) yapılır.
steps.expected: İşlem, o kişinin kimlik bilgisiyle ilişkilendirilir ve iz kayıtlarında tekil kullanıcı olarak görünür.

steps.action: Arka ofis üzerinden tek bir kişiye ait hesapla oturum açılır ve bir işlem (ör. başvuru onaylama) yapılır.
steps.expected: İşlem, o personelin kimlik bilgisiyle ilişkilendirilir ve iz kayıtlarında tekil kullanıcı olarak görünür.

steps.action: Sistemde birden fazla kişinin aynı kullanıcı adıyla oturum açmasına izin veren bir yapı olup olmadığı kontrol edilir (ör. aynı kullanıcı adıyla eş zamanlı oturum denemesi).
steps.expected: Sistem, ortak hesap kullanımını engeller veya her oturumu tekil bir kullanıcıya bağlayacak şekilde yapılandırılmıştır; izlenebilirlik sağlanır.

test_cases.title: Varsayılan ve tahmin edilebilir kimlik bilgilerinin değiştirilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Test ortamında kurulumu tamamlanmış, varsayılan yapılandırma dosyalarına erişilebilen bir sistem kurulumu.

steps.action: Veri tabanı, uygulama sunucusu ve paket programlar için tanımlı varsayılan kullanıcı adları ve parolalar kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Varsayılan kullanıcı adları ve parolalar değiştirilmiştir veya bu hesaplar devre dışı bırakılmıştır.

steps.action: Sistemde 'admin', 'root', 'test' gibi tahmin edilebilir kullanıcı adları ve genel olarak bilinen parolalarla (ör. 'password', '123456') giriş denemesi yapılır.
steps.expected: Girişler reddedilir; bu tür hesaplar sistemde aktif olarak bulunmamaktadır.

steps.action: Yazılım bileşenlerinin yapılandırma dosyalarında açık metin veya varsayılan kimlik bilgisi kalıntısı olup olmadığı incelenir.
steps.expected: Varsayılan veya tahmin edilebilir kimlik bilgisi içeren aktif hesap bulunmaz.

test_cases.title: Kaba kuvvet saldırılarına karşı istek sınırlandırma
test_cases.preconditions: Etkin bir test hesabı ve kaba kuvvet saldırısı simüle edebilen bir araç (ör. Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP).

steps.action: Oturum açma ekranına kısa bir süre içinde (ör. 1 dakika) çok sayıda (ör. 100) başarısız giriş denemesi yapılır.
steps.expected: Sistem, belirli bir eşikten sonra istekleri reddeder, IP adresini bloklar veya CAPTCHA gibi ek doğrulama yöntemleri devreye alır.

steps.action: Parola sıfırlama işlevine kısa bir süre içinde çok sayıda istek gönderilir.
steps.expected: Sistem, istekleri sınırlar ve sıralı denemelerle bilgi edinilmesini engeller.

steps.action: Hesap kurtarma işlevine kısa bir süre içinde çok sayıda istek gönderilir.
steps.expected: Sistem, istekleri sınırlar ve sıralı denemelerle bilgi edinilmesini engeller.

test_cases.title: Kimlik doğrulama yanıt boyutunun tutarlılığı
test_cases.preconditions: Etkin bir test hesabı ve yanıt boyutlarını ölçebilen bir ağ yakalama aracı.

steps.action: Doğru kullanıcı adı ve doğru parolayla oturum açma isteği gönderilir, yanıt boyutu kaydedilir.
steps.expected: Yanıt boyutu not edilir.

steps.action: Doğru kullanıcı adı ve yanlış parolayla oturum açma isteği gönderilir, yanıt boyutu kaydedilir.
steps.expected: Yanıt boyutu, başarılı girişteki yanıt boyutuyla aynıdır veya anlamlı bir fark göstermez.

steps.action: Yanlış kullanıcı adı ve doğru parolayla oturum açma isteği gönderilir, yanıt boyutu kaydedilir.
steps.expected: Yanıt boyutu, başarılı girişteki yanıt boyutuyla aynıdır veya anlamlı bir fark göstermez.

test_cases.title: Hassas işlemler öncesi yeniden kimlik doğrulama
test_cases.preconditions: Etkin bir vatandaş hesabı ve Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §5.4'te hassas olarak tanımlanmış bir işlem (ör. kişisel veri güncelleme, başvuru iptali).

steps.action: Vatandaş olarak oturum açılır ve hassas bir işleme (ör. kişisel veri güncelleme) erişilmeye çalışılır.
steps.expected: Sistem, işlemi gerçekleştirmeden önce yeniden kimlik doğrulama (ör. parola, MFA) ister.

steps.action: Yeniden kimlik doğrulama talebi reddedilir veya başarısız olur.
steps.expected: Hassas işlem gerçekleştirilmez ve kullanıcı işlemi tamamlayamaz.

steps.action: Yeniden kimlik doğrulama başarılı olur.
steps.expected: Hassas işlem gerçekleştirilir.

test_cases.title: e-Devlet ve KKS entegrasyonu ile kimlik doğrulama
test_cases.preconditions: e-Devlet test ortamına erişim ve kurumsal KKS test ortamına erişim; etkin vatandaş ve personel test hesapları.

steps.action: Vatandaş olarak portal üzerinden oturum açılır ve e-Devlet kimlik doğrulama akışı başlatılır.
steps.expected: Sistem, e-Devlet sistemiyle entegre olarak kimlik doğrulama yapar ve başarılı doğrulama sonrası oturum açılır.

steps.action: Personel olarak arka ofis üzerinden oturum açılır ve kurumsal KKS kimlik doğrulama akışı başlatılır.
steps.expected: Sistem, kurumsal KKS ile entegre olarak kimlik doğrulama yapar ve başarılı doğrulama sonrası oturum açılır.

steps.action: e-Devlet veya KKS kimlik doğrulama sürecinde hata oluşturulur (ör. geçersiz token, zaman aşımı).
steps.expected: Kimlik doğrulama başarısız olur ve oturum açılmaz.

test_cases.title: Kimlik doğrulama sonrası yeni oturum kimliğinin üretilmesi ve tek kullanımlık olması
test_cases.preconditions: Etkin bir vatandaş test hesabı vardır. Oturum çerezlerini ve sunucu tarafı oturum durumunu gözlemleyebilen bir araç (tarayıcı geliştirici araçları veya yakalama aracı) hazırdır.

steps.action: Kullanıcı geçerli kimlik bilgileriyle oturum açar.
steps.expected: Sistem yeni bir oturum başlatır ve istemciye yeni bir oturum kimliği (çerez) atar.

steps.action: Kullanıcı oturum kapatır ve aynı kimlik bilgileriyle tekrar oturum açar.
steps.expected: Sistem ikinci oturum için birinci oturumdakinden farklı, yeni bir oturum kimliği üretir.

steps.action: İlk oturumun kimliği (çerez değeri) ikinci oturum aktifken bir istekte kullanılır.
steps.expected: İstek reddedilir; eski oturum kimliği geçersizdir ve yalnızca bir kez kullanılabilir.

test_cases.title: Oturum kimliklerinin uzunluk, rastgelelik ve teklik özelliklerinin kontrolü
test_cases.preconditions: Birden fazla test hesabı vardır. Oturum kimliklerini toplayabilmek için otomasyon aracı hazırdır.
test_cases.assumptions: Oturum kimliklerinin en az 128 bit (16 bayt) uzunlukta olması beklenmektedir.

steps.action: Farklı hesaplardan art arda 10 kez oturum açılarak üretilen oturum kimlikleri toplanır.
steps.expected: Tüm üretilen oturum kimlikleri birbirinden farklıdır (tekildir).

steps.action: Toplanan oturum kimliklerinin uzunlukları ve entropi düzeyleri incelenir.
steps.expected: Oturum kimlikleri yeterince uzundur (ör. 128 bit veya üzeri) ve rastgele üretilmiş gibidir (tekrar eden desenler yoktur).

test_cases.title: Oturum kapatma işlevinin çalışması ve geçici verilerin silinmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı aktif bir oturumla portal içi bir sayfada (ör. Başvurularım) bulunmaktadır.

steps.action: Kullanıcı sayfadaki 'Oturumu Kapat' bağlantısına tıklar.
steps.expected: Oturum sonlandırılır ve kullanıcı giriş ekranına yönlendirilir.

steps.action: Tarayıcı çerezleri ve yerel depolama alanları incelenir.
steps.expected: Oturum kimliği çerezi ve ilgili geçici veriler istemci tarafında silinmiştir.

steps.action: Sunucu tarafında oturum durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Sunucuda ilgili oturum kaydı silinmiş veya geçersiz kılınmıştır.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, oturum kapatıldıktan sonra tarayıcı geri düğmesiyle korumalı bir sayfaya dönmeye çalışır.
steps.expected: Kullanıcı giriş ekranına yönlendirilir; korumalı sayfa gösterilmez.

test_cases.title: Belirli süre etkinlik olmaması durumunda oturumun sonlanması
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı aktif bir oturumla portal içindedir. Oturumun boşta kalma süresi (idle timeout) test ortamında kısa bir süreye (ör. 1 dakika) ayarlanmıştır.
test_cases.assumptions: Boşta kalma süresi 1 dakika olarak yapılandırılmıştır.

steps.action: Kullanıcı portalda 1 dakikadan fazla hiçbir işlem yapmadan bekler.
steps.expected: Oturum otomatik olarak sonlanır.

steps.action: Süre dolduktan sonra kullanıcı bir işlem yapmaya (ör. bir sayfaya tıklamaya) çalışır.
steps.expected: İşlem reddedilir ve kullanıcı oturumun sonlandığına dair bir mesajla giriş ekranına yönlendirilir.

test_cases.title: Parola değişikliği sonrası etkin oturumların sonlandırılması
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı aktif bir oturumla portal içindedir. İkinci bir tarayıcı sekmesi veya cihazda aynı kullanıcıyla başka bir aktif oturum vardır.

steps.action: Kullanıcı profil ayarlarından parolasını değiştirir.
steps.expected: Parola değişikliği başarılı olur.

steps.action: Parola değişikliği yapılmadan önceki aktif oturumda (ikinci sekme/cihaz) bir işlem yapılmaya çalışılır.
steps.expected: Oturum geçersiz kılınmıştır; işlem reddedilir ve kullanıcı yeniden kimlik doğrulama yapmaya yönlendirilir.

test_cases.title: Etkin oturumların görüntülenmesi ve seçilerek sonlandırılması
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı aynı anda birden fazla cihazda (ör. masaüstü ve mobil) aktif oturumlarla portal içindedir.

steps.action: Kullanıcı 'Oturumlarım' sayfasına gider.
steps.expected: Sayfada kullanıcının tüm etkin oturumları (cihaz türü, konum, son aktivite zamanı vb.) listelenir.

steps.action: Kullanıcı listeden masaüstü oturumunu seçer ve 'Sonlandır' butonuna tıklar.
steps.expected: Sistem onay ister veya doğrudan işlemi yapar; masaüstü oturumu sonlandırılır.

steps.action: Masaüstü cihazda (sonlandırılan oturumda) bir işlem yapılmaya çalışılır.
steps.expected: Oturumun sonlandığı bildirilir ve kullanıcı giriş ekranına yönlendirilir.

steps.action: Mobil cihazda (aktif kalan oturumda) işlem yapılmaya devam edilir.
steps.expected: Mobil oturum etkisini korur, işlem başarıyla tamamlanır.

test_cases.title: Yetkili bileşene erişim ve yetkisiz bileşene erişim denetimi
test_cases.preconditions: Yetki matrisinde 'Vatandaş' rolüne 'Başvuru Oluşturma' bileşeni yetkisi verilmiş, 'Sistem Yönetimi' bileşeni yetkisi verilmemiş etkin bir vatandaş test hesabı.

steps.action: Vatandaş hesabıyla oturum açılır ve 'Başvuru Oluşturma' bileşenine erişim sağlanır.
steps.expected: Erişim izni verilir, bileşen yüklenir.

steps.action: Aynı oturumla 'Sistem Yönetimi' bileşenine doğrudan URL üzerinden erişim denemesi yapılır.
steps.expected: Erişim reddedilir, yetkisiz erişim hatası gösterilir.

test_cases.title: Her istekte yetki denetiminin uygulanması (Oturum zaman aşımı sonrası)
test_cases.preconditions: Etkin bir vatandaş test hesabı; oturum zaman aşımı süresinin dolması bekleniyor.
test_cases.assumptions: Oturum zaman aşımı süresi test ortamında kısa tutulabilir veya beklenerek dolması sağlanabilir.

steps.action: Vatandaş hesabıyla oturum açılır ve oturum zaman aşımı süresi dolana kadar beklenir.
steps.expected: Oturum sonlandırılır.

steps.action: Oturum sonlandıktan sonra, tarayıcı geçmişinden veya kayıtlı bir bağlantıdan yetkili bir bileşene istek gönderilir.
steps.expected: İstek yetki denetiminden geçer, oturum geçersiz olduğu için erişim reddedilir ve kullanıcı giriş ekranına yönlendirilir.

test_cases.title: Kritik veriye erişimde denetim kaydı üretimi
test_cases.preconditions: Denetim kayıtlarını görüntüleme yetkisine sahip bir denetçi hesabı; kişisel veri içeren bir başvuru dosyası.

steps.action: Yetkili bir kullanıcı hesabıyla kişisel veri içeren başvuru dosyasına erişim sağlanır ve veri görüntülenir.
steps.expected: Erişim işlemi başarılı olur.

steps.action: Denetçi hesabıyla denetim kayıtları incelenir.
steps.expected: Yapılan erişim işlemi, kullanıcı kimliği, zaman damgası ve erişilen kaynak bilgisiyle birlikte denetim kaydında yer alır.

test_cases.title: Yetkisiz erişim denemesinde denetim kaydı üretimi
