test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request for RIU session when GSM-R not registered
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has GSM-R installed. No GSM-R Mobile Terminal is duly registered to a GSM-R Radio Network. The stored Radio Network type allows GSM-R usage (e.g., GSM-R or FRMCS+GSM-R).
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with a Radio Infill Unit (RIU).

steps.action: The OBU receives a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RIU.
steps.expected: The OBU does not request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Indication of 'Connection Up' status
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2, a communication session is being established with an RBC, and the safe radio connection has just been successfully set up.

steps.action: Observe the driver display for the safe radio connection status indicator.
steps.expected: The display shows the indication status 'Connection Up'.

test_cases.title: Indication of 'No Connection' status
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2, no communication session is established, and no safe radio connection is active.

steps.action: Observe the driver display for the safe radio connection status indicator.
steps.expected: The display shows the indication status 'No Connection'.

test_cases.title: Indication of 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' status
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2, a communication session is being established, and the safe radio connection set-up has failed or the connection was lost.

steps.action: Observe the driver display for the safe radio connection status indicator.
steps.expected: The display shows the indication status 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'.

test_cases.title: Start of connection status timer on first request for session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2, no communication session is established, and the connection status timer is not running.
test_cases.assumptions: The internal state of the connection status timer is observable via test instrumentation or logs.

steps.action: Trigger a session establishment (e.g., Start of Mission) causing the OBU to send the first request to set up a safe radio connection with the RBC.
steps.expected: The connection status timer starts immediately upon sending the first request.

test_cases.title: Start of connection status timer on first request for session maintenance
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2, a communication session is established, the safe radio connection is lost, and the connection status timer is not running.
test_cases.assumptions: The internal state of the connection status timer is observable via test instrumentation or logs.

steps.action: The OBU sends the first request to set up a new safe radio connection to maintain the session after loss.
steps.expected: The connection status timer starts immediately upon sending the first request.

test_cases.title: Transition from No Connection to Connection Up
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2, the indication status is 'No Connection', and a request to set up a safe radio connection is in progress.

steps.action: The safe radio connection is successfully set up (Condition [4] met).
steps.expected: The indication status transitions from 'No Connection' to 'Connection Up'.

test_cases.title: Transition from Connection Up to Connection Lost/Set-Up failed
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2, the indication status is 'Connection Up', and the safe radio connection is active.

steps.action: The safe radio connection is lost and the requests to set up a safe radio connection are stopped for a reason other than successful set-up (Condition [6] met).
steps.expected: The indication status transitions from 'Connection Up' to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'.

test_cases.title: Transition from Connection Lost/Set-Up failed to No Connection
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2, the indication status is 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed', and no Start of Mission procedure is ongoing.

steps.action: The requests to set up a safe radio connection are stopped for a reason other than successful set-up (Condition [3] met).
steps.expected: The indication status transitions from 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' to 'No Connection'.

test_cases.title: Indication of RIU connection status for current infill area
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1, has safe radio connections with multiple RIUs, and is currently located in a specific infill area.

steps.action: Observe the driver display for the safe radio connection status indicator while the train is in the current infill area.
steps.expected: The display shows the status of the safe radio connection with the RIU of the current infill area, not the other RIUs.

test_cases.title: Valid position stored after passing LRBG with invalid position
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where train position is monitored. The current train position status is 'invalid'. An LRBG is available ahead of the train.

steps.action: Verify the current train position status is 'invalid'.
steps.expected: The OBU reports the train position status as 'invalid'.

steps.action: Move the train to pass the LRBG.
steps.expected: The OBU regards a valid train position as stored on board. The train position status changes to 'valid'.

steps.action: Check the status of the previously stored invalid train position.
steps.expected: The previously stored invalid train position is deleted.

test_cases.title: Valid position stored after passing ORBG with unknown position
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where train position is monitored. The current train position status is 'unknown'. An ORBG is available ahead of the train.

steps.action: Verify the current train position status is 'unknown'.
steps.expected: The OBU reports the train position status as 'unknown'.

steps.action: Move the train to pass the ORBG.
steps.expected: The OBU regards a valid train position as stored on board. The train position status changes to 'valid'.

steps.action: Check the status of the previously stored invalid train position.
steps.expected: The previously stored invalid train position is deleted.

test_cases.title: Train orientation defined by active cab
test_cases.preconditions: The train has two cabs. Cab A is active. The train is moving in the direction of Cab A.

steps.action: Check the train orientation defined by the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU defines the train orientation such that the side of Cab A is the front of the train.

test_cases.title: Train orientation defined by last active cab when no cab is active
test_cases.preconditions: The train has two cabs. Cab B was the last active cab. Both cabs are now inactive.

steps.action: Deactivate all cabs so that no cab is active.
steps.expected: The OBU detects that no cab is active.

steps.action: Check the train orientation defined by the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU defines the train orientation based on the last active cab (Cab B), such that the side of Cab B is the front of the train.

test_cases.title: Estimated front end used for location based supervision
test_cases.preconditions: The train is in a mode where location based information is supervised (e.g., Full Supervision). The estimated front end position is known and valid.

steps.action: Supervise a location based event (e.g., passing a balise or reaching a specific distance) using the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the estimated front end position as the reference for the supervision calculation.

test_cases.title: Max safe front end used for End Section timer start
test_cases.preconditions: The train is approaching the start location of an End Section timer. The max safe front end position is known and valid.

steps.action: Move the train to the start location of the End Section timer.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the max safe front end position as the reference to determine when the End Section timer starts, not the estimated front end.

test_cases.title: Min safe rear end used for level transition border
test_cases.preconditions: The train is approaching a level transition border. The min safe rear end position is known and valid.

steps.action: Move the train to the level transition border.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the min safe rear end position as the reference to determine when the level transition occurs, not the estimated front end.

test_cases.title: Position reporting with valid LRBGONB (Linking checked)
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established. Linking consistency check is enabled on-board. The train has passed a balise group (BG-X) that is marked as 'linked' and is contained in the previously received linking information.

steps.action: The train passes the LRBG compliant balise group BG-X.
steps.expected: The OBU identifies BG-X as the LRBGONB.

steps.action: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.
steps.expected: The position report refers to the train position relative to BG-X (LRBGONB).

test_cases.title: Position reporting with valid LRBGONB (Linking not checked)
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established. Linking consistency check is disabled on-board. The train has passed a balise group (BG-Y) that is not marked as 'unlinked'.

steps.action: The train passes the balise group BG-Y.
steps.expected: The OBU identifies BG-Y as the LRBGONB since it is not marked as unlinked.

steps.action: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.
steps.expected: The position report refers to the train position relative to BG-Y (LRBGONB).

test_cases.title: Accepting trackside information referring to recent LRBGONB
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established. The OBU has reported 8 distinct LRBGONBs to the RBC in sequence: BG-1, BG-2, ..., BG-8. BG-8 is the current LRBGONB.
test_cases.assumptions: The minimum number of LRBGs to be accepted is 8 as per SUBSET-026 §3.6.2.2.2 c).

steps.action: The RBC sends a message containing trackside information (e.g., MA or profile) referring to BG-1 (the 8th last reported LRBGONB).
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the information and processes it relative to BG-1.

steps.action: The RBC sends a message containing trackside information referring to BG-8 (the current LRBGONB).
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the information and processes it relative to BG-8.

test_cases.title: Rejection of trackside information referring to LRBG outside window
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established. The OBU has reported 8 distinct LRBGONBs to the RBC in sequence: BG-1, BG-2, ..., BG-8. BG-8 is the current LRBGONB. BG-0 was reported before BG-1.
test_cases.assumptions: The minimum number of LRBGs to be accepted is 8 as per SUBSET-026 §3.6.2.2.2 c).

steps.action: The RBC sends a message containing trackside information referring to BG-0 (the 9th last reported LRBGONB).
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the information or does not process it as valid location reference, as it is outside the window of the last 8 reported LRBGs.

test_cases.title: Position reporting with unknown LRBGONB (Unlinked BG passed)
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established. Linking consistency check is enabled. The train has passed a balise group (BG-Z) marked as 'unlinked'. No LRBG compliant balise group has been passed since then.

steps.action: The train passes the unlinked balise group BG-Z.
steps.expected: The OBU does not set BG-Z as LRBGONB.

steps.action: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.
steps.expected: The position report uses an LRBG identifier set to 'unknown'.

test_cases.title: OBU takes into account information valid for the train orientation
test_cases.preconditions: Train is moving in a mode where orientation is defined (e.g., Full Supervision). The train orientation is set to the nominal direction. A balise group is passed in the nominal direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise message containing data valid for the nominal direction.

steps.action: The train passes a balise group in the nominal direction while the train orientation is nominal.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the data.

steps.action: The OBU processes the received data.
steps.expected: The OBU takes the information into account (e.g., updates location or applies profile data).

test_cases.title: OBU ignores information not valid for the train orientation
test_cases.preconditions: Train is moving in a mode where orientation is defined (e.g., Full Supervision). The train orientation is set to the nominal direction. A balise group is passed in the nominal direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise message containing data valid for the reverse direction only.

steps.action: The train passes a balise group in the nominal direction while the train orientation is nominal.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the data.

steps.action: The OBU processes the received data.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the information (it is not applied to the train state or location).

test_cases.title: OBU rejects one-direction data when orientation cannot be related to trackside direction
test_cases.preconditions: The train orientation cannot be related to the direction of the trackside device (e.g., no coordinate system assigned to the balise group). The train is in a mode where orientation is defined.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise message containing data valid for the nominal direction only.

steps.action: The train passes a balise group where the orientation cannot be related to the trackside direction.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the data.

steps.action: The OBU evaluates the validity direction of the data.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the data because it is valid for one direction only and the orientation cannot be related.

test_cases.title: OBU evaluates data valid in both directions when orientation cannot be related
test_cases.preconditions: The train orientation cannot be related to the direction of the trackside device (e.g., no coordinate system assigned to the balise group). The train is in a mode where orientation is defined.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise message containing data valid for both directions.

steps.action: The train passes a balise group where the orientation cannot be related to the trackside direction.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the data.

steps.action: The OBU evaluates the validity direction of the data.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates and takes the data into account because it is valid for both directions.

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data interpretation: value applies over following distance
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in a mode where continuous profile data is applied. Previously received profile data is stored.
test_cases.test_inputs: Continuous profile data with value(1) and distance(2) > 0.

steps.action: The OBU receives continuous profile data with value(1) and distance(2).
steps.expected: The OBU stores value(1) and distance(2).

steps.action: The train moves a distance less than distance(2) from the reference point.
steps.expected: The OBU applies value(1) to the train's speed supervision.

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data interpretation: previously received data applies over first distance
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in a mode where continuous profile data is applied. Previously received profile data (value(0)) is stored.
test_cases.test_inputs: Continuous profile data with value(1) and distance(1) > 0.

steps.action: The OBU receives continuous profile data with value(1) and distance(1).
steps.expected: The OBU stores value(1) and distance(1).

steps.action: The train moves a distance less than distance(1) from the reference point.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the previously received data (value(0)) to the train's speed supervision.

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data interpretation: last value applies without limit unless end-of-profile
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in a mode where continuous profile data is applied.
test_cases.test_inputs: Continuous profile data with value(n) not being the end-of-profile value.

steps.action: The OBU receives continuous profile data with value(n) as the last value, not being the end-of-profile value.
steps.expected: The OBU stores value(n).

steps.action: The train moves a distance greater than the sum of all previous distances.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to apply value(n) to the train's speed supervision.

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data interpretation: value followed by zero distance is taken into account
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in a mode where continuous profile data is applied.
test_cases.test_inputs: Continuous profile data with value(n) and distance(n+1) = 0.

steps.action: The OBU receives continuous profile data with value(n) and distance(n+1) = 0.
steps.expected: The OBU stores value(n) and distance(n+1).

steps.action: The train is at the reference point.
steps.expected: The OBU takes value(n) into account for speed supervision.

test_cases.title: Location data interpretation: distances are unsigned increments
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in a mode where location data is applied. Previously received location data is stored.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location data with value(1) and distance(2) > 0.

steps.action: The OBU receives location data with value(1) and distance(2).
steps.expected: The OBU stores value(1) and distance(2).

steps.action: The train moves a distance less than distance(2) from the reference point.
steps.expected: The OBU applies value(1) to the train's location calculation.

test_cases.title: Location data interpretation: previously received data applies over first distance
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in a mode where location data is applied. Previously received location data (value(0)) is stored.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location data with value(1) and distance(1) > 0.

steps.action: The OBU receives location data with value(1) and distance(1).
steps.expected: The OBU stores value(1) and distance(1).

steps.action: The train moves a distance less than distance(1) from the reference point.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the previously received data (value(0)) to the train's location calculation.

test_cases.title: Non-continuous profile data interpretation: elements with incremental distances
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in a mode where non-continuous profile data is applied. Previously received data is stored.
test_cases.test_inputs: Non-continuous profile data with element(1) (value(1), length(1)) and distance(2) > 0.

steps.action: The OBU receives non-continuous profile data with element(1) and distance(2).
steps.expected: The OBU stores element(1) and distance(2).

steps.action: The train moves a distance less than distance(2) from the start of element(1).
steps.expected: The OBU applies element(1) to the train's speed supervision.

test_cases.title: Non-continuous profile data interpretation: overlapping elements
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in a mode where non-continuous profile data is applied.
test_cases.test_inputs: Non-continuous profile data with element(1) (length(1) = 100m) and element(2) (distance(2) = 50m, length(2) = 100m).

steps.action: The OBU receives non-continuous profile data with overlapping elements.
steps.expected: The OBU stores both elements.

steps.action: The train moves to a position within the overlap region (50m to 100m from the start of element(1)).
steps.expected: The OBU applies both element(1) and element(2) to the train's speed supervision, using the most restrictive value.

test_cases.title: Linking information interpretation: first distance to first announced balise group
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in a mode where linking information is applied.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information with distance(1) > 0 and value(1) (linking data for balise group 1).

steps.action: The OBU receives linking information with distance(1) and value(1).
steps.expected: The OBU stores distance(1) and value(1).

steps.action: The train moves a distance less than distance(1) from the reference point.
steps.expected: The OBU does not apply the linking data for balise group 1 yet.

steps.action: The train moves a distance equal to or greater than distance(1) from the reference point.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the linking data for balise group 1.

test_cases.title: Linking information interpretation: further distances between consecutive announced balise groups
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in a mode where linking information is applied. Linking information for balise group 1 is already applied.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information with distance(2) > 0 and value(2) (linking data for balise group 2).

steps.action: The OBU receives linking information with distance(2) and value(2).
steps.expected: The OBU stores distance(2) and value(2).

steps.action: The train moves a distance less than distance(2) from the start of balise group 1.
steps.expected: The OBU does not apply the linking data for balise group 2 yet.

steps.action: The train moves a distance equal to or greater than distance(2) from the start of balise group 1.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the linking data for balise group 2.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from linking information
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is checked. Linking information containing a specific location accuracy value for Balise Group BG1 is stored. The train is approaching BG1.

steps.action: The train passes Balise Group BG1, which becomes the LRBG.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the location accuracy value provided in the linking information for BG1.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from National Value when linking is unavailable
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is checked. No linking information containing location accuracy for Balise Group BG2 is available. A National Value for location accuracy is defined and applicable for the current location.

steps.action: The train passes Balise Group BG2, which becomes the LRBG.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the applicable National Value for the location accuracy of BG2.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from Default Value when no National Value applies
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is checked. No linking information containing location accuracy for Balise Group BG3 is available. No National Value for location accuracy is applicable for the current location.

steps.action: The train passes Balise Group BG3, which becomes the LRBG.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the Default Value for the location accuracy of BG3.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy not updated upon new linking information
test_cases.preconditions: Balise Group BG1 is the current LRBG. Its location accuracy was previously determined from linking information (Value A). New linking information is received that specifies a different location accuracy (Value B) for BG1.

steps.action: The OBU processes the new linking information.
steps.expected: The location accuracy of BG1 remains Value A and is not updated to Value B.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy not updated when linking check stops
test_cases.preconditions: Balise Group BG1 is the current LRBG. Its location accuracy was previously determined (Value A). The system state changes such that linking consistency is no longer checked.

steps.action: The OBU continues operation with linking consistency not checked.
steps.expected: The location accuracy of BG1 remains Value A and is not recalculated or updated.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy not updated when new National Values apply
test_cases.preconditions: Balise Group BG1 is the current LRBG. Its location accuracy was previously determined (Value A). The train enters a zone where a new National Value for location accuracy becomes applicable.

steps.action: The OBU operates in the zone with the new National Value.
steps.expected: The location accuracy of BG1 remains Value A and is not updated to the new National Value.

test_cases.title: Confidence interval delimitation with standard parameters
test_cases.preconditions: The train is moving. The reference balise group has a known location accuracy. The over-reading and under-reading amounts are known. The train is not in a consist-length-related situation defined in SUBSET-026 §3.6.4.1.5.

steps.action: The OBU calculates the train front end position confidence interval.
steps.expected: The min safe front end is located in rear of the estimated front end, and the max safe front end is located in advance of the estimated front end. The distances are composed of the location accuracy of the reference balise group and the over-/under-reading amounts. The consist length uncertainty is not included.

test_cases.title: Confidence interval delimitation with consist length uncertainty
test_cases.preconditions: The train is in a consist-length-related situation defined in SUBSET-026 §3.6.4.1.5. The reference balise group has a known location accuracy. The over-reading and under-reading amounts are known. The consist length uncertainty is known.

steps.action: The OBU calculates the train front end position confidence interval.
steps.expected: The min safe front end is located in rear of the estimated front end, and the max safe front end is located in advance of the estimated front end. The distances are composed of the location accuracy of the reference balise group, the over-/under-reading amounts, and the consist length uncertainty.

test_cases.title: SOLR selection with linking consistency checked
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is checked. Linking information is stored. Balise Group BG1 is the reference of the linking information. Balise Group BG2 is announced in the linking information. The train passes BG1, then BG2.

steps.action: The train passes Balise Group BG1.
steps.expected: BG1 becomes the SOLR.

steps.action: The train passes Balise Group BG2.
steps.expected: BG2 becomes the SOLR, as it is the most recently received balise group that is announced in linking information.

test_cases.title: SOLR selection with linking consistency not checked
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is not checked. The train passes Balise Group BG1, then Balise Group BG2.

steps.action: The train passes Balise Group BG1.
steps.expected: BG1 becomes the SOLR.

steps.action: The train passes Balise Group BG2.
steps.expected: BG2 becomes the SOLR, as it is the last received balise group.

test_cases.title: Linking replacement rule applied before SOLR update
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU receives new linking information that affects the current SOLR or location items.

steps.action: The OBU processes the received linking information.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the linking replacement rule (SUBSET-026 §3.7.3.1 m)) before updating the SOLR.

test_cases.title: Relocation before replacement rule for other information
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU receives location based information (not linking information) that is referred to a balise group different from the current SOLR.

steps.action: The OBU processes the received location based information.
steps.expected: The OBU relocates the information to the SOLR before applying the corresponding replacement rule of §3.7.3.1.

test_cases.title: Processing location based information into location items
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU receives location based information that, according to SUBSET-026 Table 2a, is associated with a specific type of location item (e.g., 'min').

steps.action: The OBU processes the location based information.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the information into up to three location items ('min', 'estimated', 'max') and applies the clause associated with the 'min' location item for that information.

test_cases.title: Relocation of location items to new SOLR using linking information
test_cases.preconditions: Balise Group BG1 is the current SOLR. Location based information is referred to BG1. The train passes Balise Group BG2, which becomes the new SOLR. Linking information is available and known for the distance between BG1 and BG2.

steps.action: The OBU evaluates the location based information referred to BG1 after BG2 becomes the SOLR.
steps.expected: The OBU relocates the location items to BG2 by subtracting the distance between BG1 and BG2 retrieved from linking information from the distance to BG1.

test_cases.title: Relocation of location items to new SOLR using travelled distance
test_cases.preconditions: Balise Group BG1 is the current SOLR. Location based information is referred to BG1. The train passes Balise Group BG2, which becomes the new SOLR. Linking information is not available or known for the distance between BG1 and BG2.

steps.action: The OBU evaluates the location based information referred to BG1 after BG2 becomes the SOLR.
steps.expected: The OBU relocates the location items to BG2 by subtracting the estimated, min or max travelled distance between BG1 and BG2, computed from train front end positions, from the distance to BG1.

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon reaching standstill
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train moving, position report parameters stored.

steps.action: Train decelerates and reaches standstill (speed 0 km/h).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon leaving standstill
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train at standstill.

steps.action: Train accelerates from standstill to a speed greater than 0 km/h.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon mode change
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train in Full Supervision (FS) mode.

steps.action: A mode change occurs (e.g., transition to Supervision mode due to loss of MA).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon level change
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC.

steps.action: A level change occurs (e.g., transition from Level 2 to Level 1).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon driver confirmation of train integrity
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'No integrity information' or 'Confirmed by external source'.

steps.action: Driver confirms train integrity via DMI.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon detection of loss of train integrity
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'Confirmed by driver' or 'Confirmed by external source'.

steps.action: Loss of train integrity is detected (e.g., via external source or driver action).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon successful session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, no communication session established, RBC contact information available.

steps.action: A communication session with the RBC is successfully established.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon passing LRBG compliant balise group without stored parameters
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, no position report parameters stored on-board.

steps.action: Train passes an LRBG compliant balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon crossing RBC/RBC border with min safe rear end
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train approaching an RBC/RBC border.

steps.action: The train's min safe rear end crosses the RBC/RBC border.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon crossing RBC/RBC border with max safe front end
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train approaching an RBC/RBC border.

steps.action: The train's max safe front end crosses the RBC/RBC border.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon crossing level transition border (L2 to L0/NTC/1) with min safe rear end
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train approaching a level transition border leading to Level 0, NTC or 1.

steps.action: The train's min safe rear end crosses the level transition border.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report sent upon detection of error defined in 3.16.4
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC.

steps.action: An error as defined in SUBSET-026 §3.16.4 is detected.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Train integrity status 'No integrity information' reported without train length
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'No integrity information'.

steps.action: A position report is triggered (e.g., by reaching standstill).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report containing train integrity status 'No integrity information' and no confirmed train length field.

test_cases.title: Train integrity status 'Confirmed by driver' reported with train length
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'Confirmed by driver', valid train length available.

steps.action: A position report is triggered (e.g., by reaching standstill).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report containing train integrity status 'Confirmed by driver' and the confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Train integrity status 'Confirmed by external source' reported with train length
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'Confirmed by external source', valid train length available.

steps.action: A position report is triggered (e.g., by reaching standstill).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report containing train integrity status 'Confirmed by external source' and the confirmed train length.

test_cases.title: Train integrity status 'Lost' reported without train length
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'Lost'.

steps.action: A position report is triggered (e.g., by reaching standstill).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report containing train integrity status 'Lost' and no confirmed train length field.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'No integrity information' to 'Confirmed by driver'
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'No integrity information', valid train position and length available.

steps.action: Driver confirms train integrity.
steps.expected: The train integrity status changes to 'Confirmed by driver'.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'No integrity information' to 'Confirmed by external source'
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'No integrity information', valid train position and length available.

steps.action: External source confirms train integrity.
steps.expected: The train integrity status changes to 'Confirmed by external source'.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'Confirmed by driver' to 'Lost'
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'Confirmed by driver'.

steps.action: Loss of train integrity is detected (e.g., current estimated train position exceeds the range of the confirmed train length information).
steps.expected: The train integrity status changes to 'Lost'.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'Confirmed by external source' to 'Lost'
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'Confirmed by external source'.

steps.action: Loss of train integrity is detected (e.g., current estimated train position exceeds the range of the confirmed train length information).
steps.expected: The train integrity status changes to 'Lost'.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'Lost' to 'No integrity information'
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'Lost'.

steps.action: A new communication session is established with the RBC.
steps.expected: The train integrity status is set to 'No integrity information'.

test_cases.title: Transition from 'Confirmed by driver' to 'No integrity information' upon session re-establishment
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC, train integrity status is 'Confirmed by driver'.

steps.action: The communication session is terminated and a new session is successfully established with the RBC.
steps.expected: The train integrity status is set to 'No integrity information'.

test_cases.title: Geographical position display on driver request
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has valid geographical position information stored (e.g., from a balise group). The train is moving. The geographical position display is currently not active.

steps.action: Verify the DMI status before the request.
steps.expected: The geographical position is not displayed on the DMI.

steps.action: The driver requests the geographical position display via the DMI.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the geographical position of the train's estimated front end in relation to the track kilometre.

test_cases.title: Stopping geographical position display on driver request
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has valid geographical position information stored. The geographical position display is currently active on the DMI.

steps.action: Verify the DMI status before the request.
steps.expected: The geographical position is displayed on the DMI.

steps.action: The driver requests to stop the geographical position display via the DMI.
steps.expected: The OBU stops displaying the geographical position on the DMI.

test_cases.title: Geographical position calculation includes distance travelled
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has stored geographical position information from a reference balise group with a known track kilometre reference and offset. The train is moving in the direction of the track kilometre counting.
test_cases.assumptions: The distance travelled since the reference location is measurable and non-zero.

steps.action: Record the initial geographical position displayed or calculated by the OBU immediately after passing the reference balise group (distance travelled = 0).
steps.expected: The displayed position corresponds to the track kilometre reference value adjusted by the offset.

steps.action: Allow the train to travel a known distance D from the reference location.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the new geographical position by adding the distance D to the initial position (accounting for counting direction).

steps.action: Request the geographical position display on the DMI.
steps.expected: The displayed position reflects the initial position plus the distance D travelled.

test_cases.title: Roll-away distance supervision start calculation
test_cases.preconditions: Train is at standstill in a mode where Roll Away Protection is active (e.g., FS or OS). The National Value for maximum roll-away distance is set to 10 m. The train position is not referenced to a balise group (e.g., after a power cycle or in a section without balises).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU internal state for 'supervision started' is observable or can be inferred from the DMI status or internal logs.

steps.action: Initiate the Roll Away Protection supervision (e.g., by entering a mode that triggers it or by a specific test command).
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance to be travelled as 10 m (the full National Value) immediately upon starting the supervision.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 2 m (simulated via odometer input).
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance to 8 m (10 m - 2 m).

test_cases.title: Staff Responsible distance supervision start calculation
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Staff Responsible (SR) mode. The maximum permitted distance to run in SR mode is set to 500 m (via RBC or Driver input). The train position is not referenced to a balise group.
test_cases.assumptions: The SR distance supervision is active and the initial remaining distance is observable.

steps.action: Enter Staff Responsible mode with a defined maximum distance of 500 m.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance to be travelled as 500 m immediately upon starting the supervision.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 100 m.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance to 400 m.

test_cases.title: Roll-away distance supervision using estimated distance travelled
test_cases.preconditions: Roll Away Protection is active. The National Value for maximum roll-away distance is 10 m. The train is at the start location of the supervision.
test_cases.assumptions: The odometer reading is accurate and the 'estimated distance travelled' is derived from it.

steps.action: Start the Roll Away Protection supervision.
steps.expected: The remaining distance is 10 m.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 5 m.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the estimated distance travelled (5 m) to calculate the remaining distance as 5 m (10 m - 5 m).

steps.action: Move the train forward by another 5 m (total 10 m).
steps.expected: The remaining distance is 0 m. The OBU triggers the safety reaction (e.g., brake application) as the maximum distance has been reached.

test_cases.title: Post Trip reversing distance supervision using estimated distance travelled
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Post Trip (PT) mode. The maximum distance for reversing is set to 20 m. The train is at the start location of the reversing supervision.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is oriented such that reversing is the concerned direction.

steps.action: Start the reversing supervision in Post Trip mode.
steps.expected: The remaining distance for reversing is 20 m.

steps.action: Move the train in the reversing direction by 10 m.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the estimated distance travelled (10 m) to calculate the remaining distance as 10 m (20 m - 10 m).

steps.action: Move the train in the reversing direction by another 10 m (total 20 m).
steps.expected: The remaining distance is 0 m. The OBU triggers the safety reaction for exceeding the reversing limit.

test_cases.title: Staff Responsible virtual train front position with odometer under-reading
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Staff Responsible (SR) mode. The maximum permitted distance is 100 m. The odometer has a known under-reading amount of 5 m since the supervision was started. The train position is not referenced to a balise group.
test_cases.assumptions: The odometer under-reading amount is a known parameter in the OBU configuration or can be simulated.

steps.action: Start the Staff Responsible supervision with a maximum distance of 100 m.
steps.expected: The OBU creates a virtual train front position. The remaining distance from the estimated front end is 100 m.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 50 m (odometer reading). The odometer under-reads by 5 m, so the actual distance travelled is 55 m, but the OBU uses the estimated distance (50 m) for the virtual position calculation as per §3.6.7.3 a).
steps.expected: The remaining distance from the estimated front end is 50 m (100 m - 50 m). The remaining distance from the max safe front end is 45 m (100 m - 50 m - 5 m under-reading).

test_cases.title: Staff Responsible virtual train front position with odometer over-reading
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Staff Responsible (SR) mode. The maximum permitted distance is 100 m. The odometer has a known over-reading amount of 5 m since the supervision was started. The train position is not referenced to a balise group.
test_cases.assumptions: The odometer over-reading amount is a known parameter in the OBU configuration or can be simulated.

steps.action: Start the Staff Responsible supervision with a maximum distance of 100 m.
steps.expected: The OBU creates a virtual train front position. The remaining distance from the estimated front end is 100 m.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 50 m (odometer reading). The odometer over-reads by 5 m, so the actual distance travelled is 45 m, but the OBU uses the estimated distance (50 m) for the virtual position calculation as per §3.6.7.3 a).
steps.expected: The remaining distance from the estimated front end is 50 m (100 m - 50 m). The remaining distance from the min safe front end is 55 m (100 m - 50 m + 5 m over-reading).

test_cases.title: Zero distance to former EOA/LOA after Override without valid position
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Stand-By (SB) or Post Trip (PT) mode. The Override function has been triggered. There is no valid train position stored on-board (e.g., after a power cycle). The former EOA/LOA is at a known location.
test_cases.assumptions: The Override function is active and the zero distance supervision is started.

steps.action: Trigger the Override function in SB or PT mode without a valid train position.
steps.expected: The OBU starts supervision of a zero distance to the former EOA/LOA. The remaining distance is 0 m.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 1 m.
steps.expected: The OBU triggers the safety reaction (e.g., brake application) as the train has moved away from the former EOA/LOA, exceeding the zero distance limit.

test_cases.title: MA rejection when SSP/gradient does not cover full length (Non-infill MA)
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, train in FS mode. A communication session with the RBC is established. The train is stationary or moving slowly.
test_cases.test_inputs: An MA message where the SSP and gradient data provided covers only 50% of the distance from the estimated train front end to the Supervised Location (SvL).
test_cases.assumptions: The 'full length' for a non-infill MA is defined as the distance from the estimated front end of the train to the supervised location.

steps.action: The RBC sends a new MA with associated SSP and gradient data that does not cover the full length of the MA (from estimated train front end to SvL).
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the MA. The previous MA (if any) remains valid, or the train remains in its current state without adopting the new MA. The driver is informed of the error or the MA is not displayed as active.

steps.action: Check the OBU status regarding the Movement Authority.
steps.expected: The OBU does not supervise the new MA. The target speed and target distance are not updated to reflect the rejected MA.

test_cases.title: MA rejection when SSP/gradient does not cover full length (Infill MA)
test_cases.preconditions: Level 1 or 2, train in FS mode. An infill MA is expected. The train is approaching the infill location.
test_cases.test_inputs: An infill MA message where the SSP and gradient data covers only a portion of the distance from the infill location reference to the Supervised Location (SvL).
test_cases.assumptions: The 'full length' for an infill MA is defined as the distance from the infill location reference to the supervised location.

steps.action: The RBC sends an infill MA with associated SSP and gradient data that does not cover the full length of the MA (from infill location reference to SvL).
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the infill MA. The previous MA remains valid. The train continues to be supervised by the previous MA.

steps.action: Verify the train supervision limits.
steps.expected: The Supervised Location (SvL) and Indication Supervision Limit (ISL) remain those of the previous MA. The new infill MA is not applied.

test_cases.title: MA rejection when SSP/gradient does not cover full length (Supervised Manoeuvre, opposite orientation)
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, train in FS mode. A Supervised Manoeuvre (SH) is initiated. The train orientation is about to change or has changed such that the validity direction of the MA is opposite to the current train orientation.
test_cases.test_inputs: An MA for a Supervised Manoeuvre where the SSP and gradient data does not cover the full length from the estimated front end of the train (derived from the new orientation) to the Supervised Location.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'full length' for this case is defined as the distance from the estimated front end of the train derived from the new train orientation to the supervised location.

steps.action: The RBC sends an MA for a Supervised Manoeuvre with validity direction opposite to the current train orientation. The SSP and gradient data does not cover the full length from the estimated front end (new orientation) to the SvL.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the MA. The train does not enter the Shunting mode or does not adopt the new MA for the manoeuvre.

steps.action: Check the OBU response to the manoeuvre request.
steps.expected: The OBU informs the RBC of the rejection or maintains the previous state. The train remains in its previous mode (e.g., FS) and is supervised by the previous MA.

test_cases.title: MA acceptance when SSP/gradient covers full length (Boundary)
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, train in FS mode. Communication session established.
test_cases.test_inputs: An MA message where the SSP and gradient data covers exactly the full length of the MA (from estimated train front end to SvL) with no gap.
test_cases.assumptions: The SSP and gradient data ends exactly at the Supervised Location.

steps.action: The RBC sends a new MA with SSP and gradient data that covers exactly the full length of the MA (from estimated train front end to SvL).
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the MA. The new MA becomes the active MA.

steps.action: Verify the supervision limits.
steps.expected: The OBU supervises the train according to the new MA, with the SvL and ISL updated to the values of the new MA.

test_cases.title: Replacement of route suitability loading gauge information
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where location based information is stored (e.g., Full Supervision). Existing route suitability loading gauge information is stored for a specific track section.
test_cases.test_inputs: New track description data containing route suitability loading gauge information.

steps.action: Verify that the OBU currently stores route suitability loading gauge information for a defined track section.
steps.expected: The stored loading gauge information is present and active in the OBU's database.

steps.action: Inject new track description data containing new route suitability loading gauge information via the data link.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the new information.

steps.action: Check the stored route suitability loading gauge information in the OBU.
steps.expected: The new route suitability loading gauge information has replaced all previously stored route suitability loading gauge information.

test_cases.title: Replacement of adhesion factor information from start location
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU stores adhesion factor information for a track section starting at location L1 and ending at L2. The train is located before L1.
test_cases.test_inputs: New track description data containing adhesion factor information starting at location L3 (where L3 is within the range of the existing information or after it, but the rule specifies replacement from the start location of the new info).
test_cases.assumptions: The new adhesion factor information has a start location L3. The requirement states replacement from the start location of the new information.

steps.action: Verify the existing adhesion factor information stored in the OBU.
steps.expected: Adhesion factor information is stored for the section starting at L1.

steps.action: Inject new track description data containing adhesion factor information with a start location L3.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the new adhesion factor information.

steps.action: Check the stored adhesion factor information from location L3 onwards.
steps.expected: The new adhesion factor information replaces the stored adhesion factor information from the start location of the new information (L3) onwards. Information before L3 remains unchanged if it was not part of the replaced segment defined by the start location logic.

test_cases.title: Replacement of linking information (non-infill) from reference balise group
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU stores linking information with a reference balise group BG1. The train is in a mode where linking information is relevant.
test_cases.test_inputs: New linking information received as non-infill information with a reference balise group BG2.

steps.action: Verify the existing linking information stored in the OBU, referencing BG1.
steps.expected: Linking information referencing BG1 is stored.

steps.action: Inject new linking information as non-infill information with reference balise group BG2.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the new linking information.

steps.action: Check the stored linking information.
steps.expected: The new linking information replaces all stored linking information from the reference balise group of the new linking information (BG2) onwards.

test_cases.title: Replacement of linking information (infill) from infill reference location
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU stores linking information. The train is approaching a main signal where infill linking information is expected.
test_cases.test_inputs: New linking information received as infill information. The infill reference location is the balise group at the next main signal (BG_Signal).

steps.action: Verify the existing linking information stored in the OBU.
steps.expected: Linking information is stored.

steps.action: Inject new linking information as infill information.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the infill linking information.

steps.action: Check the stored linking information from the infill reference location (BG_Signal).
steps.expected: The new linking information replaces all stored linking information from the reference location of the infill information (the balise group at the next main signal) onwards.

test_cases.title: Resumption of initial state for PBD speed restrictions on trackside request
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU stores a Speed Restriction to ensure Permitted Braking Distance (PBD) information for a track section. The train is in a mode where this restriction is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside request to resume initial states for PBD speed restrictions beyond a given location L_req.

steps.action: Verify that a PBD speed restriction is stored and active in the OBU.
steps.expected: The PBD speed restriction is present in the OBU's speed profile.

steps.action: Send a trackside request to resume initial states for PBD speed restrictions beyond location L_req.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the request.

steps.action: Check the PBD speed restriction information beyond location L_req.
steps.expected: The PBD speed restriction information beyond location L_req is deleted or resumed to its initial state (no restriction).

test_cases.title: Resumption of initial state for axle load speed profiles on trackside request
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU stores axle load speed profile information for a track section. The train is in a mode where this profile is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside request to resume initial states for axle load speed profiles beyond a given location L_req.

steps.action: Verify that axle load speed profile information is stored and active in the OBU.
steps.expected: The axle load speed profile is present in the OBU's speed profile.

steps.action: Send a trackside request to resume initial states for axle load speed profiles beyond location L_req.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the request.

steps.action: Check the axle load speed profile information beyond location L_req.
steps.expected: The axle load speed profile information beyond location L_req is deleted or resumed to its initial state.

test_cases.title: Resumption of initial state for grouped track condition types on single request
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU stores track condition information of types: sound horn, non stopping area, tunnel stopping area, powerless section – lower pantograph, powerless section – switch off the main power switch, radio hole, air tightness, switch off regenerative brake, switch off eddy current brake for service brake, switch off eddy current brake for emergency brake, and switch off magnetic shoe brake. The train is in a mode where these conditions are active.
test_cases.test_inputs: A single trackside request to resume initial states for all stored track condition information of the listed types beyond a given location L_req.

steps.action: Verify that the listed track condition information is stored and active in the OBU.
steps.expected: The track condition information is present in the OBU's database.

steps.action: Send a single trackside request to resume initial states for all stored track condition information of the listed types beyond location L_req.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the request.

steps.action: Check the track condition information of the listed types beyond location L_req.
steps.expected: All the listed track condition information beyond location L_req is deleted or resumed to its initial state.

test_cases.title: Resumption of initial state for route suitability data on single request
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU stores route suitability information (loading gauge, traction system, axle load). The train is in a mode where this information is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: A single trackside request to resume initial states for all stored route suitability information beyond a given location L_req.

steps.action: Verify that route suitability information is stored and active in the OBU.
steps.expected: The route suitability information is present in the OBU's database.

steps.action: Send a single trackside request to resume initial states for all stored route suitability information beyond location L_req.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the request.

steps.action: Check the route suitability information beyond location L_req.
steps.expected: All stored route suitability information beyond location L_req is deleted or resumed to its initial state.

test_cases.title: Resumption of initial state for Station Platform track conditions on single request
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU stores track condition information of the type Station Platform. The train is in a mode where this information is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: A single trackside request to resume initial states for all stored track condition information of the type Station Platform beyond a given location L_req.

steps.action: Verify that Station Platform track condition information is stored and active in the OBU.
steps.expected: The Station Platform information is present in the OBU's database.

steps.action: Send a single trackside request to resume initial states for all stored track condition information of the type Station Platform beyond location L_req.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the request.

steps.action: Check the Station Platform track condition information beyond location L_req.
steps.expected: All stored Station Platform track condition information beyond location L_req is deleted or resumed to its initial state.

test_cases.title: Supervised Manoeuvre with same validity direction as train orientation
test_cases.preconditions: The train is oriented in direction D1. The OBU stores location based information (e.g., SSP, TSR, track conditions). A Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation is received with a Movement Authority (MA) validity direction D1 (same as train orientation).
test_cases.test_inputs: Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with MA validity direction D1.

steps.action: Verify the current train orientation and stored location based information.
steps.expected: Train orientation is D1. Location based information is stored.

steps.action: Receive a Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with MA validity direction D1.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the authorisation.

steps.action: Check the handling of location based information.
steps.expected: The normal replacement rules of SUBSET-026 §3.7.3.1 are applied. The stored location based information is updated according to the new MA and track description, not deleted entirely.

test_cases.title: Supervised Manoeuvre with opposite validity direction to train orientation
test_cases.preconditions: The train is oriented in direction D1. The OBU stores location based information (e.g., SSP, TSR, track conditions). A Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation is received with a Movement Authority (MA) validity direction D2 (opposite to train orientation D1).
test_cases.test_inputs: Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with MA validity direction D2.

steps.action: Verify the current train orientation and stored location based information.
steps.expected: Train orientation is D1. Location based information is stored.

steps.action: Receive a Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with MA validity direction D2 (opposite to D1).
steps.expected: The OBU processes the authorisation.

steps.action: Check the stored location based information.
steps.expected: The normal replacement rules are not applied. All previously stored location based information is deleted.

test_cases.title: MA request includes all applicable reasons when multiple triggers occur simultaneously
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC. MA request parameters received from RBC. Train is in a mode where MA requests are allowed. The train is positioned such that the perturbation location criterion is met (train front passes the defined location). Simultaneously, the driver selects 'Start'.
test_cases.assumptions: The RBC is configured to accept MA requests. The 'Start' selection and the perturbation location trigger occur within the same processing cycle or are both active at the moment the request is generated.

steps.action: Position the train so that the front passes the location defined by the perturbation-location criterion (3.8.2.2.1 a).
steps.expected: The reason 'Time before reaching the perturbation location reached' becomes applicable.

steps.action: While the perturbation reason is applicable, the driver selects 'Start' on the DMI.
steps.expected: The reason 'Start selected by driver' becomes applicable.

steps.action: Observe the MA request sent to the RBC.
steps.expected: The MA request message contains both reasons: 'Start selected by driver' and 'Time before reaching the perturbation location reached'.

test_cases.title: MA request includes only the applicable reason when a single trigger occurs
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC. MA request parameters received. No other MA request reasons are currently applicable (no perturbation, no timer expiry, no track deletion, no level 2 transition info).

steps.action: The driver selects 'Start' on the DMI.
steps.expected: The reason 'Start selected by driver' becomes applicable.

steps.action: Observe the MA request sent to the RBC.
steps.expected: The MA request message contains only the reason 'Start selected by driver'.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered when train front passes perturbation location
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC. MA request parameters received from RBC defining the time before perturbation location. A perturbation location is defined in the MA. The train is running at a speed such that it will reach the calculated trigger location.
test_cases.assumptions: The trigger location is calculated based on the warning speed and the defined time parameter from the RBC.

steps.action: Run the train towards the perturbation location.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the trigger location based on the received parameters.

steps.action: Allow the train front to pass the calculated trigger location.
steps.expected: The OBU triggers and sends an MA request to the RBC with the reason 'Time before reaching the perturbation location reached'.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered when Section timer criterion is reached
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC. MA request parameters received from RBC defining the time before Section timer expiry. A Section timer is active and supervised. The train is in a section with a defined Section timer.
test_cases.assumptions: The Section timer is running and will expire in the future. The defined time before expiry is less than the remaining time on the Section timer.

steps.action: Wait until the time remaining on the Section timer equals the defined time before expiry specified in the MA request parameters.
steps.expected: The OBU triggers and sends an MA request to the RBC with the reason 'Time before a Section timer/LOA speed timer expires reached'.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered when LOA speed timer criterion is reached
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC. MA request parameters received from RBC defining the time before LOA speed timer expiry. A LOA speed timer is active and supervised.
test_cases.assumptions: The LOA speed timer is running and will expire in the future. The defined time before expiry is less than the remaining time on the LOA speed timer.

steps.action: Wait until the time remaining on the LOA speed timer equals the defined time before expiry specified in the MA request parameters.
steps.expected: The OBU triggers and sends an MA request to the RBC with the reason 'Time before a Section timer/LOA speed timer expires reached'.

test_cases.title: MA request sent when track description is deleted (non-excluded situation)
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC. The OBU has stored track description information. A situation occurs that causes part of the track description to be deleted according to Appendix A.3.4, which is not one of the excluded situations (a, b, f, k).
test_cases.assumptions: The deletion is caused by a valid trackside command or data inconsistency that triggers deletion per A.3.4, e.g., deletion of a speed restriction not covered by exclusions.

steps.action: Trigger a deletion of part of the track description that falls under a non-excluded situation in Appendix A.3.4 (e.g., deletion of a specific speed restriction or track condition).
steps.expected: The OBU sends an MA request to the RBC with the reason 'Track description deletion'.

test_cases.title: No MA request sent when track description is deleted in an excluded situation
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, communication session established with RBC. The OBU has stored track description information. A situation occurs that causes part of the track description to be deleted according to Appendix A.3.4, which is one of the excluded situations (a, b, f, or k).
test_cases.assumptions: The deletion is caused by a situation explicitly excluded in 3.8.2.5.1, e.g., situation 'a' (deletion due to reception of a new MA that supersedes the old one, if that is the interpretation of exclusion 'a' - note: specific content of a,b,f,k is not in the provided text, but the requirement states they are exceptions. We assume a testable excluded case exists, e.g., deletion of information that is no longer relevant due to a new MA receipt which is handled differently).

steps.action: Trigger a deletion of part of the track description that falls under one of the excluded situations in Appendix A.3.4 (e.g., situation 'a').
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT send an MA request to the RBC with the reason 'Track description deletion'.

test_cases.title: End Section timer start upon passing start location
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in a mode where MA is active (e.g., FS). An MA with an End Section timer start location is stored. The train's max safe front end is located before the End Section timer start location.

steps.action: Move the train forward so that its max safe front end passes the End Section timer start location.
steps.expected: The End Section timer starts counting.

test_cases.title: End Section timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: End Section timer is running. The MA includes an LOA with a non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority. Location based information per Appendix A.3.4 is stored.

steps.action: Wait until the End Section timer value exceeds the time-out value given by trackside.
steps.expected: The EOA/LOA is withdrawn to the train's current position. The location based information listed in Appendix A.3.4 is deleted. The non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority is set to zero.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer start in Level 2
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2 operation. Communication session with RBC is established. Train is in FS mode.

steps.action: Receive a new MA message from the RBC containing a LOA speed.
steps.expected: The LOA speed timer starts at the time stamp of the received message.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer start in Level 1
test_cases.preconditions: Level 1 operation. Train is in FS mode. A balise group giving an MA with a LOA speed is ahead.

steps.action: Pass the first encountered balise of the balise group that gives the MA.
steps.expected: The LOA speed timer starts at the moment of passing the first balise.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: LOA speed timer is running. The MA includes a LOA with a non-zero speed. Location based information per Appendix A.3.4 is stored.

steps.action: Wait until the LOA speed timer value exceeds the time-out value received from trackside.
steps.expected: The speed associated with the LOA is set to zero. The LOA becomes an EOA. The Supervised Location is defined per §3.8.4.5. The location based information listed in Appendix A.3.4 is deleted.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start upon passing start location
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in a mode where MA is active. An MA with an Overlap timer start location and a finite time-out value is stored. The train's max safe front end is located before the Overlap timer start location.

steps.action: Move the train forward so that its max safe front end passes the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer starts counting.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start with infinite time-out value
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in a mode where MA is active. An MA with an Overlap timer start location and a time-out value of 'infinite' is stored. The train's max safe front end is located before the Overlap timer start location.

steps.action: Move the train forward so that its max safe front end passes the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer is considered as started.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: Overlap timer is running. The MA includes an Overlap with a release speed and a non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority. Location based information per Appendix A.3.4 is stored.

steps.action: Wait until the Overlap timer value exceeds the time-out value given by trackside.
steps.expected: The overlap information is deleted. The release speed associated with the Overlap is deleted. The Supervised Location is redetermined per §3.8.4.5. The location based information listed in Appendix A.3.4 is deleted. The non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority is set to zero.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer expiration upon train standstill
test_cases.preconditions: Overlap timer has been started. The train is moving. The MA includes an Overlap with a release speed and a non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority.

steps.action: Bring the train to a standstill while the Overlap timer is running.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the Overlap timer as expired. The overlap information is deleted. The release speed is deleted. The Supervised Location is redetermined per §3.8.4.5. The non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority is set to zero.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer expiration upon receiving new MA with rear start location
test_cases.preconditions: No Overlap timer is running. The train's max safe front end is at a specific position. The MA includes an Overlap with a release speed and a non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority.

steps.action: Receive a new MA where the Overlap timer start location is in rear of the train's max safe front end.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the Overlap timer as exceeded its time-out value. The overlap information is deleted. The release speed is deleted. The Supervised Location is redetermined per §3.8.4.5. The non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority is set to zero.

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with valid Overlap
test_cases.preconditions: The MA includes an Overlap that has not timed out. A Danger Point and an End Section are also defined in the MA.

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location determined by the OBU.
steps.expected: The Supervised Location is the end of the Overlap.

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with timed-out Overlap and valid Danger Point
test_cases.preconditions: The Overlap has timed out and been deleted. A Danger Point is defined in the MA. An End Section is also defined.

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location determined by the OBU.
steps.expected: The Supervised Location is the Danger Point.

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with no Overlap and no Danger Point
test_cases.preconditions: No Overlap exists (or it has timed out). No Danger Point exists. An End Section is defined in the MA.

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location determined by the OBU.
steps.expected: The Supervised Location is the end of the End Section.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation in Full Supervision mode
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Full Supervision mode. Linking information is available for the main signal balise group.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation in Automatic Driving mode
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Automatic Driving mode. Linking information is available for the main signal balise group.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation in Limited Supervision mode
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Limited Supervision mode. Linking information is available for the main signal balise group.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA rejection in non-supervision mode
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in a mode other than Full Supervision, Automatic Driving, or Limited Supervision (e.g., SM or SH).

steps.action: Receive an infill MA.
steps.expected: The OBU does not evaluate the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation with available linking information
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Full Supervision mode. Linking information is available for the main signal balise group to which the infill MA refers.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Infill MA rejection without linking information
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in Full Supervision mode. Linking information is NOT available for the main signal balise group to which the infill MA refers.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA.
steps.expected: The OBU does not evaluate the infill MA.

test_cases.title: Non-infill MA from RBC replaces all previous MA data
test_cases.preconditions: Level 2, train in FS, OS, LS or AD. An MA with specific data (e.g., a specific speed restriction or section timer) is currently supervised. Communication session with RBC is established.

steps.action: Receive a new MA from the RBC that contains different data (e.g., different speed profile or section lengths) than the currently supervised MA.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces all data of the previous MA with the new data. The new MA is fully applied and supervised.

test_cases.title: Non-infill MA from main-signal balise group replaces all previous MA data
test_cases.preconditions: Level 1, train in FS, OS, LS or AD. An MA is currently supervised. The train is approaching a main signal balise group that transmits a non-infill MA.

steps.action: The train passes the main signal balise group which transmits a new non-infill MA with data different from the currently supervised MA.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces all data of the previous MA with the new data. The new MA is fully applied and supervised.

test_cases.title: Infill MA replaces only data beyond the next main signal balise group
test_cases.preconditions: Level 1, train in FS, OS, LS or AD. An MA is currently supervised. Linking information for the next main signal balise group is available. The train is in the infill area.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA from a balise group or radio infill unit that refers to the next main signal balise group. The infill MA contains data different from the current MA beyond the main signal.
steps.expected: The OBU keeps the data of the previous MA up to the announced balise group at the next main signal. The OBU replaces only the data beyond that balise group with the new infill MA data.

test_cases.title: New MA section starts at infill location reference
test_cases.preconditions: Level 1, train in FS, OS, LS or AD. An MA is currently supervised. Linking information for the next main signal balise group is available. The train is in the infill area.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA that refers to the next main signal balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU starts a new MA section at the infill location reference, which is the balise group at the next main signal. The section timer for this new section starts at this location.

test_cases.title: New MA with SvL while supervising LOA is treated as MA shortening
test_cases.preconditions: Level 1 or 2, train in FS, OS, LS or AD. The OBU is currently supervising an MA ending with an LOA (Location of Authority). Location based information (e.g., speed restrictions, gradients) is stored beyond the LOA.

steps.action: Receive a new MA that defines an SvL (Stop Location) instead of an LOA. The SvL can be anywhere (e.g., before, at, or after the previous LOA location).
steps.expected: The OBU treats this as an MA shortening. The OBU deletes the stored location based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4 that is no longer valid under the new MA.

test_cases.title: MA shortening deletion applies to information stored prior to reception
